scripts.text:
[????]
Are you {0}?
I've been waiting for you.
^6B8E23Priest Bamph^000000 is expecting
your arrival at ^6B8E23Prontera
Church^000000. Please visit him
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[????]
你是{0}嗎？
我一直在等你。
^6B8E23牧師巴姆夫^000000正在
^6B8E23普隆德拉教堂^000000等你。
請儘快去見他。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Damn it, I lost again!
This game is rigged!
No matter what I try,
I can never seem to win!
But Comodo Hold 'Em
is so... It's so addicting!
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
該死，我又輸了！
這遊戲肯定有詐！
不管我怎麼試，
就是贏不了！
但是科摩多德州撲克
真是...太讓人上癮了！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Argh, I lost at this game
so many times that I've
completely lost track!
I've got to win sometime...
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
唉，我在這遊戲裡
輸得太多次了，
完全記不清了！
總有一天我會贏的...

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Oh! Uh... Hmm...
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
哦！呃...嗯...
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: ^6B8E23Priest Bamph^000000 sent me.
scripts.translation: ^6B8E23牧師巴姆夫^000000派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Oh, I see. I apologize
if my screaming and yelling
made you a bit uncomfortable.
I'm just here to kill some
time... I now see firsthand
that gambling is truly evil!
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
哦，原來如此。抱歉，
我的大喊大叫
可能讓你感到不適了。
我只是在這裡消磨時間...
我現在親眼見識到
賭博真是萬惡之源！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Er, would you come
over this way? I don't
want anyone else to
overhear us talking.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
呃，你能過來這邊嗎？
我不想讓別人
聽到我們的談話。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
What?! I lost again?
How does... How does
this game even work?!
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
什麼？！我又輸了？
這...這遊戲到底
是怎麼玩的？！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
This isn't good at all.
I don't know what to do...

[Larjes]
Good, no one should be
able to hear us from here.
After I sent a message to
the place, I found some
new information that should
really help my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
很好，這裡應該
沒人能聽到我們說話。
在我給那邊發了訊息後，
我發現了一些
對新調查很有幫助的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I learned that two details
about the night when that
high ranking man vanished.
Firstly, he left the guards for
a bit to meet a woman. It's
always a woman, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
我瞭解到關於那位
高官失蹤那晚的兩個細節。
首先，他暫時離開了衛兵，
去見一個女人。
總是女人，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Secondly, after he left to
meet that woman, some other
people came in, and then they
carried some really large
baggage with them when
they left to the west.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
其次，在他離開去見那個女人後，
其他人進來了，
然後他們帶著一些
非常大的行李
往西邊離開了。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Those bags were so big,
it's suspicious. It seems
like some organization has
kidnapped him, and wants to
bring him west for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
那些袋子太大了，
很可疑。看起來像是
某個組織綁架了他，
並想把他帶到西邊去。

scripts.text: Why to the west?
scripts.translation: 為什麼是西邊？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
This is just a guess, but
I think whoever kidnapped
him are from ^2F4F2FArunafeltz^000000.
I'm prohibited from entering
Arunafeltz so I wasn't able
to investigate any further.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
這只是我的猜測，
但我認為綁架他的人
來自^2F4F2F阿魯納菲茲^000000。
我被禁止進入阿魯納菲茲，
所以無法進一步調查。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I gambled away
this much money?
How am I gonna pay
off all of this debt?!
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
我賭掉了
這麼多錢？
我該怎麼還清
這些債務？！

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Welcome to
Rachel's Palate, one
of Rachel's finest and
most exquisite restraunts.
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
歡迎光臨
拉赫的味覺，
拉赫最精緻、
最優雅的餐廳之一。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Welcome to
Rachel's Palate, one
of Rachel's finest and
most exquisite restraunts.
[Waiter]
The food in this
restaurant is the
best in Rachel--no,
it is the best in all
of Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
歡迎光臨
拉赫的味覺，
拉赫最精緻、
最優雅的餐廳之一。
[服務員]
這家餐廳的食物
是拉赫最好的——不，
它是整個阿魯納菲茲
最好的！

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
What would you like
to order? Or... If I'm
not mistaken, you're
here for something else?
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
您想點什麼？或者...
如果我沒看錯的話，
您是來辦別的事的？

scripts.text: I'd like to order.
scripts.translation: 我想點餐。

scripts.text: Yes, I've come for another reason.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有別的事。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Sure, no problem.
Did you come alone?
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
沒問題。
您是獨自來的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Right this way.
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
請這邊走。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Hm, okay. Well, whatever
it is, I hope you enjoy your
stay at Rachel's Palate.
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
嗯，好的。無論您是為了什麼而來，
希望您能在拉赫的味覺度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
The food in this
restaurant is the
best in Rachel--no,
it is the best in all
of Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
這家餐廳的食物
是拉赫最好的——不，
它是整個阿魯納菲茲
最好的！

scripts.text:
[Normal-Looking Man]
Mmm-Mmm!
I love the food in
this restaurant!
They don't serve
anything this this
good anywhere else!
scripts.translation:
[外表普通的男子]
嗯...嗯！
我太喜歡這家餐廳的食物了！
別的地方可吃不到
這麼好吃的東西！

scripts.text:
[Common-Looking Man]
The food here isn't bad,
but my favorite restaurants
are over in Hugel. The food
over there is definitely best.
scripts.translation:
[相貌平常的男子]
這裡的食物還不錯，
但我更喜歡的餐廳在毀葛。
那裡的食物絕對是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious-Looking Man]
Each dish has its own
unique taste that you must
learn to relish. Of course,
unhealthy junk food is the
exception to this rule.
scripts.translation:
[形跡可疑的男子]
每道菜都有獨特的風味，
你需要學會去品味它。當然，
不健康的垃圾食品是例外。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
What would you like to order?
Our special today is Fried
Veins Stripe Stickleback
since we received some
high quality fish from Veins
just this morning.
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
您想點什麼？
今天的特色菜是炸伯仁斯條紋刺魚，
因為今天早上我們剛收到
一批來自伯仁斯的高品質魚。

scripts.text: ...Yes, that sounds good.
scripts.translation: ...是的，聽起來不錯。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Excellent choice.
Just to let you know,
that dish is ^9932CD3,000 zeny^000000.
I'll be right back.
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
很好的選擇。
提醒您一下，
那道菜是^9932CD3,000 Zeny^000000。
我馬上回來。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe waiter took your
order, and left to go to
the kitchen. You decide to
eavesdrop on the people
talking at the next table
while you're waiting.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF服務員記下您的訂單，
去廚房了。在等待的間隙，
您決定偷聽鄰桌的人
在聊什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
...............................
I really saw it, the greatest
fish in the world! Last time
I went to Veins, I glimpsed
the Veins Golden Stripe
Stickleback! It's true!
scripts.translation:
[沙啞的男聲]
...............................
我真的看到了，
世界上最棒的魚！
上次我去伯仁斯時，
瞥見了伯仁斯金紋刺魚！
是真的！

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Male Voice]
So were you able to taste
that Veins Golden Stripe
Stickleback juice?
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的男聲]
那你嚐到
伯仁斯金紋刺魚汁了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Average Male Voice]
Aw man, if I did, that
would've been a once
in a lifetime experience!
Veins Golden Stripe
Sticklebacks are only
caught once a decade!
scripts.translation:
[普通的男聲]
天哪，如果嚐到了，
那絕對是一生一次的體驗！
伯仁斯金紋刺魚
十年才捕獲一次！

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Oh yeah, that juice is
incredible. My voice even
changed after I drank it!
It was just... So profound.
scripts.translation:
[沙啞的男聲]
哦對，那種汁液
不可思議。我喝了之後
連聲音都變了！
那感覺...太深邃了。

scripts.text:
[Average Male Voice]
Oh! So that's why
you sound different.
scripts.translation:
[普通的男聲]
哦！原來你聲音
不一樣是因為這個。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Male Voice]
How did you get to drink
such rare juice? I mean,
there must be tons of people
in line with reservations,
just waiting to drink it!
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的男聲]
你是怎麼喝到
這麼稀有的汁液的？
我是說，肯定有
很多人預約排隊等著喝吧！

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
I got damn lucky: I went
to this tavern in Veins, and
overheard that ^DB7093a group of
smugglers were arrested
by the guards at the
southeast beach^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙啞的男聲]
我運氣好得離譜：
我去了伯仁斯的一家酒館，
無意中聽到^DB7093一群走私犯
在東南海灘被衛兵逮捕了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Then I started thinking:
maybe the smugglers were
fishing. So I checked the
beach to see if I could
find their fishing boat.
scripts.translation:
[沙啞的男聲]
然後我就想：
也許那些走私犯是在捕魚。
於是我去海灘看了看，
看能不能找到他們的漁船。

scripts.text:
[Average Male Voice]
Man, you must be obsessed
with food. I mean, how else
would you figure out that the
smugglers were illegally
fishing so quickly?
scripts.translation:
[普通的男聲]
天哪，你肯定是個
吃貨。不然你怎麼能
這麼快就猜到那些走私犯
是在非法捕魚？

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Ha, I guess you're right!
Anyway, there was only one
fishing boat, and the guards
were inspecting it. I was about
to turn back in disappointment
but then... I saw a fisherman!
scripts.translation:
[沙啞的男聲]
哈哈，你說得對！
總之，那裡只有一艘漁船，
衛兵正在檢查它。我本來
都準備失望地轉身離開了，
結果...我看到了一個漁夫！

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Out of the corner of my eye,
I saw him bringing in his
catch for the day, Veins
Golden Strip Stickleback!
I bought all of his fish
right then and there.
scripts.translation:
[沙啞的男聲]
我餘光瞥見他正把當天的
漁獲收上來，是伯仁斯金帶刺魚！
我當場就把他的魚全買下來了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Male Voice]
Boy, were you lucky.
And you never hesitate
to splurge when it comes
to food, do you? Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的男聲]
哇，你運氣真好。
而且你在吃的方面
從來都不吝嗇花錢，對吧？
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Oh, that wasn't even a
splurge. I'm sure you guys
would do the same thing
if you were in my situation.
I'm just grateful that I was
able to taste such rare fish.
scripts.translation:
[沙啞的男聲]
哦，那根本不算揮霍。
我相信如果換成你們，
遇到這種情況也會這麼做的。
我只是很慶幸能嚐到
這麼稀有的魚。

scripts.text:
^3355FF...............................
Then, the men started
to compliment each other.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF......
然後，男人們開始
互相吹捧起來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Ah, here's your Fried
Veins Stripe Stickleback.
Please enjoy your meal.
scripts.translation:
[服務員]
啊，您的炸伯仁斯條紋刺魚
來了。請慢用。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^ff0000Veins^000000, huh? I might want
to check that place one
of these days to see if
I can find more of this fish.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^ff0000伯仁斯^000000，是嗎？
也許哪天我想去那裡看看，
找找看能不能找到
更多的這種魚。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, this fish tastes...
I've never tasted anything
like it! It's almost like
a dessert. God, it's good!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，這魚的味道...
我從來沒吃過這麼好吃的！
簡直就像甜點一樣。
天哪，太美味了！

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Argh! Why must this
happen to me, especially
just when I'm about to
retire! A-ah! My ulcer...
Just all of a sudden, it--!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
啊！為什麼偏偏
發生在我身上，尤其是
在我即將退休的時候！
啊！我的潰瘍...
突然之間，它--！

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Man, this is probably
the biggest hassle of my
career. Why does this have
to happen now? Retirement
is so close, yet so far.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
天哪，這大概是我
職業生涯中最大的麻煩。
為什麼偏偏在這個時候發生？
退休近在咫尺，卻又遙不可及。

scripts.text: Are you in trouble?
scripts.translation: 你遇到麻煩了？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Huh? You don't look like
you're from around here.
Listen, I appreciate your
concern, but I'm really not
comfortable talking to complete
strangers about my problems.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
嗯？你看起來
不像本地人。
聽著，我很感激你的關心，
但我真的不習慣
跟陌生人談論我的問題。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Unless you've got special
business here, you're not
allowed to enter this place.
We're here to keep the public
peace, and letting anyone
in here will cause trouble.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
除非你有特別的公務，
否則不允許進入這裡。
我們負責維護公共秩序，
讓任何人進來都會造成麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I thought I told you
that you weren't allowed
to come in here. Why do
you keep coming back?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我剛才不是說了
你不允許進來嗎？
你為什麼一直回來？

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 對不起。

scripts.text: I want to know about the smugglers.
scripts.translation: 我想知道關於走私犯的事。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
It's fine. Just leave,
and don't come back
unless you've got a
really good reason.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
沒關係。快離開，
除非你有非常充分的理由，
否則不要再回來了。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Hey, how'd you find out
about the smugglers? Did
word spread around town?
Well, I'm sorry, but I can't
disclose any details about
an ongoing investigation.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
嘿，你是怎麼知道
走私犯的事的？訊息
在城裡傳開了嗎？
抱歉，但我不能透露
正在進行的調查細節。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
^9370DBIf you insist on learning
more, then you'd need to
bring me a written order
from a higher ranking officer.^000000
Oh, and you're prohibited
asking anyone else, so behave.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
^9370DB如果你堅持要了解更多，
那你需要給我帶來
上級軍官的書面命令。^000000
哦，而且禁止你詢問其他人，
請守規矩。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I don't blame you for
being curious, but getting
involved when you're not
supposed to will just cause
trouble. Be careful, got it?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我理解你的好奇心，但插手不該管的事只會惹麻煩。小心點，聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Huh, that's weird. You're not
even a citizen of Arunafeltz,
but somehow you know such
a high ranking priest. Alright,
I guess I can tell you more
about our investigation.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
嗯，這很奇怪。你甚至不是阿魯納菲茲的市民，卻認識一位地位如此崇高的牧師。好吧，我想我可以告訴你更多關於我們調查的情況。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I should let you know that
what I tell you might not be
worth all that trouble. This
information probably isn't
as valuable as you think.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我得提醒你，我告訴你的資訊可能並不值得你費這麼大勁。這些情報可能沒有你想像的那麼有價值。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
The smugglers we caught are
the worst kind of scoundrels:
they deal in human trafficking, but we caught them this time when they
were crossing the ocean. Their background info is pretty typical.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我們抓到的那些走私犯是最惡劣的一群人：他們從事人口販賣。這次我們是在他們渡海時抓住了他們。他們的背景資料相當典型。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Let's see... They kidnapped
some man from Comodo.
That's a place in the southwest
part of Rune-Midgarts. Anyway,
the smugglers thought he'd be
wealthy, so they set a trap.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
讓我看看...他們綁架了克魔島的一個男人。那是盧恩·米德加茲西南部的地方。總之，走私犯以為他很有錢，所以設下了陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
They lured him away from his
guards by sending a woman,
but when they captured him,
they found that he was not only
rich, he was also a high ranked
official of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
他們派了一名女子將他的衛兵引開，但在抓住他後，他們發現他不僅富有，還是盧恩·米德加茲的高官。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
That's when they got sloppy:
they were so scared that the
kingdom's troops might pursue
them that they crossed the
ocean that we patrol. That's
where we caught them.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
就在那時他們變得慌亂起來：他們太害怕王國的軍隊會追捕他們，以至於穿越了我們巡邏的海域。我們就是在那裡抓住了他們。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
What I don't understand is
why they were so scared.
I mean, they mainly deal
in human trafficking so...
Kidnapping an official isn't
that big a difference, is it?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我不明白的是，他們為什麼那麼害怕。我是說，他們主要做人口販賣生意...綁架一個高官，這差別也沒那麼大吧？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
We contacted the temple,
and reported the smugglers,
our investigation, and the
high ranking man from the
Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我們聯絡了神殿，報告了走私犯、我們的調查情況，以及那位來自盧恩·米德加茲王國的高官。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Then, some people from
the temple interrupted our
investigation, took away the
smugglers before we finished
our interrogations, and we
haven't seen them since.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
然後，神殿的一些人打斷了我們的調查，在我們完成審訊之前就把走私犯帶走了，從那以後我們就再也沒見過他們。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I asked an acquaintance that
works at the temple, but he
doesn't know what's going
on either. The ^32CD32Rune-Midgarts
official^000000 has gone missing too.
It's all very frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我問了一位在神殿工作的熟人，但他也不知道發生了什麼。那位^32CD32盧恩·米德加茲的高官^000000也不見了。這一切讓人非常沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
That happens to be all
I know. Does this mean
we have to capture the
smugglers again? I don't
know what's going on...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我知道的就只有這些了。這難道意味著我們要再次抓捕那些走私犯嗎？我不知道發生了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Even if I could make headway
into the investigation, I've
been ordered to stop by upper
management. It looks like
this case is more trouble
than it's worth to them?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
即使我能推進調查，我也被上級命令停止了。看來這個案子對他們來說麻煩大於價值？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I don't want to be involved
in this anymore. I should be
retired already! If you want to
learn more, your only choice
would be to find out on your
own. Fat chance, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我不想再捲入這件事了。我本該已經退休了！如果你想了解更多，你唯一的辦法就是自己去查。希望渺茫，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I've suffered enough
already! Why can't this
case just be done?!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾·哈馬德]
我已經受夠了！為什麼這個案子就不能結束呢？！

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Huh. The magistrate
still seems pretty upset
over the case that happened
at least a few months ago...
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
嗯。法官似乎對幾個月前發生的那個案子還是很生氣...

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Hm? Oh, the magistrate
gave you the brush-off?
Well, he hasn't really been
himself ever since we arrested
those ^32CD32smugglers coming from
the south^000000 a few months ago.
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
嗯？哦，法官把你打發走了？嗯，自從幾個月前我們逮捕了那些^32CD32來自南方的走私犯^000000之後，他就一直不太對勁。

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Once we reported the arrest
to the temple, the pope's
soldiers came and took the
smugglers away. We have no
clue what happened to them
or where they even are now.
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
一旦我們將逮捕情況報告給神殿，教皇計程車兵就來了，把走私犯帶走了。我們完全不知道他們後來怎麼樣了，甚至不知道他們現在在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Himus]
It might not seem like
a big deal to you, but
the magistrate is pretty
meticulous, and he hates
it when people interfere
with his job, you know?
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
對你來說這可能不算什麼大事，但法官做事非常嚴謹，他討厭別人干涉他的工作，你知道嗎？

scripts.text: Who are the smugglers?
scripts.translation: 那些走私犯是誰？

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Well, I don't really know.
Maybe the magistrate would
know if he was able to finish
interrogating the smugglers.
I'm not sure if he did since the smugglers were taken away.
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
嗯，我也不太清楚。
也許法官能知道，如果他能完成對走私犯的審訊的話。
不過我不確定他是否做到了，畢竟走私犯已經被帶走了。

scripts.text:
[Himus]
The magistrate is about
to retire, so I hope he can
finally quit work and just
forget about this whole
business. He does nothing
but stress out about it!
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
法官快要退休了，我希望他終於可以卸下工作，忘掉這整件事。他整天為此煩惱不已！

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Nice day, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
今天天氣不錯，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Man, I feel great! Hah hah!
Hey, gimme one more drink!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
嘿，我感覺棒極了！哈哈！
喂，再給我來一杯！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
So--*Hic* What I was...
Oog, dizzy... I say sayin',
that guy that ^32CD32snuck out to
sea on a boat^000000? You know
*Hic* why he came back
so early? You won't believe it!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
所...所... *打嗝* 我剛才說...
嘔，頭暈... 我是說，那個^32CD32偷偷出海的人^000000？你知道*打嗝*他為什麼這麼早回來嗎？你絕對猜不到！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Hah hah! He--*Hic*
He thought he saw a ^DBDB70ghost^000000!
Bwah hah hah! Oooog... Hey...
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
哈哈！他... *打嗝*
他以為看到了^DBDB70幽靈^000000！
哇哈哈！嘔... 嘿...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right!
Maybe I should check
on ^32CD32Kurdi's father since
he's a fisherman^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯！
也許我應該去看看^32CD32庫爾迪的父親^000000，畢竟他是個漁夫。

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Zzzz...
Umm... Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
呼呼呼...
唔... 呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Why?! Why can't I take
my boat out to sea? I hafta
catch fish to make a living!
What, they expect me to starve
to death or something?! Huh?!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
為什麼？！為什麼我不能出海？我必須捕魚才能謀生！
難道他們想讓我餓死嗎？！哼？！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Hohohoho~
Oh~ Hohohoho~
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
呵呵呵~
噢~ 呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She's kind of strange...

^3355FFThis boat seems to 
be in decent condition.
Who could its owner be?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這艘船看起來狀況還不錯。
它的主人會是誰呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be the boat that
Karyn was talking about.
It seems to be in pretty
good shape. Now, the
monastery should be
southwest from here...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這一定是卡琳說的那艘船。
看起來保養得相當好。那麼，修道院應該在南邊...^000000

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Long time no see,
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好久不見，
{0}。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Larjes!

[Larjes]
I had a tough time following
you, you know? I actually
almost lost you once. You
must be wondering why
I'm here. If you'll listen,
I'll explain everything.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
跟著你真是費了不少勁，你知道嗎？我差點就跟你走散了。你肯定在想我為什麼在這裡。如果你願意聽，我會把一切都解釋清楚。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
According to our investigation, Arunafeltz is definitely involved
in this case. We've been watching you since you're somehow related
to that high ranked official from Arunafeltz. I apologize for that.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
根據我們的調查，阿魯納菲茲肯定與此事有關。因為我們發現你與阿魯納菲茲的一位高官有某種聯絡，所以一直在監視你。對此我深表歉意。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
This is an international
incident, so to prevent any
intel leaks to Arunafeltz,
we've had to be much stricter
with securing and protecting
all information for this case.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
這是一起國際事件，為了防止情報洩露給阿魯納菲茲，我們不得不更加嚴格地保護此案的所有資訊。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Anyway, I've decided to
reveal myself to you since
I'm the only one that can help
you right now. You're thinking
of using that boat, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
總之，既然我是目前唯一能幫你的人，我決定向你表明身份。你正打算用那艘船，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
If you don't have the skills,
knowledge, and preparation
to sail those waters ahead,
you'll probably wreck the
boat. You'll make it if you're lucky but... That's a lot of luck.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
如果你沒有足夠的技術、知識和準備來航行前方的水域，你很可能船毀人亡。如果你運氣好或許能活下來，但...那需要極大的運氣。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I'll help you sail this
boat to get where you're
going. But if you fail, there's
a chance you might have to
sail this boat on your own if I'm not here. So, you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
我會幫你駕駛這艘船到達目的地。但如果你失敗了，而且我不在的話，你可能得自己駕駛這艘船。所以，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，我準備好了。

scripts.text: Give me more time.
scripts.translation: 再給我一點時間。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
Hold on to something:
this will probably be
a pretty rocky ride...
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好，我們出發。
抓緊點：
這趟旅程可能會相當顛簸...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright. Just let me know
whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好的。隨時告訴我，你準備好了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the boat that
can take you to the
monastery.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這艘船可以帶你前往修道院。^000000

scripts.text: Go to Monastery
scripts.translation: 前往修道院

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou set sail for
the monastery...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你揚帆起航，駛向修道院...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to
stay ashore.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定留在岸上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the boat that
can take you to the
monastery.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這艘船可以帶你前往修道院。^000000

scripts.text: Go to Monastery
scripts.translation: 前往修道院

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou set sail for
the monastery...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你揚帆起航，駛向修道院...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to
stay ashore.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定留在岸上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Are you ready to go
aboard? I'll help you
sail to that monastery,
but if you fail while you're
there, I might not be here
when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
你準備好登船了嗎？我會幫你航行到那座修道院，但如果你在那裡失敗了，等你回來時我可能不在。

scripts.text: Yes, I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，我準備好了。

scripts.text: Give me more time.
scripts.translation: 再給我一點時間。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
Hold on to something:
this will probably be
a pretty rocky ride...
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好，我們出發。
抓緊點：
這趟旅程可能會相當顛簸...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright. Just let me know
whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好的。隨時告訴我，你準備好了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe village is totally
silent, as if all life had
abandoned it. You look
around and see that something
was here a few hours ago, but
it's somewhere else now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF村莊一片死寂，彷彿所有生命都已離去。你環顧四周，發現幾個小時前這裡還有某種東西，但現在它已經不在這裡了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever it was,
it definitely wasn't
human. What kind of
creature could it be?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF無論那是什麼，肯定不是人類。那會是什麼生物呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are traces of
humans around here,
along with some kind
of creature that you
can't clearly identify.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡有人類的蹤跡，還有一些你無法明確辨認的生物。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA strange scent strikes
you as you enter this field of
grass. A few ^32CD32animal corpses^3355FF
are strewn around the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF當你進入這片草地時，一股奇怪的氣味撲面而來。地上散落著幾具^32CD32動物屍體^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThere is a dead crow on the ground.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地上有一隻死烏鴉。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe sight of this ^32CD32dead
crow^3355FF makes you feel
uneasy for some reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這隻^32CD32死烏鴉^3355FF的景象讓你感到莫名的不安。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Investigate
scripts.translation: 調查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide not to touch
the animal's carcass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定不碰這具動物屍體。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou notice some grass sap
on the crow's beak, so it
must have been nibbling on
some grass. Some feathers
are missing, revealing
scaly, snake-like skin.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你注意到烏鴉的喙上沾著一些草汁，看來它一直在啃食草葉。有些羽毛脫落了，露出了鱗片狀、類似蛇皮的皮膚。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
Did this grass...?

^3355FFThis grass must be the
main ingredient of the
poison used to kill the
Geoborg family princes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這種草一定是用來毒殺吉奧伯格家族王子的毒藥的主要成分。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like I just hit
the jackpot. Huh?
Someone behi--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來我真是走運了。咦？
身後有人——

scripts.text:
^3355FFA sharp, throbbing pain
assails the back of your
head as you fall into
unconsciousness...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一陣劇烈的刺痛襲來，你感到後腦勺一陣眩暈，隨即失去了意識...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pressure on your
stomach and the blood
rushing to your head tells
you someone is carrying you
over his shoulder. He stops,
and you hear a faint voice.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF腹部的壓迫感和湧向頭部的血液告訴你，有人正把你扛在肩上。他停了下來，你聽到一個微弱的聲音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe faint voice steadily
grows stronger and more
distinct--someone's calling
your name. You feel cold water
trickle through your lips, and
then you regain your senses.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那微弱的聲音逐漸變得清晰——有人在呼喚你的名字。你感到冷水流過嘴唇，隨後恢復了知覺。^000000

scripts.text:
That was too close...
For a second there,
I thought I lost you.
scripts.translation:
太危險了...
剛才那一瞬間，
我差點以為你沒了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Larjes...? What...
What happened?
Ugh, my head...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拉傑斯...？
怎...怎麼回事？
啊，頭好痛...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Try not to move for a while.
I had a bad feeling waiting
for you on the boat. Lucky
thing. When I found you,
these strange creatures
were savagely attacking you!
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
先別動，休息一會兒。
我在船上等你時總覺得不對勁。幸好。當我找到你時，那些奇怪的生物正在瘋狂地攻擊你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You saved me?
Thank you. Do you
happen to know what
those creatures were?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是你救了我？
謝謝你。你知道
那些生物是什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
No clue. They looked
like humans, but... They
definitely weren't. Once
I killed them, they all
turned into sand.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
完全不知道。它們看起來像人類，但...肯定不是。我一殺掉它們，它們就全變成了沙子。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
It seems it's just like the
creatures that kidnapped
you, but... I wonder why
he's not attacking us.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
看來它和那些綁架你的生物很像，但...我想知道為什麼它沒有攻擊我們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess you'll have to go
right up to him and ask.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來你得直接上去
問問它了。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Be careful. That guy
looks pretty dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
小心點。這傢伙
看起來很危險。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe door won't budge:
you can't go through.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF門紋絲不動：
你無法通過。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the hell...!?

[Larjes]
So... This is the
island's true nature.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
原來...這就是
這座島的真面目。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Someone like me won't
survive long in a place
like this. I'm going to wait
for you in the boat. Learn
what you need to learn, and then come back safe, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
像我這樣的人，在這種地方活不了多久。我會在船上等你。查清楚你需要知道的事，然後平安回來，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I don't like this place.
You'd be better be careful
around here with those weird
creatures running around.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
我不喜歡這個地方。
這裡到處都跑著那些奇怪的生物，
你最好小心點。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Good, you're back
I know that there's still
things on this island that
you want to investigate,
but did you want to leave
this place for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
很好，你回來了。
我知道島上還有你想調查的事情，
但你想暫時離開這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alight, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，我們走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but becareful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，但小心點。
那些生物差點就抓住你了，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Did you still want to
investigate the island?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
你還想繼續調查這座島嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，我們走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but be careful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，但小心點。
那些生物差點就抓住你了，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Good, you're back.
I know that there's still
things on this island that
you want to investigate,
but did you want to leave
this place for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
很好，你回來了。
我知道島上還有你想調查的事情，
但你想暫時離開這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，我們走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but becareful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，但小心點。
那些生物差點就抓住你了，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I don't believe it...
That guy was Tristam III?!
This explains a lot, I suppose.
I'll report this along with the
voucher. So Arunafeltz was
behind that poison grass too...
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
難以置信...
那個人是特里斯坦三世？！
這解釋了很多事情，我想。
我會連同憑證一起彙報此事。所以阿魯納菲茲也參與了那些毒草的事...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I'm shocked over this
whole debacle. I'm sure
the Rune-Midgarts royal family
will be in an uproar over this.
To think that we're involved
in something this huge...
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
我對這整件事感到震驚。盧恩·米德加茲的皇室肯定會為此大動干戈。
沒想到我們會捲入如此巨大的事件...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Anyway, we better get
going... This is huge!
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
總之，我們最好快點走...這件事太大了！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Did you still want to
investigate the island?
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
你還想繼續調查這座島嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，我們走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but becareful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉傑斯]
好吧，但小心點。
那些生物差點就抓住你了，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just a bunch
of old, moldy books.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF只是一堆發黴的舊書。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a book stained
with blood amongst all
these old, moldy books.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在這些發黴的舊書中，有一本沾滿了血跡。^000000

scripts.text: Examine Book
scripts.translation: 檢查書籍

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat book was probably
worthless to you anyway.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那本書對你來說大概毫無價值。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are old books
scattered all over here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡到處散落著舊書。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a man lying on
the floor, wearing torn
yet luxurious clothing.
He doesn't seem to be
breathing at all...^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現一名男子躺在地上，
穿著破爛卻華貴的衣服。
他似乎已經停止呼吸了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a man lying on
the floor, wearing torn
yet luxurious clothing.
He doesn't seem to be
breathing at all...^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現一名男子躺在地上，
穿著破爛卻華貴的衣服。
他似乎已經停止呼吸了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou bring your ears more
closely to his mouth: it
seems that he really is
still barely alive.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把耳朵湊近他的嘴邊：
似乎他還有微弱的呼吸。^000000

scripts.text: Touch Him
scripts.translation: 觸碰他

scripts.text: Ignore Him
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This man...
He's so familiar
for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這名男子...
不知為何，
我覺得他很面熟。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you touch him, the
man suddenly jumps
up with a crazed yowl.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你觸碰他時，
那男子突然發出一聲瘋狂的嚎叫，
猛地跳了起來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't feel
comfortable enough
to touch this man.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你還沒有足夠的勇氣
去觸碰這名男子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have no idea why
this dead man is moving
around, so you decided to
examine him. In his jacket,
you find a shining medal...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你完全不明白
為什麼這具屍體還會動，
於是決定檢查他。在他的夾克裡，
你發現了一枚閃閃發光的勳章...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This medal...
This means that
this man is...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這枚勳章...
這意味著
這名男子是...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is a low wall here against the other wall, if I climb it I could reach the resting place of Tristan III...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡有一堵矮牆靠著另一堵牆，如果我爬上去，就能到達特里斯坦三世的安息之地了...

scripts.text: Stay here
scripts.translation: 留在這裡

scripts.text: Climb the wall
scripts.translation: 爬上矮牆

scripts.text:
[Patch]
Input.
scripts.translation:
[帕奇]
輸入。

scripts.text: Now
scripts.translation: 現在

scripts.text: How much?
scripts.translation: 多少錢？

scripts.text: P- How much?
scripts.translation: P- 多少錢？

scripts.text: Others
scripts.translation: 其他

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
So you wanted to talk to me?
I'm pretty tired right now, but
I can spare a moment or two.
What would you like to ask?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
原來你想和我談談？
我現在有點累，
但還能抽出一點時間。
你想問什麼？

scripts.text: Ask About Veins Smugglers
scripts.translation: 詢問關於伯仁斯走私者

scripts.text: Ask About Zhed
scripts.translation: 詢問關於澤德

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Veins smugglers...
Would you explain
exactly what you mean
by Veins smugglers?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
伯仁斯的走私者...
你能具體解釋一下
你所說的“伯仁斯走私者”
是什麼意思嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Oh, them. Yes, I know
a little bit about them.
I'm afraid that I can't really
disclose certain information
about them since they're
a classified case...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
哦，他們啊。是的，我
對他們瞭解一些。
恐怕我無法透露
關於他們的某些資訊，
因為這是一個機密案件...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'm afraid that I cannot give you information about them easily
as they mean a lot to us.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
恐怕我不能輕易給你
關於他們的資訊，
因為他們對我們很重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I was curious
about who they kidnapped.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我很好奇
他們綁架了誰。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Oh, well, I suppose
I can tell you more
about their captive.
But first, I'd like to
ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
哦，好吧，我想
我可以多告訴你一些
關於他們俘虜的事。
但首先，我想
請你幫個忙。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Do Not Refuse
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Niren]
When we realized the
kind of hostage the
smugglers captured, we
didn't know what to do with
him. We've had too many
internal problems to handle...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
當我們意識到走私者綁架的是什麼人時，我們完全不知所措。我們內部的問題已經夠多了...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Still, we felt that we
could use him in our plan,
so we held him in a secret
place whose location is only
known to a few people. But
then... We lost all contact.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
儘管如此，我們還是覺得可以利用他來達成我們的計劃，所以將他關押在一個只有少數人知道地點的秘密場所。但是後來...我們失去了所有聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We sent investigators, but
we still have no idea what
happened. All they found was
a message left by one survivor:
''They're all demons.'' The
hostage is probably dead.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我們派出了調查員，但仍然不知道發生了什麼。他們只發現了一條由一名倖存者留下的資訊：
“他們全是惡魔。”
那個人質大概已經死了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
He may have been a high
ranking official, but we
were too preoccupied
with other matters. In fact,
I haven't gotten the chance
to think of what to do with him...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
他可能是一位高官，但我們當時太忙於其他事務了。事實上，我甚至還沒來得及思考該如何處置他...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I want to ask you to
go to that place, and
figure out what happened
there, and if that high ranking
official from Rune-Midgarts is
still alive. I doubt it, but...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我想請你去那個地方，查明那裡發生了什麼，以及那位來自盧恩·米德加茲的高官是否還活著。雖然我不抱希望，但是...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The investigators we employ
in our temple usually pale
in comparison to you foreign
adventurers, so I have faith
that you can do it. Still,
it'll be quite dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我們在修道院僱傭的調查員通常遠不如你們這些外國冒險者，所以我相信你能做到。不過，那裡會很危險。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
If you can do this, I'll
tell you the location of
that place: we usually call
it the monastery. It used to
be an actual monastery, but we
use it to hold captives now.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
如果你能完成這件事，我會告訴你那個地方的位置：我們通常稱之為修道院。它曾經是一座真正的修道院，但現在我們用它來關押俘虜。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'm sorry, but I can't tell
you anything else about that
old place. It's located to the
southwest of Veins across the
sea. You should be able to find
a boat at South Veins Beach.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
很抱歉，關於那個古老的地方，我無法透露更多。它位於伯仁斯西南方的海上。你應該能在伯仁斯南海灘找到船。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
However... Never mind.
I'd like to help you more,
but I'd be compromising my
position. I'm sorry. Please
come back and tell me if
you learn anything there.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
但是...算了。
我想幫你更多，但這會損害我的地位。很抱歉。
如果你在那裡瞭解到什麼，請回來告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'll send a message to the
magistrate of Veins. If you
talk to him, he'll provide you
with some useful information
for your journey. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我會給伯仁斯的行政官發一封訊息。如果你和他交談，他會為你提供一些有用的旅行資訊。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Going to the monastery
isn't the problem: coming
back here alive will probably
be the real challenge for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
去修道院不是問題：活著回來這裡，可能才是你真正的挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We can't send any troops
there until we understand
what they'd be confronting
there. That's why we need
you to investigate the area.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
在弄清楚那裡有什麼之前，我們無法派遣軍隊。這就是為什麼我們需要你去調查那個區域。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Still investigating the
monastery? Perhaps if
you found any records
left behind by one of
the residents over there...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
還在調查修道院嗎？也許如果你能找到那裡居民留下的記錄...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Still investigating the
monastery? Perhaps if
you found any records
left behind by one of
the residents over there...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
還在調查修道院嗎？也許如果你能找到那裡居民留下的記錄...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
You found this journal
in the monastery? Perfect.
Let me read it, and see
what we can learn...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
你在修道院找到了這本日記？太好了。
讓我讀一讀，看看我們能從中得知什麼...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Hmm, this sounds really
bad. This is tragic, especially
we kept so many important
people over there. I'll request
to dispatch troops there right
away. Something must be done.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
嗯，這聽起來很糟糕。這太悲劇了，尤其是我們在那裡關押了許多重要人物。我會立即申請派遣軍隊過去。必須做點什麼。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
There are too many problems
we have to confront now, but
this monastery issue needs
top priority. We won't be able
to handle it if another threat
comes from that place.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我們現在有太多問題要面對，但修道院的問題需要最高優先順序。如果那個地方再次出現威脅，我們將無法應對。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I suppose that Arunafeltz
and Rune-Midgarts will be too
busy with their own internal
issues to commit to war.
High Priest Zhed will be
glad to know about this.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我想阿魯納菲茲和盧恩·米德加茲會忙於各自的內部問題，無暇參戰。
大祭司 澤德會很高興知道這件事。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm sorry...
I really don't want
to think about Zhed
right now. He's just...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
對不起...
我真的不想現在去想澤德。他只是...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
You wanted to ask me about
Beken--High Priest Zhed?
I can't do anything for him.
He dug his own grave by
allowing you into the
holy ground, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
你想問我關於貝肯——大祭司 澤德的事？
我幫不了他。
他讓你進入聖地，不是自己挖了墳墓嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I thought I warned you
before to stay out of trouble.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我早就警告過你，讓你遠離麻煩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not here to discuss
that. But I happened to
hear that you're the only
person that can help him now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來討論這個的。但我聽說，現在只有你能幫到他。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It's true that Zhed and
I used to work well together,
but we no longer share the
same dream. You'd better find
someone else. Unlike him,
I actually want a war.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
確實，澤德和我過去配合得很好，但我們不再擁有相同的夢想。你最好去找別人。不像他，我其實渴望戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Weren't you guys friends?
Besides, you don't seem as
aggressive as those other
hard liner priests.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們不是朋友嗎？而且，你看起來並不像那些強硬派牧師那樣好戰。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Aggressive? Hmpf. If you
take a good look at those
moderates, you'll see that
they oppose war, but they're
also totally corrupt. In fact, they committed worse atrocities!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
好戰？哼。如果你仔細觀察那些溫和派，你會發現他們雖然反對戰爭，但也極度腐敗。事實上，他們犯下了更可怕的暴行！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
The moderates conducted
inhumane testing on living
creatures, even humans!
And Zhed and I... Could do
nothing but pray to Freya.
Only war can this this chaos!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
溫和派曾對活物，甚至人類進行非人道實驗！而澤德和我...除了向芙蕾雅祈禱，什麼也做不了。只有戰爭才能終結這場混亂！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
We need to start all
over again. I can't help
Zhed. Please leave...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我們需要重新開始。我幫不了澤德。請離開...

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't look like
you can change High
Priestess Niren's mind.
For now, you'd better talk
to High Priest Zhed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看來你無法改變大祭司 尼倫的想法。
目前，你最好去和大祭司 澤德談談。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I already told you
how I feel about Zhed.
We were wrong all along...
This time, war is the answer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我已經告訴過你我對澤德的感覺。
我們一直錯了...
這一次，戰爭才是答案。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I already told you
how I feel about Zhed.
We were wrong all along...
This time, war is the answer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我已經告訴過你我對澤德的感覺。
我們一直錯了...
這一次，戰爭才是答案。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. If you're so sure
of yourself, then you won't
mind reading this letter
from High Priest Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。如果你這麼自信，那你應該不介意讀一下大祭司 澤德的這封信。

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren angrily grabbed the
letter, ripped the envelope
open, and began to read his
message. Her stern face slowly
softened as she slowly scanned
what Zhed had to tell her.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF尼倫憤怒地抓起信，撕開信封，開始閱讀他的留言。隨著她慢慢掃過澤德寫下的內容，她嚴厲的面容逐漸柔和下來。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
That Zhed... He always
did have a way with words.
I suppose the old saying is
true: the pen truly is mightier
than the sword. *Sigh...*
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
那個澤德...他總是很會說話。
我想那句老話是對的：筆確實比劍更有力。*嘆息...*

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
High Priestess
Niren? Are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
大祭司 尼倫？你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Oh, I'm fine,
thank you. I guess
I'm just a little tired.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
哦，我沒事，謝謝。
我想我只是有點累了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
...............................
I have to admit, there's truth
in what Zhed's saying. We
have a duty to protect our
people, the pope, our holy
ground. But I need to think...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
...............................
我必須承認，澤德說得有道理。
我們有責任保護我們的人民、教皇和聖地。但我需要思考一下...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Would you give me some
time to myself? I'll let you
know once I've made a decision.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
能給我一點獨處的時間嗎？
一旦我做出決定，我會通知你。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
High Priestess Niren,
you must be really tired.
You look pale for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
大祭司 尼倫，
你一定很累吧。
不知道為什麼，你看起來臉色很蒼白。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I do feel rather drained.
I don't know why I've been
holding on to this hatred for
so long. I guess I can finally
just cast it to the winds...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我感到有些精疲力竭。
我不知道自己為何
要執著於這份仇恨這麼久。
我想，我終於可以
將其拋諸腦後了...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Adventurer...
What was your name?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
冒險者...
你叫什麼名字來著？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[High Priestess Niren]
Adventurer...
You had the chance to talk
with our pope once, but I doubt
you'll be able to do so again
^3311FFin private^000000. You'll definitely
need our help for that end.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
冒險者...
你曾有機會與我們的教皇交談，
但我懷疑你無法再次
^3311FF私下^000000見到她。
要做到這一點，
你肯定需要我們的幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Does this mean that
you've decided to work
with Zhed again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是意味著你決定
再次與澤德合作嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren quietly nodded
her head, and then
resumed talking.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尼倫輕輕點了點頭，
然後繼續說道。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm still not sure if
I can join him in the long
run. I mean, talking to the
pope might not result in
anything, actually. But
it's still worth a try.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我仍不確定自己
能否長期與他合作。我是說，
與教皇交談可能
實際上不會有任何結果。
但嘗試一下也無妨。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
However, I've never
doubted Zhed's dedication
to Arunafeltz. He deserves
another chance from me.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
然而，我從未懷疑過
澤德對阿魯納菲茲的忠誠。
他值得我再給他一次機會。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Our pope is always surrounded 
by priests and followers sent
by High Priest Vildt. He always
manages to keep his eyes and
ears on her. We need to get
those spies away somehow...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我們的教皇總是被
神官維爾德派來的牧師和信徒包圍。
她總是設法監視著他們。
我們需要想辦法趕走那些間諜...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What can we do
about them, then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我們該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
For now, just approach
the pope as if you just
wanted to leisurely chat.
While you're doing that,
try to gather information
from the priests around her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
目前，只需假裝
只是想隨意聊聊去接近教皇。
在此期間，
試著從她身邊的牧師那裡
收集情報。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure thing. You
can count on me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒問題。你可以
指望我！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ugh, this is giving me
a headache. There's
too much to consider...
Too much at stake here...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
唉，這讓我頭疼。
要考慮的事情太多了...
這裡的利害關係太重了...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Just approach the pope
for a chat, and see what
you can learn from the
other priests around her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
只需去和教皇聊聊天，
看看你能從她身邊的
其他牧師那裡瞭解到什麼。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
How is the pope?
I haven't had the chance
to meet her recently, so...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
教皇最近怎麼樣？
我最近沒機會見她，所以...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, she doesn't seem
very well, just like the
last time I saw her. I didn't
learn anything about all those
priests. Just that they've been
working in the temple non-stop.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，她看起來不太好，
就像我上次見她時一樣。
我沒有從那些牧師那裡
瞭解到什麼。只知道他們
一直在神殿沒日沒夜地工作。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Yes, they've been by her
side twenty-fours a day.
It's been like that for years.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
是的，他們日夜守護在她身邊。
這種情況已經持續多年了。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Oh, High Priestess Niren,
I love working for you, but
sometimes I wish I could leave
just to see my family. Even
just once a year would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
哦，大祭司 尼倫，
我很樂意為您工作，但
有時候我真希望能離開，
去看看我的家人。哪怕一年一次也好。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
...............................
You're absolutely right.
That gives me an idea.

[Sippie]
Huh? What is it?
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
嗯？什麼主意？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
You all need a vacation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
你們都需要休假。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
{0}。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I should reward everyone
in the Sky Garden for their
contribution. However,
they were hired by Vildt,
so I can't directly give them
leave for vacation. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我應該獎勵天空花園裡的每一個人，感謝他們的貢獻。但是，他們是受僱於維爾德的，所以我不能直接給他們放假。嗯...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sippie...
I'll need a pen
and some paper.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
西皮...
我需要一支筆和一些紙張。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Yes, ma'am.
There you go!
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
好的，女士。
給您！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000

[High Priestess Niren]
I administered a blessing
for a child from a native
family, and they were very
grateful since most of the
priests shun the natives.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我為一個原住民家庭的孩子施了天使之賜福，他們非常感激，因為大多數牧師都回避原住民。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It turns out that this
child is gifted at forgery.
She doesn't like being too
close to other people, but
that's beside the point.
Here, take this letter.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
原來這個孩子很有偽造的天賦。她不喜歡與人走得太近，但這不是重點。拿著，把這封信帶走。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah, and take this file that
contains a sample of Vildt's
handwriting. Bring them to
a girl named Ishmael in a
village in North Rachel.
I hope she'll help us...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
啊，還有這份包含維爾德筆跡樣本的檔案。把它們帶到拉赫北部的一個村莊，交給一個叫伊什梅爾的女孩。希望她會幫我們的忙...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Please deliver my letter
and that file to Ishmael in
North Rachel. Hopefully,
she can use her talents
to help us out.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
請把我的信和那份檔案送到拉赫北部的伊什梅爾那裡。希望她能利用她的天賦幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Have you met with Ishmael?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
你見過伊什梅爾了嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou handed Niren the
file forged by Ishmael.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把伊什梅爾偽造的檔案交給了尼倫。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Perfect! This forgery is
so well done, I'm sure
that even Vildt won't be
know if he wrote it or not.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
完美！這份偽造品做得太好了，我確信連維爾德自己都不知道這是他寫的。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0}...
I'm going to use this to
send the priests and followers
on vacation. Then me and Zhed
can talk to the pope without
any unecessary interruptions.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
{0}...
我要用這個讓牧師和信徒們去休假。這樣我和澤德就可以在沒有不必要打擾的情況下與教皇交談了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I really don't want to burden
our pope with what Zhed and I
have to say... But that's much
preferable to doing nothing
and experiencing the downfall
of our beloved Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我真的不想把澤德和我要說的話給教皇添麻煩...但比起什麼都不做，看著我們深愛的阿魯納菲茲走向毀滅，這樣做要好得多。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sippie, please
deliver this vacation
approval to the priests and
followers in the Sky Garden.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
西皮，請把這份休假批准書送到天空花園的牧師和信徒那裡。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Yes, ma'am!
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
好的，女士！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0},
please go back to Zhed,
and let him know everything
is ready. Then I want you to
meet us in the ^3131FFSky Garden^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
{0}，
請回去告訴澤德，一切都準備好了。然後我要你在^3131FF天空花園^000000與我們會面。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
We need to hurry and
do this before High
Priest Vildt realizes
what we are doing.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我們需要抓緊，在大祭司維爾德意識到我們在做什麼之前完成這件事。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou seem to have
misplaced Ishmael's file.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你似乎弄丟了伊什梅爾的檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Please hurry back
to High Priest Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
請趕快回去找大祭司 澤德。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm so proud of our pope!
Did you hear her wonderful
speech? Well, I should say
those are the words of Freya,
but... Well, you know. Hohoho!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我真為我們的教皇感到驕傲！
你聽到她那精彩的演講了嗎？
嗯，應該說那是芙蕾雅的話語，
不過... 你知道的。呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Our priests may have acted
selfishly, but they are still
committed to Arunafeltz's
welfare. Things should
change for the better now.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我們的牧師們雖然有些自私，
但他們仍然致力於阿魯納菲茲的福祉。
現在情況應該會好轉了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm ashamed that I strayed
from the path of peace and
almost endangered my country.
I'm glad Zhed brought me back
my senses. From now on, I'll
repent for my sins with Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我為自己偏離和平之道，
幾乎危及國家而感到羞愧。
很高興澤德讓我恢復了理智。
從現在起，我將與澤德一起贖罪。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I hope the goddess can
forgive me. Ah, and you
should know that Zhed is
waiting for you. Why don't
you go see him now?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
希望女神能原諒我。
啊，對了，你應該知道澤德在等你。
你不妨現在去見見他？

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren softly smiles
at you, and you realize
that it's the first time
that you've seen that
expression on her face.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尼倫對你溫柔地微笑，
你意識到這是你第一次
在她臉上看到這種表情。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Thanks to you and
Bekento, I think I've
finally found my way.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
多虧了你和貝克托，
我想我終於找到了方向。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm sorry...
I really don't want
to think about Zhed
right now. He's just...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
對不起...
我真的不想現在去想澤德。他只是...

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Now I finally have some
time to take a break.
Too many followers are
crowding High Priestess
Niren, and they're giving
me so much work to do!
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
現在我終於有時間休息一下了。
太多信徒圍著大祭司 尼倫，
他們給了我太多工作要做！

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Excuse me, but are you
a friend of our pope?
I think I saw you talk
to her a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
請問，你是我們教皇的朋友嗎？
我剛才好像看到你在和她說話...

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
I don't understand why
High Priestess Niren wants
to go to war. I actually think
that in her heart, she doesn't
want it. She's sweet and kind
once you get to know her.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
我不明白大祭司 尼倫為什麼想發動戰爭。
我其實覺得，在她心裡，她並不想這麼做。
只要你瞭解她，就會發現她既溫柔又善良。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
She loves children...
She's like a mother to
all the kids in Arunafeltz.
She even brought our pope to
Rachel when she was a baby,
raising her like her own child.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
她喜歡孩子們...
她是阿魯納菲茲所有孩子的母親。
她甚至在我們教皇還是嬰兒時，
就把她帶到拉赫，像親生女兒一樣撫養她。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
If you didn't know she
was our pope, it'd be easy
to mistake her for High
Priestess Niren's daughter.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
如果你不知道她是我們的教皇，
很容易把她誤認為是大祭司 尼倫的女兒。

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I never thought the desert
would be this hot! They built
a town here?! How can they call
this place inhabitable! What's
more, the crowds make things
around here so much hotter!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
我從沒想過沙漠會這麼熱！
他們居然在這裡建了一座城鎮？！
怎麼能說這個地方適合居住呢！
而且，人群讓這裡變得更熱了！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I heard that I could make
a killing in Morocc, which is
why I moved my business here.
But it looks like the weather
is going to kill me first!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
我聽說在摩洛哥可以大賺一筆，
所以我把生意搬到了這裡。
但看起來天氣會先把我熱死！

scripts.text: How did you hear of Morocc?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼聽說摩洛哥的？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I... I just told you.
I heard that Morocc is
full customers willing to
buy things at premium prices.
Ugh, but it's a burning hell!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
我... 我剛才不是告訴你了嗎。
我聽說摩洛哥有很多顧客，
願意以高價購買東西。
唉，但這地方簡直是個燃燒的地獄！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I don't even care about making
money anymore! I just want to
be somewhere cool, drinking
a nice, frosty drink! You know,
I might just leave this town
tomorrow. Forget this desert!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
我現在甚至不在乎賺錢了！
我只想去個涼快的地方，
喝杯冰鎮飲料！
你知道嗎，我可能明天就離開這個城鎮。
忘掉這片沙漠吧！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Ah, that's right. Don't they
sell some sweet, heavenly
drink around here? You know,
near the pond in the middle
of Morocc? Before I leave,
I want to taste that drink...
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
啊，對了。這裡附近不賣一種甜美的、
天堂般的飲料嗎？
你知道，在摩洛哥中間的池塘附近？
在我離開之前，我想嚐嚐那種飲料...

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Say, isn't there a wandering
drink merchant near the pond
in the middle of Morocc. Oh,
what I would do to have that
delicious drink he's selling...
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
喂，摩洛哥中間的池塘附近
是不是有個流浪的飲料商人？
哦，我多麼想喝到他賣的那種美味飲料啊...

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, the heat's getting to me...
And I'm running out of sweat
to sweat... I think I'm going
to faint soon! I need a drink!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
熱得受不了了...
汗水都快流乾了...我感覺快要暈倒了！我需要喝點東西！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
*Pant Pant*
*Sweat*
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
*喘氣 喘氣*
*流汗*

scripts.text: Give Fruit Wine
scripts.translation: 給予水果酒

scripts.text: Quietly Watch Him
scripts.translation: 靜靜地看著他

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, thank you! This
smells so heavenly...
Is this that famous drink
that I keep hearing about?
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
哦，謝謝你！
這聞起來太美妙了...
這就是我一直聽說的那種著名飲料嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Ahhh! That hit the spot!
It's so refreshing and so
exotic, like... Like... Those
dancers in Comodo! Ahhhh!
Thank you so much, friend!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
啊哈！太解渴了！
既清爽又獨特，就像...就像...
克魔島的那些舞娘一樣！啊哈！
非常感謝你，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
There must be some
way I can repay you.
Ah, here we go. Take it.
Isn't your name, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
我得想辦法報答你。
啊，就是這個。拿著吧。
你的名字是{0}，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What th--?
How did you know?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什麼？
你怎麼知道我的名字？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe merchant giggled,
note from under his sleeve.
You open the note, and
read its message.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF商人咯咯笑著，
從袖子裡拿出一張紙條。
你開啟紙條，
讀上面的內容。^000000

scripts.text:
^666666{0}.
 
The time for us to act
has come once again.
Please come see me
once you get the chance.
 
 - Bekento^000000
scripts.translation:
^666666{0}。
 
我們行動的時間
再次到來了。
請找機會來見我。
 
 - 貝肯托^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... This means...
You're not really a
merchant, are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...這意味著...
你其實不是商人，對吧？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe merchant quietly
looks at you with a
mischievous grin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF商人靜靜地注視著你，
臉上帶著頑皮的微笑。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you asked me to get
you a drink as an excuse
just to talk to you?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以你讓我給你帶飲料，
只是為了找個藉口跟我說話？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh well, thanks for
bringing me the note.
But I'm not buying you
any more drinks, got it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
算了，謝謝你把紙條帶給我。
但我不會再給你買飲料了，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Heh, understood.
Now why don't you
speak to him now?
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
嘿，明白了。
那你現在去和他對話吧。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Wha-- Do you just
enjoy watching me
slowly sweat to death?
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
什...什麼？
你就喜歡看著我慢慢熱死嗎？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Well, I'm already here.
I guess I may as well go
sightseeing around Morocc.
*Pant Pant* But it's so hot!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
既然我已經在這裡了。
那我也許可以順便在摩洛哥逛逛。
*喘氣 喘氣* 但這裡太熱了！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I never thought the desert
would be this hot! They built
a town here?! How can they call
this place inhabitable! What's
more, the crowds make things
around here so much hotter!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
我從沒想過沙漠會這麼熱！
他們居然在這裡建了一座城鎮？！
怎麼能說這個地方適合居住呢！
而且，人群讓這裡變得更熱了！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
*Pant Pant*
Man, I think I'm going
to die from all this heat!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
*喘氣 喘氣*
天哪，我覺得我要被熱死了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but I heard
that I could buy some
good drinks around here.
Would you happen to be
the one selling them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，我聽說
這裡附近可以買到不錯的飲料。
請問你是賣飲料的那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, you mean my fruit wine?
I'm afraid it's not as good
as people chalk it up to be.
It's just a little something
I brew at home, and share
with my friends after dinner.
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
哦，你說的是我的果酒嗎？
恐怕它並沒有人們吹捧得那麼好。
這只是我在家自釀的一點小酒，
飯後和朋友們分享而已。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I ran into this
merchant that really wants
to have a taste of that wine.
Do you think that you'd be
able to sell me some?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我遇到了一個商人，
他很想嚐嚐那酒。
你覺得你能賣給我一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm
all sold out for today.
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
哦，抱歉，今天的酒已經賣光了。

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
You know, I save a small
bottle of wine for myself
so I'll just give that to you.
I can always brew more, and
I'm flattered that your friend
is so interested in my wine.
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
你知道嗎，我給自己留了一小瓶酒，
我就把那瓶給你吧。
我可以再釀一些，
而且你的朋友對我的酒這麼感興趣，
我感到很榮幸。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? Thank you!
I'm sure that he's really
appreciate your generosity.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的嗎？謝謝你！
我相信他一定會非常感激你的慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, don't mention it.
Well, I should head back
home now. I'll be sure to
keep an extra bottle in case
you want more next time. Take
care, and I'll see you later!
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
哦，別客氣。
好了，我該回家了。
下次如果你還想喝，
我會多留一瓶的。
保重，回頭見！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a bottle
of the famous fruit wine
from the old man. That
guy's pretty nice!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你從老人那裡得到了一瓶
著名的果酒。
那個傢伙人真好！^000000

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I'm sorry, but I'm all
sold out of fruit wine.
I hope that's not too
much of an inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[外來商人]
抱歉，我的果酒已經賣光了。
希望這不會給你帶來太多不便。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
I work really hard to keep
this room clean and cozy so
that the High Priestess can
rest and refresh herself in
comfort. Take a deep breath:
smell that relaxing aroma?
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
我非常努力地保持這個房間
乾淨舒適，
這樣大祭司就能舒適地休息和恢復。
深呼吸：
聞到那股令人放鬆的香氣了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
I work really hard to keep
this room clean and cozy so
that the High Priestess can
rest and refresh herself in
comfort. Take a deep breath:
smell that relaxing aroma?
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
我非常努力地保持這個房間
乾淨舒適，
這樣大祭司就能舒適地休息和恢復。
深呼吸：
聞到那股令人放鬆的香氣了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you're right, that
is a nice smell! So, is
Priestess Niren away
from her office today?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，你說得對，
那味道真不錯！
那麼，尼倫女祭司今天不在辦公室嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
Oh, yes, she's out since
there are many followers
that wish to meet her,
even early in the morning.
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
哦，是的，她出去了，
因為有很多信徒
希望見她，
甚至一大早就這樣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know where
I could find her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道我能在哪裡找到她嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
Hm... Sippie mentioned
something... Ah, right. Sippie
said that High Priestess Niren
decided to go to Cheshrumnir
Garden. That garden is very
large, and quite beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
嗯...西皮提到了什麼...啊，對了。
西皮說大祭司 尼倫
決定去瑟斯隆尼勒花園。
那個花園非常大，
而且相當美麗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The High Priestess
must be very busy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大祭司一定很忙。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
Oh, you can't even imagine!
She's been passing her wisdom
to the people ever since she
was a baby, and crowds of
people still clamor for
her sage teachings.
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
哦，你甚至無法想像！
她從嬰兒時期就開始
向人們傳授智慧，
而現在人群仍然渴望
聆聽她賢者的教誨。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
If you really want
to talk to her, it'd
be best if you catch her
before she's surrounded
by Freya's followers.
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
如果你真的想和她談談，
最好在她被芙蕾雅的信徒
包圍之前找到她。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
High Priestess Niren must
be in Cheshrumnir Garden.
You should try to talk to her
before the crowds show up.
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
大祭司 尼倫一定在瑟斯隆尼勒花園。
你應該在人群到來之前
試著和她談談。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
It's rumored that the
Goddess Freya spoke to
our pope, giving her an
important message. Now
everyone wants to hear
what Freya told her...
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
據說女神芙蕾雅
曾對我們的教皇說過話，
傳達了一個重要的資訊。
現在每個人都想聽聽
芙蕾雅對她說了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
I work really hard to keep
this room clean and cozy so
that the High Priestess can
rest and refresh herself in
comfort. Take a deep breath:
smell that relaxing aroma?
scripts.translation:
[薩皮]
我非常努力地保持這個房間
乾淨舒適，
這樣大祭司就能舒適地休息和恢復。
深呼吸：
聞到那股令人放鬆的香氣了嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I-I don't know you, do I?
Sorry, but would you, um,
just step away? I... I don't
like being too close to
other people. Please!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
我...我不認識你吧？
抱歉，那個，
請退後一點好嗎？我...我不太喜歡
和別人靠得太近。拜託了！

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I-I don't know you, do I?
Sorry, but would you, um,
just step away? Wait, you
don't have something you
need from me, do you?
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
我...我不認識你吧？
抱歉，那個，
請退後一點好嗎？等等，
你該不會有什麼事
需要我幫忙吧？

scripts.text: Give Her Niren's File
scripts.translation: 給她尼倫的檔案

scripts.text: Leave Her Alone
scripts.translation: 別打擾她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know High Priestess
Niren, right? This is from her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你認識大祭司 尼倫，對吧？
這是她給你的。

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Oh, really? Okay, just...
Just toss the file over
to me. I-I don't want
you coming any closer.
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
哦，是嗎？好的，那就...
直接把檔案扔給我吧。我...我不想
讓你靠得更近。

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I'll be glad to help out
the priestess. Even though
we're natives, she's never
discriminated against us.
Hmm... What does she want?
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
我很樂意幫女祭司的忙。
雖然我們是原住民，
但她從未歧視過我們。
嗯...她想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Let's see... She wants
me to forge a copy of this
file? Piece of cake, I'm an
expert at forging writing!
Just give me a moment and--
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
讓我看看...她想要我
偽造一份這份檔案的副本？
小菜一碟，我偽造文書可是專家！
給我一點時間——

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Dang it! I completely forgot!
Someone stole my pen yesterday!
Now how am I gonna do this...?
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
該死！我完全忘了！
昨天有人偷了我的筆！
這下我該怎麼辦...？

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
My pen was made of a very
rare gemstone called ^FF0000Sardonyx^000000.
*Sob* I don't think anyone
sells Sardonyx in Arunafeltz.
You can only get that in the
countries next to us...
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
我的筆是用一種非常稀有的寶石原石製成的，叫^FF0000紅玉髓^000000。
*抽泣* 我覺得阿魯納菲茲
沒人賣紅玉髓。
你只能在我們鄰國找到那種東西...

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I really want to help
High Priestess Niren...
I can't let her down after
she's been so good to us...
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
我真的想幫大祭司 尼倫...
她對我們這麼好，
我不能讓她失望...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou seem to have
misplaced Niren's file...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你似乎弄丟了尼倫的檔案...^000000

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I... I don't see you
backing away. Stay back,
and don't you dare touch me!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
我...我看你並沒有
退後啊。站遠點，
千萬別碰我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you be able to forge
a copy of High Priestess
Niren's file if you had
this gemstone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你有了這塊寶石原石，
你能偽造一份大祭司 尼倫
檔案的副本嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Oh, you found
a Sardonyx for me?
It looks perfect!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
哦，你幫我找到了一塊
紅玉髓？
看起來完美極了！

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Er, but, um...
Would you please
not come any closer?
I still... Uh... I don't mean
to be rude... It's just...
I'm just not good with...
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
呃，那個，嗯...
你能不能
別再靠近了？
我還是...呃...我不是故意
要無禮的...只是...
我不太擅長...

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
If you just toss the
Sardonyx over here,
I'll be able to forge
your copy right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
如果你把紅玉髓
扔到這裡，
我就能馬上
幫你偽造副本。

scripts.text: Don't Give It to Her
scripts.translation: 不給她

scripts.text: Give It to Her
scripts.translation: 給她

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Huh? I thought you
needed my help? I can't
do anything unless you
give me that gemstone.
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
咦？我以為你
需要我的幫助？
除非你把那塊寶石原石給我，
否則我什麼都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Yay, thank you so much!
Now I can get to work~
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
太好了，非常感謝！
現在我可以開始工作了~

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000

^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000

^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000

[Ishmael]
There you go! I made the
best quality copy I could for
you since High Priestess
Niren requested for it.
Would you please send
her my regards? Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
給您！既然大祭司 尼倫有求於我，
我就為您製作了最高品質的副本。
請幫我向她問好，好嗎？嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a file
containing a forged
written approval for
vacation from Ishmael.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您收到了一份檔案，
其中包含伊什梅爾偽造的
休假書面批准。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
If only I only had
my precious pen made
of Sardonyx! Waaaah~!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
要是我有那支用紅玉髓
製成的珍貴鋼筆就好了！哇啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
High Priestess Niren is
such a nice lady. I have to
help her out whenever I get
the chance. Er, do you mind
stepping back a bit? I just...
I don't like being near people!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅爾]
大祭司 尼倫真是位好女士。
只要有機會，我一定要幫她。
呃，你介意稍微退後一點嗎？我只是...
我不喜歡別人靠我太近！

scripts.text:
^3355FFHigh Priest Zhed and High
Priestess Niren have already
arrived, and are carefully
watching the pope's face.
They seem worried about
what will happen...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大祭司 澤德和大祭司 尼倫已經
到達，正小心翼翼地觀察著教皇的臉色。
他們似乎對即將發生的事感到擔憂...^000000

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
How have you been, Your
Eminence? I apologize for
not visiting you sooner, but
I've been too ashamed about
my competency as a high priest.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
您最近好嗎，聖座大人？
抱歉沒能早點來拜訪您，
但作為神官，我因自己的無能而感到羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
High Priest Zhed...
You came... Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
大祭司 澤德...
你來了...謝謝你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pope faintly smiled
at High Priest Zhed, glad
to finally see him again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF教皇對大祭司 澤德露出了
淡淡的微笑，很高興終於再次見到他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Your Eminence...
I hope you understand
that I've tried my best
to only show you what is
beautiful in this world...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
聖座大人...
希望您能理解，
我一直盡力只向您展示
這個世界美麗的一面...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
However, today I must
reveal to you the world's
ugliness as well. I'm sorry...
I gave the Sky Garden people
a vacation today so that we
tell you something in private.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
然而，今天我必須向您
揭示這個世界醜陋的一面。對不起...
今天我給了天空花園的人們放假，
以便我們私下向您說明情況。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren... What is it?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫...是什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
You may want to brace
yourself, Your Eminence,
for what we are about to
tell you. You may very
well be shocked...
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
聖座大人，
請您做好心理準備，
因為我們即將告訴您的事，
可能會讓您非常震驚...

scripts.text:
^3355FFHigh Priest Zhed explained
all of Arunafeltz's secrets
in detail. He revealed the
split between the moderates
and hard liners among the
priests, the corruption...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大祭司 澤德詳細解釋了
阿魯納菲茲的所有秘密。他揭露了
牧師中溫和派與強硬派之間的分裂，
以及腐敗現象...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe also explained the role
of the priests in the inhumane
testing conducted by the
Rekenber Corporation, and
the hard liner priests grab
for power at Thor Volcano.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他還解釋了牧師在雷肯貝爾公司
進行的人體實驗中所扮演的角色，
以及強硬派牧師在火山爭奪權力的行為。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pope stared at
High Priest Zhed in
shock as he spoke.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF教皇震驚地凝視著
正在說話的大祭司 澤德。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
We all understand that
you're already burdened
enough with your duties
as pope, but we feel that
you should take action soon.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
我們都理解，
您作為教皇已經揹負了足夠的重擔，
但我們覺得您應該儘快採取行動。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We don't mean to force
you, Your Eminence, but
we don't have much time.
We're facing the possibility
of war, and we must stop it
in order to save Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
聖座大人，
我們無意強迫您，
但時間不多了。
我們正面臨戰爭的威脅，
為了拯救阿魯納菲茲，
我們必須阻止它。

scripts.text:
[Zhed, Niren]
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[澤德，尼倫]
抱歉，什麼？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren, Zhed...
I'm glad that you all
finally came to me for
a solution to all this.
I'm young, but I remember
what I saw in the holy ground.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫，澤德...
我很高興你們終於
來找我尋求解決這一切的辦法。
雖然我年輕，
但我記得我在聖地看到的一切。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Don't you remember, Niren?
You found me in the holy
ground, and safely led me
out. But while I was there,
I saw ^3131FFYmir's Heart^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
你不記得了嗎，尼倫？
是你在聖地找到了我，
並安全地將我帶了出來。
但就在我在那裡的時候，
我看到了^3131FF伊米爾之心^000000。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
How... How did you know
that was Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
怎...怎麼可能知道
那是伊米爾之心的？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
The priests in the Sky
Garden don't mind talking
freely around me. I guess
they looked at me more as
a child, rather than as pope.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
天空花園的牧師們
在我面前說話很隨意。
我想在他們眼裡，
我更像個孩子，而不是教皇。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'm already aware of the
moderate priest group
conducting their cruel tests,
and of the hard liners building
their military power. However,
I couldn't really do anything.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我已經知道溫和派牧師
正在進行殘酷的實驗，
也知道強硬派正在建立軍事力量。
然而，我什麼也做不了。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Most people don't take my
position seriously because
of my age. Nobody believes
I can change the situation.
I've also heard everything
about what you did, Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
大多數人因為我的年齡
而不重視我的職位。
沒有人相信我能改變現狀。
我也聽說了你做的所有事，澤德。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'm sorry that you were
punished by the other priests
for allowing an outsider to
enter the holy ground, but
I understand your reasons.
Isn't this the adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
很抱歉，你因為允許外人
進入聖地而受到其他牧師的懲罰，
但我理解你的理由。
這位就是那位冒險者吧？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
{0}...
I'm very glad to see you
again. Not only did you
share news of the outside
world with me, but you've
been protecting our peace.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
{0}...
很高興再次見到你。
你不僅與我分享了外界的訊息，
還一直在守護我們的和平。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I really didn't know...
How'd you feel about this,
or how much you actually
knew. I'm truly sorry, Your
Eminence. I'm ashamed
for underestimating you.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我真的不知道...
您對此的感受，
或者您實際上知道多少。
聖座大人，我真的很抱歉。
我很慚愧，竟然低估了您。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Please don't apologize,
Niren. If it weren't for you,
I'd be drawn into the utter
foolishness of the selfish
people in this temple. Niren,
you're like a mother to me.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
請不要道歉，尼倫。
如果不是因為你，
我早就被這座寺廟裡
那些自私之人的愚蠢行徑
拖入深淵了。尼倫，
你對我來說就像母親一樣。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Your Eminence...
Thank you. I feel
the same way...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
聖座大人...
謝謝您。
我也這麼覺得...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Zhed...?
I need you to do
something for me.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
澤德...
我需要你幫我做一件事。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
Of course,
Your Eminence.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
當然，
聖座大人。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Write a report about the
tests conducted by the
moderates in Arunafeltz and
the Schwarzwald Republic,
and their relationship with
that Schwarzwald Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
寫一份報告，
關於溫和派在阿魯納菲茲
和修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國
進行的實驗，
以及他們與修瓦魯茲巴魯德公司的關係。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
I'll get it done immediately,
Your Eminence. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
我立刻去辦，
聖座大人。謝謝您。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Yes, Your Eminence?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
是，聖座大人？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Please collect the
evidence that proves
that the hard liners have
been gearing for war.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
請收集證據，
證明強硬派
正在為戰爭做準備。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Yes, Your Eminence.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
遵命，聖座大人。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'll summon all the High
Priests and Priestesses
soon. I'd like the two of
you to stand by my side.
I won't let anyone disgrace
our holy ground with bloodshed.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我很快就會召集
所有的高階牧師和女祭司。
我希望你們兩人
能站在我身邊。
我不會讓任何人
用鮮血玷汙我們的聖地。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
As you command,
Your Eminence.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
遵命，
聖座大人。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
{0}...
I appreciate all your work
on behalf of Arunafeltz.
My influence may still be
weak, but I'll do my best
with Zhed and Niren's support.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
{0}...
感謝你們為阿魯納菲茲
所做的一切。
我的影響力可能還很微弱，
但我會盡我所能，
在澤德和尼倫的支援下。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I would be expecting
too much to ask you to
stay by my side. But I'd like
to thank you for all you've
done. But if it is Freya's
will, we'll meet again...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
要求你們留在我身邊
可能有些強人所難。但我還是想
感謝你們所做的一切。但如果這是
芙蕾雅女神的旨意，我們還會再見的...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
May Freya bless you...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
願芙蕾雅保佑你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pope prayed in earnest
for you, and you feel a strong
aura of warmth and kindness
permeate your entire being.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF教皇為你虔誠地祈禱，
你感到一股強烈的溫暖和善意
滲透了你的全身。^000000

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You're carrying way too
much stuff right now.
Come back after you put
your stuff in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
你現在帶的東西
實在太多了。
先把東西存到卡普拉倉庫
再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
What th-?! Geez,
you didn't have to
scare me like that!
What is it that you want?
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
什-什麼？！天哪，
你嚇我一大跳！
你想幹什麼？

scripts.text: You look troubled.
scripts.translation: 你看起來很煩惱。

scripts.text: Nothing. Take care!
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。保重！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Oh. That's awfully
thoughtful of you.
I was thinking about
asking you for help,
but you don't look like
you could handle it. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
哦。你真是
太體貼了。
我本來想找你幫忙，
但你看起來好像
應付不來。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Well, I'm actually in
pretty big trouble.
I borrowed some money
from this loan shark
named ^0000FFBelder^000000 in Alberta.
It was a bad move!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
其實，我遇到了
很大的麻煩。
我在艾爾貝塔向一個
叫^0000FF貝爾德^000000的高利貸者
借了錢。
這是個糟糕的決定！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
My business hasn't been
good, but I felt like I didn't
have a choice. I made enough
money to repay him now, but
then I lost my bond of debt.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我的生意一直不好，
但我感覺別無選擇。我現在
有足夠的錢還給他了，
但我弄丟了借據。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
When I asked Belder if
I could pay him back without
that bond, he insisted that
he didn't remember loaning
money to me. I bet he just
wants to keep my collateral!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
當我問貝爾德
能不能不用那張借據
還錢時，他堅持說
他不記得借給我錢了。我敢打賭
他就是想吞掉我的抵押品！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I knew that guy was shady!
Would you help me find my
lost bond of debt? You see,
the collateral I gave him
is really valuable to me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我就知道那傢伙不靠譜！
你能幫我找到
丟失的借據嗎？你看，
我抵押給他的東西
對我來說非常有價值。

scripts.text: Do you know where you lost it?
scripts.translation: 你知道你把它丟在哪裡了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Bye!
scripts.translation: 聽到這個真遺憾。再見！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
If I knew where I lost
it, then it wouldn't be
lost now, would it? Well,
I remember going to a union
meeting, and I had a drink
or two. Okay, I had a lot.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
要是我知道把它丟哪了，
它現在就不會丟了，對吧？
嗯，我記得我去參加了一個
工會會議，喝了兩杯。
好吧，我喝了很多。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
On the way home,
I stumbled in a field
near Comodo... I remember
seeing some water... That
must be where I dropped my
wallet with the bond of debt.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
回家的路上，
我在克魔島附近的一片
田地裡摔倒了... 我記得
看到了一些水... 那應該
就是我掉落錢包和借據的地方。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
If you can find my
wallet, I'll make sure
to repay you. Please
help me if you can!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
如果你能找到我的錢包，
我一定會報答你的。
如果你能幫幫我，請幫幫我！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
H-hey! Where are you
going?! You can't just
leave me here! I need help!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
嘿！你要去哪？！
你不能就這樣丟下我！
我需要幫助！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
What, are you trying to
make me mad on purpose?
I get it. You're working for
Belder! I'm gonna get
my treasure from that
bastard, no matter what!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
什麼，你是故意想惹我生氣嗎？
我明白了。你是給貝爾德
工作的！不管發生什麼，
我都要從那個混蛋手裡
拿回我的寶物！

scripts.text: I don't understand.
scripts.translation: 我不明白。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I was just kidding...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我只是在開玩笑...

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You think you can
fool me?! Get lost!
I'm not telling you
anything, you snake!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
你以為你能騙過我？！
滾開！
我不會告訴你任何事，
你這毒蛇！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
So you're not spying on
me for Belder? Well, then
why are you pestering me?
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
所以你不是在替貝爾德
監視我？那麼，
你為什麼還要糾纏我？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Wait a second...
You're not as strong
as you were earlier.
You'd better train first
so you can be better
prepared to help me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
等一下...
你看起來不像剛才那麼強了。
你最好先訓練一下，
這樣才能更好地幫助我。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Well, I'm actually in
pretty big trouble.
I borrowed some money
from this loan shark
named ^0000FFBelder^000000 in Alberta.
It was a bad move!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
其實，我遇到了
很大的麻煩。
我在艾爾貝塔向一個
叫^0000FF貝爾德^000000的高利貸者
借了錢。
這是個糟糕的決定！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
My business hasn't been
good, but I felt like I didn't
have a choice. I made enough
money to repay him now, but
then I lost my bond of debt.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我的生意一直不好，
但我感覺別無選擇。我現在
有足夠的錢還給他了，
但我弄丟了借據。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
When I asked Belder if
I could pay him back without
that bond, he insisted that
he didn't remember loaning
money to me. I bet he just
wants to keep my collateral!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
當我問貝爾德
能不能不用那張借據
還錢時，他堅持說
他不記得借給我錢了。我敢打賭
他就是想吞掉我的抵押品！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I knew that guy was shady!
Would you help me find my
