lost bond of debt? You see,
the collateral I gave him
is really valuable to me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我就知道那傢伙不靠譜！
你能幫我找到
丟失的借據嗎？你看，
我抵押給他的東西
對我來說非常有價值。

scripts.text: Do you know where you lost it?
scripts.translation: 你知道你把它丟在哪裡了嗎？

scripts.text: What was the collateral?
scripts.translation: 抵押品是什麼？

scripts.text: Bye!
scripts.translation: 再見！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
If I knew where I lost
it, then it wouldn't be
lost now, would it? Well,
I remember going to a union
meeting, and I had a drink
or two. Okay, I had a lot.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
要是我知道把它丟哪了，
它現在就不會丟了，對吧？
嗯，我記得我去參加了一個
工會會議，喝了兩杯。
好吧，我喝了很多。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I took this path in the
Papuchicha Forest to head
back home, and I must have
passed out near a river.
After that, my wallet with the
bond of debt was missing.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我走了普勒斯特森林的
這條路回家，
我一定是昏倒在河邊了。
之後，我裝有借據的錢包
就不見了。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I don't care about the
other stuff in my wallet,
but I really need my bond
of debt to get my collateral
back from that Belder.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我不在乎錢包裡的
其他東西，
但我真的需要我的借據，
才能從那個貝爾德手裡
拿回我的抵押品。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Well, the collateral was
this huge, stunningly
beautiful jewel. It's really
precious to me. But well,
I don't want to tell you
more about it.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
嗯，抵押品是一顆巨大的、
極其美麗的寶石。
它對我來說非常珍貴。
不過，我不想再告訴你
更多了。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I understand if you don't
want to help me after
hearing that, but if you
change your mind, please
come talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
聽到這些後如果你不想
幫我，我理解，
但如果你改變主意，
請再來找我談談。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
H-hey! Where are you
going?! You can't just
leave me here! I need help!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
嘿！你要去哪？！
你不能就這樣丟下我！
我需要幫助！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You didn't leave to
look for my wallet yet?
I think it's somewhere
in the Papuchicha Forest.
Please find the bond of debt
inside as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
你還沒去找我的錢包嗎？
我想它在普勒斯特森林的
某個地方。
請儘快找到裡面的借據。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this wet, tattered
piece of paper the bond
of debt that you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這張溼透、破爛的紙
就是你需要的那張借據嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Yes, that's it!
Ugh, but look at it...
It's ruined! You can't
even read what's written
on it! I need... I need
to fix this somehow!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
是的，就是它！
唉，看看它...
它毀了！你甚至
都讀不出上面寫的字！
我需要... 我需要
想辦法修復它！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you have any ideas?
I mean, if we dried the
paper, the letters would
still be faded, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你有什麼主意嗎？
我是說，如果我們把紙弄乾，
字跡還是會褪色，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I got it! There's this
famous inventor named
^FF0000Dorian^000000 in Izlude. I heard
he just invented something
like a Magic Dryer. Yeah,
that should work perfectly!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我想到了！依斯魯得島上
有位著名的發明家
^FF0000多里安^000000。
我聽說他最近發明了一種
類似“魔法烘乾機”的東西。
沒錯，那應該能完美解決問題！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I don't know exactly
how it works, but it
should be able to restore
my bond of debt. I mean...
It's magic, right? Will you
ask Dorian to help me out?
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
我不太清楚它具體是怎麼工作的，
但它應該能修復我的借據。
我是說...
這是魔法，對吧？
你能請多里安幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Accept His Request
scripts.translation: 接受他的請求

scripts.text: Decline His Request
scripts.translation: 拒絕他的請求

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Thank you so much!
Please talk to Inventor
Dorian in Izlude, and ask
him to restore my bond of
debt. I'll be waiting for
you right here, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
太感謝你了！
請去依斯魯得島找發明家
多里安，讓他修復我的借據。
我會在這裡等你的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Really? I was hoping
that you'd continue to
help me, but... Alright.
I'm sure you've got other
problems. If you change your
mind, though, just come back.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
真的嗎？我還以為
你會繼續幫我的，但是...
好吧。
我相信你肯定有別的事情要忙。
不過如果你改變主意了，
隨時都可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Oh, I knew you'd come
back and help me restore
my bond of debt! You look
too nice to just leave
me hanging like that.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
哦，我就知道你會回來
幫我修復借據的！
你人太好了，不會就這樣
丟下我不管的。

scripts.text: Accept His Request
scripts.translation: 接受他的請求

scripts.text: Decline His Request
scripts.translation: 拒絕他的請求

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Thank you so much!
Please talk to Inventor
Dorian in Izlude, and ask
him to restore my bond of
debt. I'll be waiting for
you right here, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
太感謝你了！
請去依斯魯得島找發明家
多里安，讓他修復我的借據。
我會在這裡等你的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Really? I was hoping
that you'd continue to
help me, but... Alright.
I'm sure you've got other
problems. If you change your
mind, though, just come back.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
真的嗎？我還以為
你會繼續幫我的，但是...
好吧。
我相信你肯定有別的事情要忙。
不過如果你改變主意了，
隨時都可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Would you please visit
^FF0000Inventor Dorian^000000 in Izlude,
and ask him to use his
Magic Dryer to restore
my bond of debt?
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
請去依斯魯得島拜訪
^FF0000發明家多里安^000000，
讓他用他的魔法烘乾機
修復我的借據，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You're back! So how
did it go? I was getting
pretty anxious... So did
Dorian's Magic Dryer work?
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
你回來了！
情況怎麼樣？
我有點擔心... 所以
多里安的魔法烘乾機起作用了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Oh! It worked much better
than I expected! Belder
can't complain now! Haha!
You've done well, my friend.
Here, please take these as
a meager reward for your help.
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
哦！效果比我預期的好多了！
貝爾德現在沒話可說了！哈哈！
你做得很好，我的朋友。
拿著，這是對你幫助的
一點微薄回報。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Now that I have my bond
of debt, I should get my
jewel back from Belder.
He won't have any excuse
to keep my treasure now!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
既然我拿回了借據，
我就應該從貝爾德那裡
拿回我的寶石。
他現在沒借口再扣著我的
寶物了！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
H-hey! Where's my
bond of debt?! Don't
tell me you lost it!
You'd better go back
to Dorian... Hopefully
you left it with him!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
嘿！我的借據呢？！
別告訴我你把它弄丟了！
你最好回去找多里安...
希望你把它留在他那裡了！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Yes! Finally, I'm
free of debt! I've got
my jewel back, business
is doing well... Life sure
is good right now. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
是的！終於，我擺脫了債務！
我拿回了我的寶石，生意
也做得很好... 現在的生活
真不錯。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Listen to me: never
take out a loan if you
can help it. And if you do,
borrow from someone
more reputable than...
Well, you know my story.
*Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[瑪芙]
聽我說：如果可能的話，
千萬不要去借錢。
如果非要借，
就找比... 嗯，你知道我的故事。
*嘆氣*

scripts.text:
[Belder]
I ought to hire some
part-time promotional
workers... Some sexy
ladies ought to bring in
the customers by th--Oh!
Welcome to Belder Loans!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
我應該僱一些兼職的
促銷員... 一些性感的女士
應該能吸引大量顧客，然後——哦！
歡迎光臨貝爾德貸款！

scripts.text: I'll promote your loans!
scripts.translation: 我來推廣你的貸款！

scripts.text: Uh...

[Belder]
You? But you're a dude!
No sweaty, stinky, sleazy
man should be the image
of Belder Loans! We need
to exude trust, dependability,
and... And lady charms.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
你？但你可是個男人！
汗流浹背、臭烘烘、油膩膩的男人
怎麼能成為貝爾德貸款的形象代言人呢！
我們需要展現信任、可靠，
以及... 以及女性的魅力。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
You? Well, don't take
this the wrong way, but
all your curves? Wrong
places, honey. Later!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
你？嗯，別誤會，
但是你的曲線... 長錯地方了，親愛的。
再見！

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Hey, aren't you
interested in a loan?
Better you come to
me than you relying
on some guy that'll
try to rip you off!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
嘿，你對貸款感興趣嗎？
來找我比找那些
想坑你一把的傢伙好多了！

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Welcome! So, do you
need money fast? Belder
Loans get you the money
you need at low interest rates!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
歡迎光臨！需要快速籌錢嗎？
貝爾德貸款能讓您以低利率
獲得所需的資金！

scripts.text: Ask About Muff
scripts.translation: 詢問瑪芙

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Muff? Oh! Is that
supposed to be a name?
I thought you meant--No.
Nope. Doesn't ring a bell.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
瑪芙？噢！
那是個名字嗎？
我還以為你指的是——不。
不是。沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Huh? Collateral?
Now why would I refuse
to take back his money
if I really loaned it to him?
Leave me alone now, this kind
of talk is bad for business!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
哈？抵押品？
如果我確實借給了他錢，
為什麼我會拒絕收回呢？
別煩我了，這種話題
對生意沒好處！

scripts.text:
[Belder]
He really found his bond
of debt? Damn it--I mean,
what a surprise! That's,
uh, real good for him.
Now that I think of it, I did
loan a Muff money once.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
他真的找到了
那張借據？該死——我是說，
真是意外！這，嗯，
對他來說挺好的。
仔細想想，我確實
曾借給一個叫瑪芙的人錢。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
What's with that dirty look?
I've got nothing to hide!
Can't you see that I'm
the victim here? Me!
Just... Scram before you
make me more upset.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
你那是什麼眼神？
我沒什麼可隱瞞的！
難道看不出
我才是受害者嗎？是我！
趕緊...滾開，別
讓我更生氣。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Welcome! Did you need
money fa--Oh. Hey, it's
you again, the do-gooder.
Why don't you do me some
good, and go back where
you came from. Jerk.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
歡迎光臨！需要快——噢。
嘿，又是你，
那個多管閒事的人。
不如行行好，
回到你來的地方去。
混蛋。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Cash flow problems?
Well, I'm your solution!
I offer unsecured loans
at an extremely low interest
rate, twenty-four hours a day!
Belder Loans is Alberta's best!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾德]
資金週轉困難？
我就是你的解決方案！
我提供無抵押貸款，
利率極低，全天候24小時服務！
貝爾德貸款是艾爾貝塔最好的！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like someone
dug a hole in the ground,
and then covered it again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看起來有人
在地上挖了個洞，
然後又填上了。^000000

scripts.text: Dig Up the Spot
scripts.translation: 挖掘這個地方

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There must be something
in the ground. I better
dig it up and check...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
地下肯定有什麼東西。
我最好挖出來看看...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ergh...! Ugh!
This would be a lot
easier with a shovel!
Only a little more to go...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...！唔！
如果有鏟子會容易得多！
再挖一點就好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm? I hit something?
Let's--Yucky! It's so
wet and--Ugh! Nasty
little thing. Now what?
I dropped it! I have to
try to dig it up again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？我碰到什麼東西了？
讓我——好惡心！好溼——唔！
討厭的小東西。現在怎麼辦？
我把它弄掉了！我得
再試著挖出來...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Something isn't quite
kosher about all this.
Nope, this time, I'm
not going to do this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這一切都有些不對勁。
不，這次，
我不打算這麼做了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here we are... It's...
A soggy wallet? This
must be the one Muff
lost. Oh, and the bond
of debt is inside... Mm...
Ugh, it's really soaked...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在這裡...這是...
一個溼透的錢包？這
一定是瑪芙丟的那個。噢，
還有那張借據在裡面...嗯...
唔，真的泡得很溼...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I've done all
I can for now. I should
bring this back to Muff.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我現在能做的
都做了。我應該
把這個還給瑪芙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the same spot
I dug up from before.
It's useless to me now!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是我之前挖過的地方。
現在對我沒用了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh. There's a weird
bump in the ground. Well,
I can't just go looking at
anything that's slightly
out of the ordinary. Heh.
I'm not weird like that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈。地上有個奇怪的
凸起。好吧，
我不能隨便去檢視
任何稍微有點異常的東西。嘿。
我沒那麼奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ugh, just like a member
of the working class:
hoarding all your items
like a packrat? Have the
decency to relocate your
goods to Kafra Storage, please.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
唉，就像
工人階級的一員：
像囤積癖一樣
把所有物品都堆在一起？
請有點體面，
把貨物轉移到卡普拉倉庫吧。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
You must be in awe
of my elegant, artistic
touch. In my hands, almost
anything can become a
work of art... Even you~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你一定在驚歎
我優雅的藝術
觸覺。在我手中，
幾乎任何東西都能變成
藝術品...甚至是你~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I am Inventor Dorian,
and I welcome you to my
workship. All I create is
infused with art's essence~
So... How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我是發明家多里安，
歡迎來到我的工作船。
我所創造的一切，
都蘊含著藝術的精髓~
那麼...有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to use your Magic Dryer.
scripts.translation: 我想使用您的魔法烘乾機。

scripts.text: I want to be your student.
scripts.translation: 我想拜您為師。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Magic Dryer? No, no, no.
That, my friend, is my
Mystic Heater de Elegance.
Don't disgrace my creation
like that. What, pray tell,
do you need to dry?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
魔法烘乾機？不不不。
朋友，那是我的
優雅神秘加熱器。
請不要這樣侮辱我的創作。
請問，您想烘乾什麼？

scripts.text: This Bond of Debt
scripts.translation: 這個債務契約

scripts.text: My Hair
scripts.translation: 我的頭髮

scripts.text: I'm just curious.
scripts.translation: 我只是好奇。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Mm? My masterpiece is far
too sophisticated for such
petty purposes, but... You
intrigue me. Show me this
''bond of debt'' you wish
to restore.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
嗯？我的傑作
太過精密，
不適合這種瑣碎的用途，但是...
您引起了我的興趣。
讓我看看您想修復的
那個“債務契約”。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, now I understand.
This print is beyond
recognition. Only my creation
can restore the life that
nature has taken away! Yes...
You were right to come here.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，我明白了。
這個印記已經
面目全非了。只有我的創作
才能恢復被自然奪走的生命力！是的...
您來這裡是對的。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Allow me to explain how
the Mystic Dryer de Elegance
works. A glamourous ruby
engine whose design was born
of my genius, generates a
powerful magnetic field.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
請允許我解釋一下
優雅神秘加熱器的工作原理。
一顆華麗的紅寶石引擎，
其設計源於我的天才，
能產生強大的磁場。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
The ruby engine's
magnetic field operates
according to the ^FF00003 Centrifuge
Wavelength Theory^000000. Now,
pearl inset sensors detect
the amount of calibration...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
紅寶石引擎的磁場
遵循^FF0000三離心波長理論^000000運作。現在，
珍珠鑲嵌感測器檢測
校準的量...

scripts.text: Zzz...
scripts.translation: 呼嚕...

scripts.text: Oh, please!
scripts.translation: 拜託了！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
You... You fell asleep?
But I was dutifully explaining
the machine's operation!
No, no, I won't hear your
excuses. What's that?
You were listening?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你...你睡著了？
但我可是盡職地
在講解機器的運作原理！
不不，我不聽你的藉口。
什麼？你在聽？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Hm. Well then, let me
ask you this: what is the
main theory by which the
Mystic Heater de Elegance
operates? Hmm? Well?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
嗯。那麼，讓我
問你一個問題：
優雅神秘加熱器
運作的主要理論是什麼？
嗯？怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
That's right. My apologies.
I suppose I misjudged you.
Yes, the magnetic field can
restore the shape and integrity
of damaged, inanimate objects.
However, there is a problem.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
沒錯。抱歉。
看來我誤判了您。
是的，磁場可以
恢復受損無生命物體的
形狀和完整性。
但是，有一個問題。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
The ruby engine is broken,
and I've been too busy with
other projects as ordered by
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
I'll need your assistance
to fix the engine. Alright?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
紅寶石引擎壞了，
而我一直忙於
盧恩·米德加茲王國
指派的其他專案。
我需要您的幫助
來修復引擎。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
If you help me fix the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance,
I'll allow you to use it
as much as you like. First,
I'd like you to gather all
of the repair materials.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
如果您幫我修復
優雅神秘加熱器，
我會允許您
隨意使用它。首先，
我想請您收集
所有的修復材料。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Please procure
^FF000020 Rusty Screws^000000,
^FF000010 Iron Ores^000000,
^FF00005 Steel^000000,
^FF00002 Rubies^000000, and
^FF000010 Red Gemstones^000000.

[Dorian]
Once you bring all the
repair materials, I'll
explain how you can
repair the Mystic
Dryer de Elegance.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
一旦您帶齊所有
修復材料，我
就會向您解釋
如何修復
優雅神秘加熱器。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Oh? You sound dissatisfied
with my explanation. Well...
I surely can't let you use the
machine unless you fathom
how it works. Otherwise,
you just might break it.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
哦？聽起來您對
我的講解不太滿意。好吧...
如果您不明白
它的運作原理，
我當然不能讓您使用
這臺機器。否則，
您可能會把它弄壞。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Were you too bored while
listening to me speak?
Ah! This wound! It's so...
Alas! It's too emotional!
I am seriously hurt!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
您聽我說話時
覺得太無聊了嗎？
啊！這個傷口！真是...
唉！太讓人動情了！
我深受打擊！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
How can you compare my
Mystic Dryer de Elegance
to a simple hair dryer?
Your comment offends me!
I'm no mere engineer...
I'm a true virtuoso!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
您怎麼能把我的
優雅神秘加熱器
和普通的吹風機相提並論？
您的話冒犯了我！
我不只是個普通工程師...
我是真正的藝術家！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Allow me to explain how
the Mystic Dryer de Elegance
works. A glamourous ruby
engine whose design was born
of my genius, generates a
powerful magnetic field.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
請允許我解釋一下
優雅神秘加熱器的工作原理。
一顆華麗的紅寶石引擎，
其設計源於我的天才，
能產生強大的磁場。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
The ruby engine's
magnetic field operates
according to the ^FF00003 Centrifuge
Wavelength Theory^000000. Now,
pearl inset sensors detect
the amount of calibration...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
紅寶石引擎的磁場
遵循^FF0000三離心波長理論^000000運作。現在，
珍珠鑲嵌感測器檢測
校準的量...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I know, I know.
Astounding, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我知道，我知道。
是不是很驚人？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, my apologies.
Too many have asked, so
I now only accept beautiful
female students. Don't be
too disappointed: I know
you can find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，抱歉。
因為詢問的人太多，
我現在只招收
美麗的女學生。別太失望：
我知道您可以
去找別人。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Mademoiselle, it is my
honor to meet you: even
the moon covers its face,
and roses raise their thorns,
shameful of themselves
and jealous of your beauty.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
小姐，很榮幸
見到您：連月亮
都遮住了臉，
玫瑰也豎起了刺，
為您美麗的容貌
感到羞愧和嫉妒。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah! But why go under the
pretense of being my student
when we can leisurely spend
time together as lovers?
Won't you--Mademoiselle?
Wait, where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊！但為什麼
要假裝是我的學生，
而不是作為戀人
悠閒地共度時光呢？
您不會——小姐？
等等，您要去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I don't have enough
time for trivel, so
please leave me to my
artistic endeavors and
bother me no longer.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我沒有時間
閒聊，所以
請讓我專心於
藝術創作，
不要再打擾我了。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ugh, your behavior
from before disgusts me...
But those pitiful eyes...
Seeking sympathy. Ah,
you're only human.
I shall forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
唉，您之前的
行為讓我很反感...
但那雙可憐的眼睛...
在尋求同情。啊，
您只是個人類。
我原諒您了。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Alright then. Please
listen carefully this time,
and don't insult my pride
again. When you are ready,
please come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
好吧。請
這次仔細聽好，
不要再冒犯我的自尊。
當您準備好了，
請再來找我對話。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, did you bring all
the materials I need to
repair the Mystic Dryer
de Elegance? Let me take
a glance at what you brought...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，您帶齊了
我修復優雅神秘加熱器
所需的材料嗎？讓我
看看您帶了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, well done. Now
that the materials are
ready, I can instruct you on
how to repair the machine.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，做得好。現在
材料都準備好了，
我可以指導您
如何修復這臺機器。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I expect you to fail
a few times, but the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance
is designed for durability:
even if you tried, you'd
have trouble scratching it.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我預計您會
失敗幾次，但
優雅神秘加熱器
的設計非常耐用：
即使您想，
也很難在它上面留下劃痕。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
First, insert a new rough
ruby into the ruby engine,
and tighten the screw on
the joint until you hear
a ^0000FFclick^000000. You'll break it
if you tighten it further.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
首先，將一顆新的
紅寶石原石插入紅寶石引擎，
並擰緊關節處的螺絲，
直到聽到
^0000FF咔噠^000000聲。如果繼續擰緊，
您會把它弄壞的。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Next you'll need to
operate the four switches
coded by the colors red,
blue, yellow, and green.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
接下來您需要
操作四個分別用
紅、藍、黃、綠
顏色編碼的開關。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Press the ^0000FFRed^000000 switch
if the engine is in 1st
Gear. Press the ^0000FFBlue^000000
switch in 2nd Gear,
^0000FFYellow^000000 for 3rd, and
^0000FFGreen^000000 for 4th.

[Dorian]
The engine's sound is the
only indicator of which
gear is running. You'll
have to figure that out
on your own. I'm sorry
I designed it that way...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
引擎的聲音是
判斷當前檔位
的唯一指標。您
得自己弄清楚。抱歉
我把它設計成這樣...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, one last tip!
If you enter the correct
engine gear, the machine
will start without a problem,
even if you press the same
switch more than once.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，最後一個小提示！
如果您輸入了正確的
引擎檔位，即使
多次按同一個開關，
機器也能正常啟動。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Please let me know
if you get it started so
I can verify if the Mystic
Dryer de Elegance is fully
operational. Good luck now~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
如果您成功啟動了它，
請告訴我，這樣我就能
驗證“優雅神秘乾燥機”
是否完全正常執行。
祝您好運~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Oh? You're still missing
some materials. Well, we're
in no rush. If you already
forgot, then let me remind
you what you need to bring...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
哦？您還缺少一些材料。
沒關係，我們不著急。
如果您已經忘記了，
那就讓我提醒您一下
您需要帶什麼...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Please procure
^FF000020 Rusty Screws^000000,
^FF000010 Iron Ores^000000,
^FF00005 Steel^000000,
^FF00002 Rubies^000000, and
^FF000010 Red Gemstones^000000.

[Dorian]
Did you already forget
my instructions for fixing my
Mystic Dryer de Elegance?
I can't blame you since
they're a bit complicated.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
您已經忘記我關於
修理“優雅神秘乾燥機”
的說明了嗎？
考慮到步驟有點複雜，
我不怪您。

scripts.text: Instructions
scripts.translation: 檢視說明

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Really? It's no problem
for me to explain it again
to you. Don't be shy now:
not all of us can be geniuses~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
真的嗎？沒問題，
我可以再向您解釋一遍。
別害羞：
畢竟不是每個人都是天才~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, so you failed to
fix the Mystic Dryer de
Elegance? That's expected:
I didn't really design it for the common user in mind. Well,
why don't you try it again?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，所以您沒能
修好“優雅神秘乾燥機”？
這是意料之中的：
我設計它時並沒有
考慮到普通使用者。那麼，
您不妨再試一次？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, I underestimated you.
You really repaired the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance~
This is a testament to my
incredible teaching prowess.
Congratulations are in order!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，我低估您了。
您真的修好了
“優雅神秘乾燥機”~
這證明了我
驚人的教學能力。
恭喜您！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Now all you have to do
is insert the damaged
document and press the
switch. Simple, yes?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
現在您只需要
插入損壞的檔案
並按下開關。
很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Well, I'm afraid my
usefulness to you has
been all used up. Ah,
but I'll make sure to
contact you if I need
your kind of help. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
嗯，恐怕我對您的
用處已經用完了。啊，
但如果我需要
您這樣的幫助，我會
聯絡您的。再見~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, hello! How have
you been? Are you in need
of my artistic inventions?
Or did you just miss me?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，你好！
最近怎麼樣？您需要
我的藝術發明嗎？
還是說您只是
想我了？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Wh-what are you doing?
D-don't sully my wonderful
masterpieces with your
uncultured hands!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你...你在做什麼？
別...別用你那
粗俗的手玷汙
我精美的傑作！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Can't you see that the
machine won't work without
the materials? Even a simple
child should understand that!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
難道您看不出
沒有材料機器
就無法工作嗎？
連小孩子都應該明白！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ugh, just like a member
of the working class:
hoarding all your items
like a packrat? Have the
decency to relocate your
goods to Kafra Storage, please.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
唉，就像
工人階級的一員：
像囤積癖一樣
把所有物品都堆在一起？
請有點體面，
把貨物轉移到卡普拉倉庫吧。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be Dorian's
Mystic Dryer de Elegance.
What do you want to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這一定是多里安的
“優雅神秘乾燥機”。
您想做什麼？^000000

scripts.text: Check the Machine
scripts.translation: 檢查機器

scripts.text: Replace the Engine
scripts.translation: 更換引擎

scripts.text: Tighten the Screw
scripts.translation: 擰緊螺絲

scripts.text: Press a Switch
scripts.translation: 按下開關

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's no power
in this behemoth
of a machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這臺龐然大物
沒有通電。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou replace the rough
ruby in the ruby engine
with a new rough ruby.
It clicks into place
inside the engine core.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您用一顆新的紅寶石原石
替換了紅寶石引擎中的
紅寶石原石。
它咔噠一音效卡入
引擎核心。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe ruby in the
engine has already
been replaced.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF引擎中的紅寶石
已經被替換過了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou probably need
to replace the ruby
in the engine first.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您可能需要先
替換引擎中的紅寶石。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000
^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000

^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000
^0000FF*Click*^000000

^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000
^3355FF*KrrICK-ICK-ICK-KOOM*^000000

^3355FFYou tightened the
screw too tightly!
The joint is broken...
You should go back
to Dorian for help.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您把螺絲擰得太緊了！
連線處壞了...
您應該去找多里安幫忙。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomething must have
gone wrong. You'd be
better off starting
from the beginning...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一定出了什麼問題。
您最好從頭開始...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou need to replace
the engine's ruby and
tighten the main screw
before you mess with
these switches.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在您擺弄這些開關之前，
您需要先替換引擎的紅寶石
並擰緊主螺絲。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou need to tighten
the scren before you can
start the engine safely.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您需要先擰緊螺絲，
才能安全地啟動引擎。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Mystic Dryer de
Elegance started with
a mighty buzz, and the
sound lowers to a calm
hum as it stabilizes.
It looks like you fixed it!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF神秘乾燥器“優雅”
發出巨大的嗡嗡聲啟動，
隨著穩定下來，
聲音逐漸降低為平穩的嗡嗡聲。
看起來您修好了它！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should tell Dorian
first so that you can
use this machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您應該先告訴多里安，
這樣您才能使用這臺機器。^000000

scripts.text:

^3355FF*Buzz Buzz*^000000
^3355FFThe machine is

Which switch do
you want to press?^000000

^3355FF*嗡嗡 嗡嗡*^000000

^3355FF*Whiz Whiz*^000000

before coming to a sudden
stop. That was the wrong
switch. You'd better ask Dorian...

然後突然停止。那是錯誤的開關。
您最好問問多里安...

vibrations have
grown stronger.

chose the right switch.^000000
scripts.translation:

變強了。

^3355FF*噗噗 噗噗*
*噗噗 噗噗*
機器的震動現在相當強烈了。

您最好問問多里安...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
It sounds like you're
done fixing my Mystic
Dryer de Elegance.
Why don't you come
back so I can explain
how you can use it?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
聽起來你已經修好了
我的“優雅神秘烘乾機”。
不如回來吧，
我可以向你解釋
如何使用它。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou lift the main
operational switch,
turning on a light and
opening a convenient
slot. You insert the
wet bond of debt.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你抬起主操作開關，
指示燈亮起，
一個便捷的插槽打開了。
你插入了溼漉漉的債務契約。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe engine's pistons
and cylinders churn
with a lively din, and
when the heater stops,
the slot reopens.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF引擎的活塞和氣缸
發出活潑的轟鳴聲，
當加熱器停止時，
插槽再次開啟。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So this is the original
bond of debt that Muff
lost? It looks... Perfect!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是瑪芙丟失的
原始債務契約嗎？
看起來...完美！

scripts.text:
You already used this
machine to restore the
bond of debt. There's no
need to mess around
with it any longer.
scripts.translation:
你已經使用這臺機器
恢復了債務契約。
不需要再折騰它了。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Who are you?
Don't you dare lay
a hand on my precious
masterpiece inventions!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你是誰？
別碰我珍貴的
傑作發明！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
You're carrying too much
stuff with you. Dump it
in Kafra Storge, sell it,
drop it, whatever, before
you come talk to me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你身上帶的東西太多了。
在來找我之前，
把它們存進卡普拉倉庫，
賣掉，扔掉，隨便怎樣，
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Have you heard of the
Four Cursed Jewels?
I hear that one of them,
the Diamond of Destruction,
just appeared recently.
What I'd do to find it...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你聽說過四顆詛咒寶石嗎？
我聽說其中一顆，
毀滅之鑽，
最近剛剛出現。
我多希望能找到它...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
{0}, right?
Don't be too suprised.
I've heard of you here
and there. Heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
{0}，對吧？
別太驚訝。
我在這裡聽說過你。
嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: What'd you hear?
scripts.translation: 你聽到了什麼？

scripts.text: Bye!
scripts.translation: 再見！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I wanted to ask you about
the Four Cursed Jewels.
All the merchants in the
area are talking about them.
Anyway, I was able to obtain
the Diamond of Destruction!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我想問問你關於
四顆詛咒寶石的事。
這一帶的商人們
都在談論它們。
總之，我獲得了
毀滅之鑽！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^666666Hmm... He might
be talking about that
jewel Muff gave to Belder
as collateral for his debt.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^666666嗯...他可能在說
瑪芙抵押給貝爾德的
那顆寶石。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I paid a hefty sum for it,
but then I lost it after
just a few days. I kept it
under high security, but
that didn't stop the thief...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我花了大價錢買下它，
但幾天後就丟了。
我把它放在高度安保的地方，
但這沒能阻止那個盜賊...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
It's a risky job, but
I want to employ you to
find where my diamond went.
It'd be best if you could get
it back, but I can understand
if you can't. You up for it?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
這是一份危險的工作，
我想僱你去找
我的鑽石去了哪裡。
最好能把它找回來，
但如果找不到我也能理解。
你願意嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 當然，我會幫你。

scripts.text: No, sorry.
scripts.translation: 不，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Great! I knew it was
a good idea to find you.
The thief didn't leave any
clues, but he should have
some problems selling the gem.
It's one of a kind, you know.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
太好了！我就知道找你準沒錯。
那個盜賊沒留下什麼線索，
但他想賣掉那顆寶石應該會很難。
那可是獨一無二的珍品啊。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Visiting the large
jewelry shops in the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
would be a good start.
Their merchants know the
most about those jewels.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
去盧恩·米德加茲王國的大型珠寶店看看是個好主意。
那裡的商人對寶石最瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
The thief will also have
to sell the jewel to a jeweler
that can afford astronomical
prices. There are three big
locations you should check.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
那個盜賊還得找一家出得起天價的珠寶商才行。
你應該去查查這三個地方。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Find ^0000FFJhonnita^000000 in Alberta,
^0000FFKimeunbang^000000 in Payon, and
^0000FFLeblo^000000 in Geffen. They wanted 
that diamond badly too, so
they'll remember if they
heard any clues about it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
去艾爾貝塔找^0000FF瓊妮塔^000000，
斐揚找^0000FF金恩邦^000000，
吉芬找^0000FF勒布羅^000000。他們也想要那顆鑽石，
所以如果聽到關於它的線索，
他們肯定記得。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Please don't let them
know I've hired you to
investigate that diamond.
They won't speak to you
if they figure out that
I've sent you to them.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
請不要讓他們知道是我僱你
去調查那顆鑽石的。
如果他們發現是我派你來的，
就不會跟你對話了。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Well, I'll be right
here. I hope you come
back with some good news.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嗯，我就在這裡等著。
希望你能帶回好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Really? I went through
a lot of trouble to find
you, but... I understand.
If you have a change of
heart, I'll be willing to
hire you for your expertise.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
真的嗎？我費了好大勁才找到你，
不過...我理解。
如果你改變主意了，
我很樂意因為你的專長而僱傭你。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
So it's true...
People say you're
just a Novice, but
you still help them
out with their problems.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
原來是真的...
人們都說你只是個初心者，
但你還是幫他們解決了麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I've got a few buddies
in the Swordman Association.
They dropped your name when
I mentioned I was looking
for someone smart and strong.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我在劍士協會有幾個朋友。
當我提到我在找一個既聰明又強壯的人時，
他們提到了你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Heh, so you really
are one of those holy
knights. I'm glad to
have met you for myself.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嘿，看來你真的是那種神聖的騎士。
很高興能親自見到你。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I didn't think a member
of the clergy would be so
strong, but you know, your
reputation precedes you.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我沒想到神職人員會這麼強，
不過你知道的，你的名聲早已傳開了。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Hey, if I didn't know
your name, how could I call
myself a Merchant? You set
an example for us all~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嘿，如果我不知道你的名字，
我怎麼能自稱是商人呢？你為我們所有人樹立了榜樣~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
We have a mutual friend,
you know that? Aragham
really spoke highly of you.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我們有個共同的朋友，你知道嗎？
阿拉甘對你的評價非常高。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I know a guy who knows
a guy in the Alchemist Guild.
Around their parts, it sounds
like you're pretty hot stuff.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我認識一個認識鍊金術士公會的人。
在他們那邊，聽說你相當厲害。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Magic is totally beyond
my understanding, but
if it gets the job done,
it can't be all bad.
I hear you're really
good at that stuff.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
魔法完全超出了我的理解範圍，
但如果它能解決問題，
那也不全是壞事。
聽說你在這方面真的很擅長。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Heh, it sounds like almost
anyone who's anyone in
Morocc knows who you are.
Pleasure to make your
acquaintance~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嘿，聽起來摩洛克幾乎每個有名有姓的人
都知道你是誰。
很高興認識你~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Anyone who's used
a bow seems to drop
your name when it comes
to accuracy and heroism.
Hard to believe that I'm
actually talking to you~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
任何用過弓的人，
在談到精準和英勇時都會提到你的名字。
很難相信我真的在和你說話~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Is it really true?
I hear you sing
like an angel...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
是真的嗎？
聽說你唱歌像天使一樣...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Is it really true?
I hear you dance
like the devil...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
是真的嗎？
聽說你跳舞像魔鬼一樣...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Me and your old master,
Phoenix, we go way back.
He had nothing but pride
when he talked about you~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我和你以前的師父，
鳳凰，我們淵源頗深。
他談到你時總是充滿自豪~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I heard your name from
this spiritual message
I got from a dream. That
doesn't sound crazy to
you, does it?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我從一個夢中的靈驗資訊裡聽到了你的名字。
這聽起來不瘋狂吧？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Aren't you the least
bit curious how I know
about you? Wait, come back!
I'm not really that suspicious!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你難道一點都不好奇我是怎麼知道你的嗎？
等等，回來！
我沒那麼可疑！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Find ^0000FFJhonnita^000000 in Alberta,
^0000FFKimeunbang^000000 in Payon, and
^0000FFLeblo^000000 in Geffen. They wanted 
that diamond badly too, so
they'll remember if they
heard any clues about it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
去艾爾貝塔找^0000FF瓊妮塔^000000，
斐揚找^0000FF金恩邦^000000，
吉芬找^0000FF勒布羅^000000。他們也想要那顆鑽石，
所以如果聽到關於它的線索，
他們肯定記得。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Please don't let them
know I've hired you to
investigate that diamond.
They won't speak to you
if they figure out that
I've sent you to them.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
請不要讓他們知道是我僱你
去調查那顆鑽石的。
如果他們發現是我派你來的，
就不會跟你對話了。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Are you still investigating
the diamond's whereabouts?
Well, I hope you can bring
me back good news soon.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你還在調查鑽石的下落嗎？
希望你能儘快帶給我好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh, you're back.
Made any headway in
your investigation of the
Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦，你回來了。
調查“毀滅之鑽”有什麼進展嗎？

scripts.text: Explain What You Learned
scripts.translation: 解釋你瞭解到的情況

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
What?! The Z Gang stole
my diamond? No wonder!
I bet they wanted to use its
curse for something evil.
How about the jewel?
Did you retrieve it?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
什麼？！Z集團偷了我的鑽石？
難怪了！
我敢打賭他們想利用它的詛咒做壞事。
寶石呢？
你拿回來了嗎？

scripts.text: Give Diamond of Destruction
scripts.translation: 交出毀滅之鑽

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh! Great! So it was
in the Z Gang's hideout?
Wow, even after hearing so
much about you, you still
exceeded my expectations!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦！太好了！
原來是在Z集團的秘密基地？
哇，即使聽過那麼多關於你的傳聞，
你依然超出了我的預期！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Thank God, I finally
have this back! Ah, and
as for your payment...
Well, I don't know if
it's enough for what you
did, but I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
謝天謝地，我終於把它拿回來了！
啊，至於報酬...
我不知道這是否配得上你做的事，
但希望你能喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Now that I have the
Diamond of Destruction
again, I can research
more about its strange
properties. I'll contact you
again if I need your help.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
既然我重新擁有了“毀滅之鑽”，
我可以進一步研究它奇特的屬性。
如果需要你的幫助，我會再聯絡你。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I hear from a friend
in Morocc that you happened
to obtain the Unlucky Emerald.
I'm sure it's one of the Four
Cursed Jewels. You wouldn't
mind if I look at it, do you?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我聽說你在摩洛克偶然獲得了“異樣的綠寶石”。
我確信它是四顆詛咒寶石之一。
你不介意我看看它，對吧？

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
No? Well, I'm sure you
have your reasons. Still,
maybe I can learn something
that would benefit both of
us if I examined it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
不？好吧，我相信你有你的理由。
不過，如果我研究一下，
也許能學到一些對雙方都有益的東西。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I appreciate it!
Now, let's see here...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，謝謝！
那麼，讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Yes, judging from its
characteristic shape, this
is the cursed emerald.
Like me, you now possess
one of the Four Cursed Jewels.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
是的，從它獨特的形狀來看，
這就是那顆被詛咒的綠寶石。
像我一樣，你現在也擁有了一顆四顆詛咒寶石之一。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Hm? Did you happen to
misplace your emerald?
I mean, it's not with you...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嗯？你難道把綠寶石弄丟了？
我是說，它不在你身上...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Tell me, what were
you planning to do with
the Unlucky Emerald?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
告訴我，
你打算怎麼處理那顆“異樣的綠寶石”？

scripts.text: I'm going to sell it.
scripts.translation: 我打算賣掉它

scripts.text: I'm going to study it.
scripts.translation: 我打算研究它

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh, you weren't going
to keep it? I wish I could
afford to buy it from you...
But I've had enough trouble
buying the Diamond of
Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦，你不打算留著它？
我真希望能買得起它...
但我買“毀滅之鑽”已經花了不少錢。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
You already met several
renown jewelers while
you were looking for the
dimaond. Why don't you ask
them if they'll buy that
Unlucky Emerald from you?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你在尋找鑽石的時候，
已經見過幾位著名的珠寶商了。
為什麼不問問他們願不願意從你這裡買下那顆“異樣的綠寶石”呢？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I applaud your
thirst for knowledge,
your quest to seek truth.
If you really want an expert
to look at the emerald, talk
to this scholar in Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我讚賞你對知識的渴望，
以及你追求真理的決心。
如果你真的想請專家鑑定那顆綠寶石，
去克魔島找那位學者談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
This man is an antique
appraiser, an specialist in
ancient artifacts and treasure.
I highly recommend consulting
him since he's been invaluable
in my own jewel research.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
這位先生是古董鑑定師，
專門研究古代文物和珍寶。
我強烈推薦你諮詢他，
因為他在我的寶石研究中幫了大忙。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I heard that you obtained
the Unlucky Emerald from
a friend in Morocc. Let me
warn you that you might not
be strong enough to handle
its power. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我聽說你從摩洛哥的朋友那裡
得到了“異樣的綠寶石”。
我要提醒你，你可能還不足以
駕馭它的力量。小心一點。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
If you're not wary,
its curse might destroy
you. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
如果你不警惕，
它的詛咒可能會毀滅你。
明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Thank you for all
you've done for me. I'll
continue my research in the
cursed jewel's powers, and
I'll contact you if I need your
help again. Take care~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
感謝你所做的一切。
我會繼續研究這顆被詛咒寶石的力量，
如果還需要你的幫助，我會聯絡你的。
保重~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I don't have the funds
to buy your emerald at
a fair price, but why don't
you ask the other jewelers?
They might be interested
in buying your jewel.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我沒有足夠的資金
以合理的價格買下你的綠寶石，
但你可以問問其他珠寶商。
他們可能會對購買你的寶石感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, you're back~
So were you able to
sell the Unlucky Emerald?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，你回來了~
那麼，你賣掉“異樣的綠寶石”了嗎？

scripts.text: Everyone seems scared!
scripts.translation: 大家都好害怕！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I see now. They
must be too afraid of
that particular jewel's
curse. Huh. Weird.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我明白了。
他們一定是太害怕那顆寶石的詛咒了。
嗯。真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I guess the Diamond of
Destruction is considered
pretty safe since it's been
around for a while without
any strange incidents.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我想“毀滅之鑽”應該算是比較安全的，
因為它已經存在一段時間了，
而且沒有發生過任何奇怪的事件。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
You just dug up the
emerald? I suppose it
might be too soon to sell it.
Not too many people will
test their luck with that gem,
now that I think about it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你剛挖出這顆綠寶石？
我想現在賣掉可能還為時過早。
仔細想想，
現在沒多少人願意拿自己的運氣去賭那顆寶石。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, here's an idea.
Why don't you ask my
scholar friend in Comodo
to examine it? Maybe you
can learn more about the
emerald's so-called curse.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我有個主意。
為什麼不請我在克魔島的學者朋友
來鑑定一下呢？
也許你能瞭解更多關於
那顆綠寶石所謂詛咒的事情。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I'll go ahead and send
him a message ahead of
time so that he'll know to
expect your arrival, okay?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我會先給他發個訊息，
讓他知道你要來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Why don't you visit my
scholar friend in Comodo,
and ask him to examine your
Unlucky Emerald? The more
you learn about that so-called
curse, the better. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
為什麼不去拜訪我在克魔島的學者朋友，
請他鑑定一下你的“異樣的綠寶石”呢？
你越瞭解那個所謂的詛咒，對你越有利。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh, so what have you
learned about the Unlucky
Emerald so far? Hmmm. Yes,
very intriguing. Good luck
with your research efforts~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦，那你目前對“異樣的綠寶石”
瞭解了多少呢？嗯嗯。
是的，非常引人入勝。
祝你的研究工作順利~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Have you heard of
the Four Cursed Jewels?
I wish to retrieve my
Diamond of Destruction,
but whoever has it has
kept it well hidden...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你聽說過“四顆被詛咒的寶石”嗎？
我想找回我的“毀滅之鑽”，
但持有它的人把它藏得很嚴實...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Psst, adventurer!
You're {0}, right?
There's something
I'd like to discuss
with you in private!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
噓，冒險者！
你是{0}，對吧？
我有件事想私下和你談談！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Oh, it's always nice
to see a new face~
So were you interested
in selling or buying
a jewel? We only carry
the best. Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
哦，總是很高興見到新面孔~
那麼，你是想賣還是想買寶石？
我們這裡只有最好的。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: What's the most popular jewel?
scripts.translation: 最流行的寶石是什麼？

scripts.text: Do you know Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation: 你知道“毀滅之鑽”嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Ah, take a look at this
lustrous ruby. Isn't it
just breathtaking? It can
be yours for the specially
discounted price of just
1,000,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
啊，看看這顆光彩奪目的紅寶石。
是不是美得令人窒息？
現在特價只要1,000,000 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Wait, where are you--?
Damn, I shouldn't have
marked it up so much.
Rookie mistake, rookie
mistake! I'm a professional!
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
等等，你要去哪——？
該死，我不該把價格標得這麼高。
新手失誤，新手失誤！我可是專業人士！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Diamond of Destruction?
Heh heh! A rookie like you
wouldn't appreciate its true
value. I wanted it so badly,
but that Ibrahim was much
luckier that I was...
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
毀滅之鑽？
嘿嘿！像你這樣的新手，
根本不懂它真正的價值。
我本來非常想要它，
但那個易卜拉欣運氣比我好多了...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
It makes me so upset to
think about how I lost to
him. All the big jewelers
are trying to snatch up
the Four Cursed Jewels...
But only one showed up so far.
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
一想到輸給他，我就很生氣。
所有大珠寶商都在爭搶
四顆被詛咒的寶石...
但到目前為止只出現了一顆。

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Hey. You look familiar.
You're not one of my
regulars, are you?
No, couldn't be.
You're not dressed
richly enough. No offense.
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
嘿。你看起來很面熟。
你不是我的常客吧？
不，不可能。
你穿得不夠華麗。別介意啊。

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
So you here to sell
any Garlets, or did you
come to spend your life
savings on my jewels?
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
所以你是來賣加勒結晶，
還是想把畢生積蓄
花在我的寶石上？

scripts.text: Show me some jewels...
scripts.translation: 給我看看寶石...

scripts.text: I have a rare emerald to sell...
scripts.translation: 我有一顆稀有祖母綠要賣...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
It couldn't hurt to
show you my wares, but...
I doubt you can afford them.
Jewels aren't cheap, you know?
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
給你看看我的貨也無妨，但是...
我懷疑你買不起。
寶石可不便宜，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Oh, I get it now. You want
to give one as a present to
some woman. Isn't that typical?
Can't you come up with a more
creative way to buy some
woman's love? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
哦，我明白了。你想買一個
送給某個女人當禮物。真典型。
你就不能想點更有創意的
方式去討好女人嗎？哼？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Sorry, sweetheart, but
I have a strict ''no window
shopping'' policy.
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
抱歉，親愛的，
但我有嚴格的“禁止只看不買”政策。

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Rare emerald, eh?
It better not be something
like a Garlet or a Zargon!
Sometimes you guys make
that kind of mistake.
Okay, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
稀有祖母綠，是嗎？
希望它不是加勒結晶或剎勒空結晶！
你們有時候會犯這種錯誤。
好吧，讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
......
Umm...

[Jhonnita]
...........................Um.
It's an incredibly nice
emerald, but I can't take
this off your hands. Er,
would you be on your way?
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
...........................嗯。
這是一顆非常漂亮的祖母綠，
但我不能從你手裡收下它。呃，
你可以走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? But why?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？但為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
J-just get out of my
shop! Go... Go to Payon
and talk to Kimeunbang!
Y-yeah, and don't come back!
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
快...快離開我的店！
去...去斐揚找金恩邦！
對，別再回來了！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
What'd I tell you, huh?
I don't want you here
in my shop anymore!
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
我剛才怎麼說的？
我不希望你再出現在我的店裡！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Look, I'll level with you.
Rumors spread fast amongst
us jewelers. Nobody will get
near you if they know you
have that jewel. You get it
now? Please... Stay back...
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
聽著，我跟你說實話。
訊息在珠寶商之間傳得很快。
如果別人知道你有那顆寶石，
沒人敢靠近你。你懂了嗎？
拜託...離遠點...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
I don't want anything
to do with your weird
emerald or with you.
Aren't you leaving
already? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
我不想跟你的奇怪祖母綠
或者跟你有任何關係。
你還不走嗎？快滾！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Are you here to buy or
sell any jewels? I always
buy high and sell low.
Come to me for all of
your gem related needs~
scripts.translation:
[瓊妮塔]
你是來買還是賣寶石？
我向來高買低賣。
所有寶石相關的需求都來找我~

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Zzzz... Huh?
Why'd you wake me?
Such a good dream too.
Go to another jewelry shop,
I don't feel like opening up.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
呼嚕嚕...啊？
你把我吵醒了？
我剛才正做著美夢呢。
去別家珠寶店吧，
我現在不想開門。

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text: Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation: 毀滅之鑽？

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I'm just disappointed.
I was so close to getting
that Diamond of Destruction.
So close! Belder, my business
partner, actually snatched
it up from some poor sap.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
真是令人失望。
我本來都快拿到那顆毀滅之鑽了。
就差一點！貝爾德，我的生意夥伴，竟然從某個倒霉蛋手裡把它搶走了。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Somehow, Belder ended up
returning the jewel. I was
going to buy the jewel from
the original owner, but then
this upstart jeweler got to
it before I could. Damn it!
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
不知怎的，貝爾德最後又把寶石還了回去。我本來打算從原主人手裡買下它，結果被那個不知天高地厚的珠寶商搶先一步。真是可惡！

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
This was a monumental
failure. I haven't been
able to sleep, I don't want
to work. Ugh. Well, thanks
for letting me get that off
my chest. I feel a bit better.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
這是一次巨大的失敗。我睡不著覺，也不想工作。唉。不過，謝謝你聽我發牢騷。我現在感覺好多了。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Here, take this as
a little gift. Not all of us
jewelers are as greedy
as you think we are. Heh.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
拿著，這是給你的小禮物。並不是我們所有珠寶商都像你想的那樣貪婪。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Oh! That diamond is the
very reason for my agony!
I was so close to getting it...
But then someone got to the
diamond before I did. Argh!
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
哦！那顆鑽石正是讓我痛苦的原因！
我本來都快拿到它了...
結果有人比我先一步得到了它。啊！

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I don't feel like opening
my shop any time soon, but
you can always come back later.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
我最近都不打算開門營業了，
不過你以後隨時可以再來。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Oh, hello. Looks like
I'm back in business~
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
哦，你好。看來我又重新開張了~

scripts.text: I have a jewel to sell.
scripts.translation: 我有寶石要賣

scripts.text: How are you?
scripts.translation: 你好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Really? Alright, just
give me a minute to
appraise your gem.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
真的嗎？好的，請稍等，
讓我鑑定一下你的寶石。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I'm sorry, but I just
can't buy this emerald.
It's... It's too big of
a risk. The rumors I keep
hearing, they're just horrible.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
抱歉，但我不能買這顆祖母綠。
這...這風險太大了。我聽到的那些傳聞，簡直太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Hm? Where's this
jewel you were talking
about? Did you forget
to bring it with you?
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
嗯？你剛才說的那顆寶石在哪裡？
你忘記帶在身上了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I don't even feel like
talking about my business.
I've been considering closing
up shop for good, actually.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
我甚至都不想談生意了。
實際上，我一直在考慮徹底關店。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
No jeweler around will
buy that cursed emerald.
I'm really sorry. You can
try talking to Ibrahim, though.
He's the one that got that
Diamond of Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
周圍的珠寶商沒人敢買那顆被詛咒的祖母綠。
真的很抱歉。不過你可以去找易卜拉欣。
就是他拿到了那顆毀滅之鑽。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Ugh... The stress
of the jewel business
is finally getting to me.
Oh well, I've had a good run...
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
唉...珠寶生意的壓力終於讓我吃不消了。
算了，我也算盡力了...

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I don't feel like opening
my shop any time soon, but
you can always come back later.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
我最近都不打算開門營業了，
不過你以後隨時可以再來。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, I've heard about
you. You're the one that's
been asking questions about
the Diamond of Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
哦，我聽說過你。你就是那個一直在打聽毀滅之鑽的人。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Don't be so suprised:
word travels fast in the
jewel industry. Well, if you
want to learn more, you'll
have to do something for
me first. We have a deal?
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
別這麼驚訝：訊息在珠寶行業傳得很快。好吧，如果你想了解更多，得先幫我做點事。我們成交嗎？

scripts.text: Deal.
scripts.translation: 成交。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I've been suffering back
pain lately, and none of
the medicines do any good.
I resorted to seeing this
famous doctor in Payon, but
then I totally screwed it up.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
我最近一直背痛，
吃了不少藥都沒用。
我只好去找斐揚那位名醫，
結果卻把事情搞砸了。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
She was such a nag, and
I said something... unpleasant
to her. Now she refuses to
examine me! But if I sent
you, then you could get
some medicine for me.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
她是個愛嘮叨的人，
我說了些...不禮貌的話。
現在她拒絕給我看病！
但如果你去的話，
應該能幫我拿到藥。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
She knows my symptoms
so if you make her happy,
she'll give you my medicine...
I hope. Anyway, her name is
^0000FFWola^000000, and she's in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
她知道我的症狀，
只要你讓她高興，
她就會把藥給你...
我想吧。總之，她叫
^0000FF沃拉^000000，在斐揚。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, yeah? Well, that's
fine with me. I don't
have anything to lose.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
哦，是嗎？
那對我來說正合適。
反正我也沒什麼可失去的。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Please look for a female
doctor named ^0000FFWola^000000 in Payon.
Do what you can to get my
medicine from her... Oh,
and try to be nice~
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
請去斐揚找一位名叫
^0000FF沃拉^000000的女醫生。
儘量幫我從她那裡拿到藥...
哦，還有，態度好點~

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh? Is that... Is that my
medicine? Thank goodness!
 Hm? Oh, so I misunderstood
 her. I thought she was awfully
 arrogant, but she was just
 concerned for my health.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
哦？那是...那是我的藥？
謝天謝地！
嗯？哦，原來是我誤會她了。
我以為她很傲慢，
其實她只是關心我的健康。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I better make it a point
to properly apologize to
her the next time I see her.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
下次見到她，
我一定要好好向她道歉。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Right, I need to tell
you about the Diamond of
Destruction. Listen carefully.
A while ago, a young couple
tried to sell me that very
jewel. Suspicious, eh?
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
對了，我得告訴你
關於毀滅之鑽的事。
仔細聽好。
不久前，一對年輕情侶
試圖把那枚寶石賣給我。
很可疑，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I had no interest in
buying it, so I actually
offered them a much lower
price than they hoped.
Now that I think about it...
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
我對買它沒興趣，
所以我出的價比他們期望的
低得多。
現在回想起來...

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
That man and woman looked
like the members of that
infamous Z Gang. Heh!
I should have reported it,
but... You know. Back
pain and all that.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
那對男女看起來像是
那個臭名昭著的Z幫的成員。
嘿！
我本該舉報他們的，
但是...你知道的。
背痛什麼的。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I hear the Rogue Guild
is secretly investigating
the Z Gang, so that couple
must have plenty of enemies.
So... Yeah. The Z Gang has
the Diamond of Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
聽說流氓公會
正在秘密調查Z幫，
所以那對情侶肯定有很多敵人。
所以...是的。Z幫擁有
毀滅之鑽。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
You should talk with one
of the investigators of the
Rogue Guild if you want to
learn more about the Z Gang.
Pretty useful info, huh?
Take care, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
如果你想了解更多關於Z幫的事，
應該去和流氓公會的
調查員談談。
很有用的資訊，對吧？
保重，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
You should talk with one
of the investigators of the
Rogue Guild if you want to
learn more about the Z Gang.
Pretty useful info, huh?
Take care, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
如果你想了解更多關於Z幫的事，
應該去和流氓公會的
調查員談談。
很有用的資訊，對吧？
保重，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Hm? I'm sorry, but
I'm pretty busy with
all my other customers.
Besides, you don't strike
me as a jewel seller or
buyer. Please excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
嗯？抱歉，
我忙著接待其他顧客。
而且，你看起來不像
是賣珠寶或買珠寶的人。
請原諒我...

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, hey. Did you
have any business
with me today?
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
哦，嘿。你今天
有什麼事找我嗎？

scripts.text: I have a jewel to sell.
scripts.translation: 我有寶石要賣

scripts.text: No, not really.
scripts.translation: 不，不是。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, yeah? Well then,
I'm curious now. You
mind if I take a look?
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
哦，是嗎？那太好了，
我現在很好奇。
介意我看一眼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Now, what do we ha--
Oh. I'm sorry, but I just
can't buy this. I hate to
break it to you, but I hear
that thing has an awful curse.
See what you can do about that!
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
那麼，我們看看這是什--
哦。抱歉，但我就是
不能買這個。真不想告訴你，
但我聽說這東西有可怕的詛咒。
你自己想辦法吧！

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Hmm. The jewel
you were just
talking about...
Did you remember
to bring it with you?
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
嗯。你剛才提到的
那枚寶石...
你記得帶它來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, yeah? Well, that's
fine too. No skin off
my nose, that's what
I always say.
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
哦，是嗎？那也好。
對我沒什麼損失，
我一直是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh. I'm sorry, but I just
can't buy this. I hate to
break it to you, but I hear
that thing has an awful curse.
See what you can do about that!
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
哦。抱歉，但我就是
不能買這個。真不想告訴你，
但我聽說這東西有可怕的詛咒。
你自己想辦法吧！

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I'm sorry that you're
the one that currently
has that jewel. Hopefully,
the curse is just a rumor...
But, well, I didn't get this
old by taking chances...
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
真抱歉，現在持有那枚寶石的人是你。
希望那個詛咒只是謠言...
不過，我活了這麼久，可不是靠冒險活下來的...

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Hello, are you interested
in buying or selling any
precious jewels?
scripts.translation:
[勒布羅]
你好，你想買或賣什麼寶石嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? I'm here to
see Doctor Wola.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好？我來找沃拉醫生。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oh... Ah... Um...

[{0}]
Excuse me, but do you
know where I can find her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，你知道我在哪裡能找到她嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
I, um...
Oh no! Wah!
See what you did?!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
我，嗯...
哎呀！哇！
你看你乾的好事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I... I don't know
what you're talking
about. I'm just wanted
to talk to Doctor Wola.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...我不知道你在說什麼。
我只是想見沃拉醫生。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
I'm Doctor Wola!
And look! You made me
drop the herbal medicine
I was brewing! The pot
is all broken now...
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
我就是沃拉醫生！
你看！你讓我把正在熬製的漢方藥材灑出來了！
鍋全碎了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Oh, I'm...
I'm really sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？哦，我...
真的很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
That's... That's
quite alright. It's
my fault, really.
Waaah~! My pot!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
那...那沒關係。
其實是我的錯。
哇啊~！我的鍋！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, I don't know
what's going on exactly.
Was that pot expensive?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我不太清楚發生了什麼。
那個鍋很貴嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oh, I'm acting stupid
again! I don't have time
to cry over a broken pot!
I need to check my hands
for any cuts! If they're
hurt, I can't help anyone!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
哎呀，我又犯傻了！
我沒時間為一個碎鍋哭泣！
我得檢查一下手有沒有被割傷！
如果受傷了，我就沒法幫別人了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's, uh, that
sounds pretty serious.
So how are your hands?
They don't hurt, do they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這，嗯，聽起來挺嚴重的。
那你的手怎麼樣？
不疼吧？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oooh, never mind that!
They're fine, thank goodness.
What's important now is that
you help me fix my herbal
medicine pot. You're partly
responsible, you know.
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
噢，別管那個了！
還好沒事。
現在重要的是，
你要幫我修好這個熬藥鍋。
你也得負一部分責任，知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay. Just tell
me what I should do.
Hold on, I came here to
ask you if you'd give me
some medicine. You see--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。告訴我該怎麼做。
等等，我來這裡是想
問問你能不能給我一些藥。
你看--

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Perfect! All the more
reason you should help
me fix this pot! I can't
make any medicine without
this pot now, can I? Let's
see... I'll need glue, glue...
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
太好了！
那你更應該幫我修好這個鍋了！
沒有這個鍋，我現在沒法熬藥，對吧？
讓我想想...我需要膠水，膠水...

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Hurry and get
^0000FF20 Fine Sands^000000,
^0000FF5 Empty Bottles^000000,
^0000FF10 Brigans^000000, and
^0000FF10 Soft Blades of Grass^000000.
There's no time to waste!

[{0}]
You... You got it.

[Wola]
Good, you're back.
So you brought everything
I need to glue my pot
back together again?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
很好，你回來了。
所以你帶齊了
我修鍋需要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Great. Give them here.
I should grind this, mix
that... Wait, was that right?
What were these for again?
Argh, I'm acting stupid again!
You mind not watching me?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
太好了。給我吧。
我應該磨這個，混合那個...
等等，是這樣嗎？
這些是做什麼用的來著？
哎呀，我又犯傻了！
你能別看著我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Just... Just sit in
that corner, don't say
anything, and wait till
I say I'm done, okay?!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
就...就坐在那個角落，
什麼都別說話，
等我做完再說，好嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
There. It's finally
fixed. Oh wait, did you
say something about needing
some medicine? I completely
forgot about that for a while.
What did you say exactly?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
好了。終於修好了。
哦等等，你剛才說需要
什麼藥來著？我剛才完全
忘了那回事。
你具體說了什麼？

scripts.text: Will you go out with me?
scripts.translation: 你願意和我約會嗎？

scripts.text: Leblo's back medicine?
scripts.translation: 勒布羅的傷藥？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
^666666*Blush*^000000 But it's too
early for us to just go
on a date. I'm sorry, it's...
I have someone in mind.
Still, I'm flattered that
you think of me that way.
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
^666666*臉紅*^000000 但我們現在
還太早，不能就這樣
去約會。對不起，我...
我心裡有別人了。
不過，你能這樣想，
我很榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Wow, I can't believe
I'm turning you down--
a little surprised,
actually. But yes.
I have someone I like.
And it's not really you. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
哇，我居然要拒絕你——
其實有點驚訝。但是是的。
我有喜歡的人了。
而且那個人不是你。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Leblo... Oh, that
man in Geffen? Finally...
He has the sense to send
someone to get his meds.
I already prepared it.
Where did I put it now?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
勒布羅... 哦，是吉芬的
那個男人？終於...
他總算有常識，派人來
取他的藥了。
我已經準備好了。
我把它放哪兒了來著？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
I want to double check
his medicine first so
please tell him that I'll
have it delivered to him
shortly. In a while, maybe?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
我想再仔細檢查一下
他的藥，所以請告訴他，
我很快就會送過去。
過一會兒，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, you're not mad or
anything? I gathered that
you didn't like him much...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你生氣了嗎？
我感覺你好像不太喜歡他...

scripts.text:
[Wola]
What are saying?
I'm a doctor: we're duty
bound to heal everyone we can!
That's not to say that some
patients suffer longer and
more painful treatment...
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
你在說什麼？
我是醫生：我們有義務
救治每一個能救的人！
這並不意味著有些病人
要承受更久、更痛苦的
治療...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^666666She hates him!
But I guess Leblo's life
should be okay in her hands.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^666666她討厭他！
但我想勒布羅的命
在她手裡應該沒問題。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Alright, just let Leblo
know that I'm taking care
of him, that his life should
be okay in my hands. I need
to get back to work: please
take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
好了，告訴勒布羅，
我正在照顧他，他的命
在我手裡應該沒問題。
我得回去工作了：
請照顧好自己！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Hurry and get
^0000FF20 Fine Sands^000000,
^0000FF5 Empty Bottles^000000,
^0000FF10 Brigans^000000, and
^0000FF10 Soft Blades of Grass^000000.
There's no time to waste!

[{0}]
You... You got it.

[Wola]
Sorry, I completely
missed what you said
earlier. Something about
needing medicine from me?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
抱歉，我完全沒聽清
你剛才說的話。是關於
需要從我這裡拿藥嗎？

scripts.text: Will you go out with me?
scripts.translation: 你願意和我約會嗎？

scripts.text: Leblo's back medicine?
scripts.translation: 勒布羅的傷藥？

Alright, just let Leblo

take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
好了，告訴勒布羅，
我正在照顧他，他的命
在我手裡應該沒問題。
我得回去工作了：
請照顧好自己！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Food has a dramatic
effect on your body:
treat it like a drug, and
watch what you eat. Oh,
and do your research!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
食物對身體有巨大的
影響：把它當作藥物，
注意你吃的東西。哦，
還有，多做研究！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
You know, your lifestyle
and habits determine
your health in the future.
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
你知道嗎，你的生活方式
和習慣決定了你未來的
健康。請照顧好自己！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oh, how can this be
happening? What 
should I do?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
哦，怎麼會發生這種事？
我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, remember me?
It's been a long time
so I can't blame you:
I was there when you
first joined our guild!
So what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
哦，還記得我嗎？
好久不見了，
不記得也情有可原：
你剛加入公會時，
我就在那裡！
那麼，這次來找我什麼事？

scripts.text: Ask About the Z Gang
scripts.translation: 詢問關於Z幫的事

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Ah, Z Gang, you said?
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
啊，你說的是Z幫？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, yeah, we're investigating
those guys. We actually found
their hideout, but then they
escaped before we could even
catch them. Wily bastards...
I think they were tipped off!
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
哦，對，我們正在調查那幫傢伙。
我們其實找到了他們的據點，
但還沒來得及抓人，
他們就逃了。真是一群狡猾的傢伙...
我覺得他們肯定是收到風聲了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
A few of our Rogue agents
are investigating the hideout,
but I doubt they can find
anything useful there.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
我們幾名流氓特工正在調查那個據點，
但我懷疑那裡能有什麼有用的線索。

scripts.text: Where's the hideout?
scripts.translation: 據點在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Well, it's a large
warehouse over in Comodo.
You're free to scope out
the place if you really want.
But chances are slim that
you'll find anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
嗯，那是克魔島上的一個大倉庫。
如果你真的想去，
可以隨意去探探路。
不過，你在那裡找到東西的可能性很小。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Hey, how's it going?
You ever consider joining
the Rogues? It'd be a lot
of fun. You're welcome to
look around, so feel free
to ask me any questions.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
嘿，最近怎麼樣？
有沒有考慮過加入流氓？
會很開心的。
歡迎四處看看，
有什麼想問的儘管問我。

scripts.text: Ask About the Z Gang
scripts.translation: 詢問關於Z幫的事

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, yeah, we're investigating
those guys. We actually found
their hideout, but then they
escaped before we could even
catch them. Wily bastards...
I think they were tipped off!
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
哦，對，我們正在調查那幫傢伙。
我們其實找到了他們的據點，
但還沒來得及抓人，
他們就逃了。真是一群狡猾的傢伙...
我覺得他們肯定是收到風聲了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
A few of our Rogue agents
are investigating the hideout,
but I doubt they can find
anything useful there.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
我們幾名流氓特工正在調查那個據點，
但我懷疑那裡能有什麼有用的線索。

scripts.text: Where's the hideout?
scripts.translation: 據點在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Well, I'm not sure if
I can just tell you that
kind of information. I mean,
you're not a member of our
guild... Yet. What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
嗯，我不確定我能不能
直接告訴你那種資訊。我是說，
你還不是我們公會的成員...
至少目前還不是。我能為你做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
I got it. I'll just tell my
boss that you bribed me
with 10,000 zeny. Not too
much, is it? We Rogues are
pretty bad... But not that bad.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
明白了。我就跟老闆說
你用10,000 Zeny賄賂了我。
不多吧？我們流氓雖然有點壞...
但也沒那麼壞。

scripts.text: Sounds good!
scripts.translation: 聽起來不錯！

scripts.text: Never mind, I'll find it myself...
scripts.translation: 算了，我自己去找...

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Thanks for the money~
Of course, if you became
a Rogue, this amount is
nothing compared to what
you can gank. ^666666*Ahem*^000000
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
謝謝你的錢~
當然，如果你成為流氓，
這點錢跟你強奪來的比起來
根本不算什麼。^666666*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
The Z Gang's old hideout
is a large warehouse over
in Comodo. I doubt you'll
find anything there, but
you can go check it out.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
Z幫以前的據點
是克魔島上的一個大倉庫。
我懷疑那裡能有什麼東西，
但你可以去檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Aw, what am I gonna
do if my boss askes to
see the money? We've got
to make this bribe authentic!
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
哎呀，如果老闆要檢查這筆錢，
我該怎麼辦？我們得讓這筆賄賂看起來真實一點！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Be my guest, maybe it'll be
a good learning experience.
But yeah, come back when
you think about changing
your job, okay? Be a Rogue~
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
請便吧，也許這會是個不錯的學習經歷。
不過，等你考慮轉職的時候，
記得回來哦，好嗎？做個流氓~

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Whoa, what are you doin'
here? I've got no beef with
you, but some Rogues, see,
some Rogues, have got a 
lot of beef. Uh, what'd you
want? Not a fight, I hope.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
哇，你在這裡幹什麼？
我跟你沒什麼過節，但是有些流氓，
嗯，有些流氓，
可是很有脾氣的。呃，
你想幹什麼？希望不是想打架。

scripts.text: Ask About the Z Gang
scripts.translation: 詢問關於Z幫的事

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Those guys have been
bothering everyone!
Yeah, I guess you can
say we're united on this.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
那幫傢伙一直在騷擾大家！
是的，我想我們可以說
在這件事上我們是一致的。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, yeah, we're investigating
those guys. We actually found
their hideout, but then they
escaped before we could even
catch them. Wily bastards...
I think they were tipped off!
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
哦，對，我們正在調查那幫傢伙。
我們其實找到了他們的據點，
但還沒來得及抓人，
他們就逃了。真是一群狡猾的傢伙...
我覺得他們肯定是收到風聲了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
A few of our Rogue agents
are investigating the hideout,
but I doubt they can find
anything useful there.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
我們幾名流氓特工正在調查那個據點，
但我懷疑那裡能有什麼有用的線索。

scripts.text: Where's the hideout?
scripts.translation: 據點在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Uh, I can't just give
you that information
if you're not a member
of our guild. But since
we're together on this,
I'll just ask for 10,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
呃，如果你不是我們公會的成員，
我不能隨便給你那種資訊。但既然
我們在同一陣線，
我就只要10,000 Zeny吧。

scripts.text: Sounds good!
scripts.translation: 聽起來不錯！

scripts.text: Forget it...
scripts.translation: 算了...

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Right on, right on.
Alright, I didn't charge
you much since the hideout
is a large warehouse in
Comodo where I doubt you'll
find anything. But who knows?
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
很好，很好。
好吧，我沒收你太多錢，因為據點
是克魔島上的一個大倉庫，
我懷疑你能找到什麼。但誰知道呢？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Hey, this isn't enough
money. I thought people
in your job made more
zeny than this everyday!
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
嘿，這點錢不夠啊。
我以為像你這種職業的人
平時賺的Zeny比這多得多呢！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Alright, but I think
you'll need a little
extra help finding that
place. I mean, Rogues are
hiding experts, and even
we had some trouble!
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
好吧，但我覺得
你可能需要一點額外的幫助
才能找到那個地方。
我是說，流氓是隱匿專家，
連我們都費了點勁呢！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Geez, I'm so sleepy...
Everyone's out on a mission,
and I'm stuck here on guard
duty. When can I see some
action again? Ugh! Rogues
hate standing in one place!
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
天哪，我好睏...
大家都出任務去了，
我卻只能在這裡站崗。
什麼時候才能再有點動作啊？
唉！流氓最討厭站在一個地方不動了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Hey, pal. You part
of the guild? Nice.
If they sent you to help
out, well, there's nothing
to do here. This place is
pretty much cleaned out.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
嘿，夥計。
你是公會的成員嗎？不錯。
如果是他們派你來幫忙的，
那這裡沒什麼可做的。
這個地方基本上已經被搜空了。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
What do you want?
Oh, your guild musta
sent you to help out.
Yeah. We investigated.
Didn't find anything.
The Z Gang's long gone.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
你想幹什麼？
哦，你們公會一定是派你來幫忙的。
是啊。我們調查過了。
什麼也沒找到。
Z幫早就跑光了。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Feel free to look
around, but if you ask
me, it's a waste of time.
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
你可以隨便看看，
但在我看來，
這是浪費時間。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Yeesh, I'm stuck here
till I receive my new
orders from the guild.
They didn't... They didn't
forget about me, did they?
scripts.translation:
[調查員]
唉，我得在這裡待著，
直到收到公會的新命令。
他們不會...不會忘了我吧？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a small
safe hidden under the
shadows of these boxes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這些箱子的陰影下
藏著一個小型保險箱。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like the Z Gang
forgot to take this with
them in their rush to escape.
Hmmm... How do I open this?
Is there a key, a switch,
something I can use?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來Z幫在匆忙逃跑時
忘了把這個帶走。
嗯...我怎麼開啟它？
是有鑰匙，還是開關，
或者有什麼我能用的東西？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, the safe opened!
Those switches must have
done the trick. Now...
Let's look inside.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，保險箱開了！
那些開關一定起了作用。
現在...
讓我們看看裡面有什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Awesome! It's a huge
red diamond! Is this
Ibrahim's Diamond
of Destruction?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太棒了！是一顆巨大的紅鑽石！
這是易卜拉欣的
毀滅之鑽嗎？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Zzz... Zzz...

[{0}]
Lucky for me, this
guy is asleep. I better
sneak out of here, and
return this big diamond
to Ibrahim as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
幸好這傢伙睡著了。
我得趕緊溜出去，
儘快把這顆大鑽石還給易卜拉欣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was something here
fixed to the ground, but now
it looks like something yanked
it out forcefully. How weird.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡原本有個固定在地上的東西，
但現在看起來像是被強行拔走了。
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is this?
Oh well, I don't
think it's important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是什麼？
算了，我覺得這並不重要。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a tiny
switch on the ground
near the whiskey barrels.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF威士忌桶附近的地面上
有一個微小的開關。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was this here before?
What happens if I press
this teeny little switch?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是之前就在的嗎？
如果我按下這個微小的開關
會發生什麼？

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Click Click*^000000

[{0}]
That sound...!
Something happened,
but what could it be?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個聲音...！
好像有什麼東西發生了，
但會是什麼呢？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a tiny
switch on the ground
under the boxes' shadows.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF箱子陰影下的地面上
有一個微小的開關。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was this here before?
What happens if I press
this teeny little switch?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是之前就在的嗎？
如果我按下這個微小的開關
會發生什麼？

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Click Click*^000000

[{0}]
That sound...!
Something happened,
but what could it be?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個聲音...！
好像有什麼東西發生了，
但會是什麼呢？

regarding these criminals to

scripts.translation:

國土安全域性報告
關於這些罪犯的任何資訊。

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
These infamous members
of the Z Gang are suspected
of stealing national treasure,
committing fraud, forgery,
and promoting overall
depravity and immorality.
scripts.translation:
====全國通緝令====
這些臭名昭著的Z幫成員
涉嫌盜竊國家寶藏、
實施欺詐、偽造檔案，
以及助長整體的
墮落與不道德行為。

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
Anyone that captures
the listed criminals will
be rewarded with the Book
of Forbidden Mystery, one
of the kingdom's treasures.
scripts.translation:
====全國通緝令====
任何捕獲
名單上罪犯的人
都將獲得《禁忌之謎之書》
作為獎勵，
這是王國的寶藏之一。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Ever since you captured
the Z Gang, crime has gone
down to an all time low.
Thanks for helping us out~
scripts.translation:
[大副]
自從你們捕獲了Z幫，
犯罪率就降到了
歷史最低點。
謝謝你們幫助我們~

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Peace never lasts long...
Some other fiends will
replace the Z Gang soon.
When that happens, I hope
we can count on you again.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
和平不會持續太久...
很快就會有其他惡棍
取代Z幫。
當那一天到來時，
我希望還能依靠你們。

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
These infamous members
of the Z Gang are suspected
of stealing national treasure,
committing fraud, forgery,
and promoting overall
depravity and immorality.
scripts.translation:
====全國通緝令====
這些臭名昭著的Z幫成員
涉嫌盜竊國家寶藏、
實施欺詐、偽造檔案，
以及助長整體的
墮落與不道德行為。

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
Anyone that captures
the listed criminals will
be rewarded with the Book
of Forbidden Mystery, one
of the kingdom's treasures.
scripts.translation:
====全國通緝令====
任何捕獲
名單上罪犯的人
都將獲得《禁忌之謎之書》
作為獎勵，
這是王國的寶藏之一。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
You're carrying far too
much right now. Please
lighten your load by
placing your items
in the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
你現在攜帶的物品
實在太多了。請
將物品放入卡普拉倉庫
以減輕負擔。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Adventurers, this is
your chance to protect
and serve your country!
Please read the National
Wanted Notice for more details.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
冒險者們，這是
你們保衛和服務
國家的絕佳機會！
請閱讀全國通緝令
以瞭解更多詳情。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Attention, attention.
The Homeland Security Office
of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
is looking for any information
regarding the Z Gang.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
注意，注意。
盧恩·米德加茲王國
國土安全域性正在
尋找關於Z幫的任何資訊。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
There are three members:
Louis Von Silokens a.k.a.
Louis, Martha Hertizan a.k.a.
Martha, and Catfoii a.k.a.
Catfoii must be captured!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
共有三名成員：
路易斯·馮·西洛肯斯，
又名路易斯，瑪莎·赫蒂贊，
又名瑪莎，以及卡特福伊，
又名卡特福伊，必須被捕獲！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Oh, were you interested
in pursuing the criminals
listed in the Wanted notice?
I'm sorry, but you're not
ready for that kind of task...
But I encourge you to train!
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
啊，你是想追捕
通緝令上列出的罪犯嗎？
很抱歉，但你還沒有
準備好執行這種任務...
但我鼓勵你多加訓練！
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Hello, Rune-Midgartian.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[大副]
你好，盧恩·米德加茲的居民。
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: National Wanted Notice
scripts.translation: 全國通緝令

scripts.text: Z Gang
scripts.translation: Z幫

scripts.text: What crimes did Z Gang commit?
scripts.translation: Z幫犯了什麼罪？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Ah, were you interested
in pursuing the Z Gang?
Please carefully read the
Wanted notice posted right
next to me. We desperately
need help to catch them.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
啊，你是想追捕Z幫嗎？
請仔細閱讀
貼在我旁邊的通緝令。
我們急需幫助來抓捕他們。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
If you want to learn
more about the Z Gang,
I suggest talking to
a knight named Valdes.
He's fairly familiar with
their brand of antics.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
如果你想了解更多
關於Z幫的資訊，
我建議你去和
一位名叫瓦爾德斯的騎士談談。
他對他們的所作所為
相當熟悉。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Unfortunately, I fear
that he may be ashamed
of his failure to catch
them. However, I am sure
that he will be of service
in your quest for justice.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
不幸的是，我擔心
他可能會因為未能
抓捕他們而感到羞愧。
不過，我相信他
會在你追求正義的
旅途中提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
You wanted to know more
about the Z Gang members?
I don'tknow much about them,
but I can divulge what
little I've heard.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
你想知道更多
關於Z幫成員的事嗎？
我對他們瞭解不多，
但我可以透露
我所聽到的一些資訊。

scripts.text: Louis
scripts.translation: 路易斯

scripts.text: Martha
scripts.translation: 瑪莎

scripts.text: Catfoii
scripts.translation: 卡特福伊

scripts.text: Book of Forbidden Mystery?
scripts.translation: 《禁忌之謎之書》？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Louis Von Silokens was
the third son of the noble
Silokens family which was
ruined many years ago.
According to record, he failed
Magic Academy three times.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
路易斯·馮·西洛肯斯是西洛肯斯家族的三子，該家族多年前已家道中落。
據記載，他曾三次未能通過魔法學院的考試。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
It is believed that he formed
the Z Gang as a result of
his personal failure. He
also stole the Book of
Forbidden Mystery from
the Royal Library.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
人們認為他因個人失敗而組建了Z幫。
他還從皇家圖書館偷走了《禁忌之謎之書》。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
We must capture him and
retrieve that book before
he can abuse its power.
We need the help of the
people in order to find him
and bring Louis to justice!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
我們必須在他濫用其力量之前將他抓獲並奪回那本書。
我們需要民眾的幫助來找到他，讓路易斯受到法律的制裁！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Martha Hertizan is the
second daughter of Alberta's
Hertizan family. No one knows
why she ran away from home
at the age of twenty.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
瑪莎·赫蒂贊是艾爾貝塔赫蒂贊家族的二小姐。
沒人知道她為何在二十歲時離家出走。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Martha handles the Z Gang's
finances. It's a shame that
such a talented merchant
has stooped to thievery.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
瑪莎負責管理Z幫的財務。
真可惜，如此有才華的商人竟淪落為盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
We initially believed
that Catfoii was just
Louis and Martha's pet
cat... But it's actually a
master criminal. Approach
it with extreme caution!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
我們起初以為卡特福伊只是路易斯和瑪莎的寵物貓...
但它其實是個犯罪大師。請極度小心地接近它！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
That's all I know about
that animal. The true
nature of Catfoii is
shrouded in mystery.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
關於那隻動物，我就知道這些。
卡特福伊的真實面目籠罩在神秘之中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Out of all their crimes,
their theft of the Book of
Forbidden Mystery poses the
greatest danger to the kingdom.
If they misuse that book, it
will cause grave disaster.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
在他們犯下的所有罪行中，
偷竊《禁忌之謎之書》對王國構成了最大的威脅。
如果他們濫用那本書，將引發嚴重的災難。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
That damned Z Gang seems
to be in the center of all the
crime that's happening in
Rune-Midgarts. They caused
a riot in Geffen by spreading
rumors about ghosts...
scripts.translation:
[大副]
該死的Z幫似乎正處於盧恩·米德加茲所有犯罪活動的中心。
他們散佈關於幽靈的謠言，在吉芬引發了騷亂...

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
They poisoned the
drinking water in the
wells of Payon, seized
countless goods, profited
off illegal trade... The list
just keeps going on and on...
scripts.translation:
[大副]
他們在斐揚的水井中投毒，掠奪無數貨物，從中非法貿易中牟利...
這樣的罪行簡直數不勝數...

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Out of all their crimes,
their theft of the Book of
Forbidden Mystery poses the
greatest danger to the kingdom.
If they misuse that book, it
will cause grave disaster.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
在他們犯下的所有罪行中，
偷竊《禁忌之謎之書》對王國構成了最大的威脅。
如果他們濫用那本書，將引發嚴重的災難。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Oh, you were that nice
adventurer that dropped
by the other day. How
may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[大副]
哦，你是前幾天來過的那位好心的冒險者。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
What's that?! You really
found the Z Gang's hideout,
captured them, and retrieved
the forbidden book?
scripts.translation:
[大副]
什麼？！你真的找到了Z幫的秘密基地，
抓住了他們，並奪回了那本禁忌之書？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Splendid! Just splendid!
On behalf of the king,
let me give you a well
deserved reward. Thank
you for your work on
behalf of our kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
太棒了！簡直太棒了！
代表國王，讓我為您頒發一份應得的獎勵。
感謝您為我們王國所做的貢獻！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Your bravery and ardent
patriotism will forever
be recorded in the annals
of Rune-Midgarts history.
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
您的英勇和熾熱的愛國之心將永遠載入盧恩·米德加茲的歷史。
恭喜您！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
All those that oppose
the peace and safety of
our kingdom will not be
spared the fury of our
righteous swords!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
所有反對我國和平與安全的人，
都將受到我們正義之劍的怒火制裁！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Urp*^000000 What?
You here to... 
Um, commiserate
about failing life too?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
^666666*嗝*^000000 什麼？
你來這裡... 
呃，也是為了同情我人生失敗的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Valdes?
I came to ask you
for your help...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是瓦爾德斯嗎？
我來是想請求你的幫助...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Hiccup*^000000 Why~?
I'm-I'm no good
to anybody anymore!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
^666666*嗝*^000000 為什麼~？
我...我已經對誰都沒用了！

scripts.text: Ask About Z Gang
scripts.translation: 詢問關於Z幫派的事

scripts.text: The chief officer is worried about you.
scripts.translation: 大副很擔心你。

scripts.text: Bye!
scripts.translation: 再見！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
That Z Gang...
Ruined my life!
My career, my pension...
It's all gone because
of those damn criminals!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
那個Z幫派...
毀了我的人生！
我的事業，我的退休金...
全都被那群該死的罪犯給毀了！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
You? Capture them?
Good luck! Just... Just
try not to end up like me.
Oh, you want info-information?
^666666*Hic*^000000 Heh, scratch my back,
well, you know the rest.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
你？去抓他們？
祝你好運！只是...只是
別像我一樣落得這種下場。
哦，你想要資...資訊？
^666666*嗝*^000000 嘿，幫我個忙，
你也知道規矩的。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Heh, I just ran out of wine!
Gimme, um, ^0000FFMorocc Fruit Wine^000000!
5 bottles! Then... Maybe...
I'll tell you want you really
wanna know. Heh heh~ ^666666*Hic!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
嘿，我剛好沒酒了！
給我來...^0000FF莫洛克果酒^000000！
5瓶！然後...也許...
我會告訴你你真正想知道的。嘿嘿~ ^666666*嗝！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
R-really? Well...
I don't care! Just
let me drink in peace!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
真...真的嗎？好吧...
我才不在乎呢！
讓我安安靜靜地喝酒！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Wha--? Who do you think
you're messing with, ^666666*Hic!*^000000
just comin' by to say ''bye?!''
I useta be a knight once,
you know that? I could
totally kick your--^666666*Urp!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
什...什麼？你以為你在跟誰說話，^666666*嗝！*^000000
就只是來道個“再見”嗎？！
我以前可是騎士，
你知道吧？我完全能把你揍得--^666666*嗝！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Heeeey yoooou~
You bring me wine?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
嘿~ 你~
你帶酒來了？

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Sniff*^000000 Yeeesh, that
smeells good. This must
be it. Oh, yeah. Knight's
honor. First I talk, then
I can drink theesh...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾德斯]
^666666*吸鼻子*^000000 哇，聞起來
真香。這應該就是它了。哦，對。騎士的
榮譽。先說話，
