scripts.text:
[Marybell]
It might be a good idea
for you to go to Morocc
and check it out. Good
luck finding those Z Gang
guys. And take care!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
也許你去摩洛克看看情況是個好主意。
祝你好運找到那些Z集團的人。
保重！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, I'm willing to
let you in on everything
I know. After all the trouble
you went through, I'm sure
you've got a ton of questions!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
嘿，我願意把我知道的一切都告訴你。
經歷了那麼多麻煩，
我肯定你有很多問題要問！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Oh, and one more thing...
I hear that they're trying
to secretly recruit more
gang members in Morocc.
The nerve of those guys...!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
哦，還有一件事...
我聽說他們正在摩洛克秘密招募
更多的幫派成員。這些人真是膽大包天...！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
I haven't heard anything
else, but would you let me
know if you get any new leads?
The Rogue Guild wants these
Z Gang guys really bad!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
我沒聽到其他訊息，但如果你得到
任何新線索，請告訴我好嗎？
流氓公會非常想抓住這些Z集團的人！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, I've been looking for
you! One of the Rogues
dispatched to Comodo found
this envelope on a Z Gang
informer. Could be a clue!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
嘿，我一直在找你！
派往克魔島的一名流氓
在一個Z集團線人身上發現了這個信封。
這可能是一個線索！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
What's weird is that the
informer was fighting so
hard to hold on to blank
piece of paper... But we 
know that's not really
the case here, is it?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
奇怪的是，那個線人拼命想抓住
一張空白的紙...但我們都知道
這裡的情況並非如此，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
They must've been using
some kinda secret invisible
ink. Anyway, I gave the paper
to a professional decoder to
crack, and he oughta be
done by now. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
他們一定使用了某種秘密的隱形墨水。
總之，我把那張紙交給了一個專業的
解碼員去破解，他現在應該已經完成了。
總之...

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
I thought maybe you'd
want to go talk to him,
see if he's finished with it.
His name's Gooho Ahn over
in Payon, one of the best
decoders in this kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
我想你可能想去找他談談，
看看他是否完成了。他叫安具浩，
在斐揚，是這個王國最好的解碼員之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Gooho Ahn?
Why does it feel like
I should know that
name? It's so familiar...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
安具浩？
為什麼我覺得我應該知道
這個名字？它很熟悉...

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
I guess it's 'cause
Gooho is the younger brother
of Moonho, that legendary
gambler you happened to beat.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
我想是因為安具浩是月浩的弟弟，
那個你碰巧打敗的傳奇賭徒。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Eh, that's not what's
important right now.
Would you talk to Gooho
Ahn and see what he found?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
呃，現在這不是最重要的。
你會去和安具浩談談，看看他發現了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, why don't you talk
to Gooho Ahn in Payon,
and ask if he finished
decoding that secret letter
from the Z Gang already?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
嘿，你為什麼不和斐揚的安具浩談談，
問問他是否已經破解了那封來自Z集團的秘密信件？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Oh, Gooho decoded everything?
Let's see... Something about
the Book of Forbidden Mystery... Ah. There we go! The location
of the Z Gang's hideout!
Heh heh! We got 'em!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
哦，安具浩破解了一切？
讓我們看看...關於《禁忌之謎之書》...啊。找到了！
Z集團秘密基地的位置！
嘿嘿！我們抓到他們了！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
One of the Rogues followed
the informer carrying this
letter, but he just vanished
during the chase... Like, by
magic, I guess. So we don't
the hideout's exact place.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
一名流氓跟蹤了攜帶這封信的線人，
但他在追逐中消失了...就像
被魔法一樣。所以我們不知道
秘密基地的確切位置。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Even so, we're definitely
sure that it's around the
secret path to the South
Morocc underground. Um,
but we can't let you come
with the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
即便如此，我們肯定知道它在
摩洛克南部的地下秘密通道附近。
嗯，但我們不能讓你和流氓公會一起
去。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Sorry, I know, it's official
business and all that hooplah.
Tell you what. We'll each go
hunt them down separately, and
whoever finds 'em first gets
dibs on beating them up!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
抱歉，我知道，這是官方業務之類的。
這樣吧。我們各自去追捕他們，
誰先找到他們，誰就有優先權
揍他們一頓！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
We're definitely sure
that the Z Gang's hideout
is near the secret path
to the South Morocc
underground. You
know where that is?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
我們肯定知道Z集團的秘密基地
在摩洛克南部的地下秘密通道附近。
你知道那在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Tell you what. We'll each go
hunt them down separately, and
whoever finds 'em first gets
dibs on beating them up!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
這樣吧。我們各自去追捕他們，
誰先找到他們，誰就有優先權
揍他們一頓！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Nice work! You captured
the Z Gang! The kingdom
musta given you a really
big reward, huh?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
幹得漂亮！你抓住了Z集團！
王國肯定給了你一大筆賞金吧？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Valdes really wanted to
capture them himself, but
I'm sure he'll be real happy
to hear the news. Maybe he
and I can celebrate with
a little drink later.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
瓦爾德斯本來很想親自抓住他們，
但聽到這個訊息他肯定很高興。
也許之後我和他能小酌一杯慶祝一下。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, it's been a real
thrill working with you,
real thrill. Maybe we can
team up again for a good
cause some other time, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
嘿，和你合作真是令人興奮，
真的非常刺激。希望以後有機會
我們還能為了正義再次聯手，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
That Z Gang has been
a pain the Rogue Guild's
ass. No one runs away
from us! Nobody! But...
They can do it somehow.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
那個Z集團真是讓流氓公會頭疼。
沒人能逃過我們的手掌心！
一個都沒有！但是...
他們總能做到。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
There's not much here
that might interest you,
but knock yourself out
if you wanna look around.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗貝爾]
這裡沒什麼特別值得你關注的東西，
不過如果你想四處看看，請便。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hahaha, now what brings
a youngster like you before
me? You're not here for what
I think you are... Are you?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哈哈，是什麼風把像你這樣的年輕人
吹到我面前來了？
你不會是來找我...做那件事的吧？

scripts.text: Are you the White Meteor?
scripts.translation: 你是白流星嗎？

scripts.text: I'm here to challenge you.
scripts.translation: 我來向你挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
It's been so long since
I've heard that name...
I'm retired now, and it
seems no one wants to
challenge me anymore.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
好久沒聽到這個名字了...
我現在已經退休了，
看來也沒人想再挑戰我了。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Those were some good
times. Back then, only
Dalho Kwak was able to
give me a real challenge.
I wonder what he's doing now?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
那是段美好的時光。那時候，
只有達霍·郭能給我真正的挑戰。
不知道他現在在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Oh, I was right...!
You're here to challenge
me! It's been a long time...
Alright. I accept. However,
I set all of the terms.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哦，我猜對了...！
你是來挑戰我的！
真是好久不見了...
好吧，我接受。不過，
規則由我來定。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I'm too old to play the
complicated games I loved
in the past. Let's just
play a simple game that
I call Coin Shake.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我年紀大了，玩不動過去那些
複雜的遊戲了。讓我們玩個簡單的，
我稱之為“搖硬幣”的遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
This is basically
a guessing game played
in rounds, best 2 out of 3.
One of us will be the coin
shaker, and the other will
be the guesser.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
這基本上是一個猜謎遊戲，
分回合進行，三局兩勝。
其中一人負責搖硬幣，
另一人負責猜。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The coin shaker begins
the round by grabbing
a random amount of coins,
shaking them in his closed
hands, and then stopping,
keeping the coins concealed.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
負責搖硬幣的人開始回合時，
會抓取隨機數量的硬幣，
在緊握的雙手中搖晃，
然後停下，保持硬幣隱藏。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The other person, the
guesser, will then declare
a guess on whether the total
value of the coins is ^0000FFOdd^000000 or
^0000FFEven^000000. Afterwards, the coin
shaker reveals the coins...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
另一人，也就是猜的人，
需要猜測硬幣的總價值是^0000FF奇數^000000還是
^0000FF偶數^000000。之後，搖硬幣的人
會展示硬幣...

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
If the guesser is right,
then he wins the round.
However, if he guessed
wrong, then it's a victory
for the coin shaker.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
如果猜的人猜對了，
他就贏得這一回合。
但是，如果他猜錯了，
那就是搖硬幣的人獲勝。

scripts.text:
[Moohno Ahn]
We each take turns,
switching roles.
If it's your turn to
guess, remember to
call out ^0000FFOdd^000000 or ^0000FFEven^000000.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我們輪流進行，
交換角色。
如果輪到你去猜，
記得喊出^0000FF奇數^000000或^0000FF偶數^000000。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Lastly, I'm the house,
so I'll charge a game
participation fee. It's
not much, just 500 zeny.
We're only playing for fun,
not to break the bank.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
最後，我是莊家，
所以要收取一點參與費。
不多，只要500 Zeny。
我們只是玩玩，
不是要讓你破產。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Why don't you give me
some time to prep the
game? When you return,
we'll be ready to play~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
你不妨給我點時間準備一下游戲？
等你回來，我們就準備好開玩了~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Are you ready to
play Coin Shake?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
你準備好玩“搖硬幣”了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, let's play!
scripts.translation: 是的，開始吧！

scripts.text: How does this game work again?
scripts.translation: 這遊戲是怎麼玩的來著？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Good, let's get started!
I'll let you go first~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
很好，我們開始吧！
你先來~

scripts.text:
*Shake Shake*
Guess! Is it
Odd or Even?
scripts.translation:
*搖啊搖*
猜！
是奇數還是偶數？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
^0000ff{0}^000000?
Okay, you won.

^3355FF*Shake Shake*
Guess! Is it
Odd or Even?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*搖啊搖*
猜！
是奇數還是偶數？^000000

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Well, it's ^0000FFEven^000000.
I won.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
嗯，是^0000FF偶數^000000。
我贏了。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Shake Shake*
Guess! Is it
Odd or Even?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*搖啊搖*
猜！
是奇數還是偶數？^000000

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Ah, you win this round.
However, the game has
just started. The next
round will be mine~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
啊，這一局你贏了。
不過遊戲才剛開始。
下一局該我了~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
It looks like I win
this round. I guess
my gambling skills
haven't left me yet~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
看來這一局我贏了。
看來我的賭技還沒退步嘛~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
You can only declare
your guess as ^0000FFOdd^000000 or ^0000FFEven^000000.
Please try entering it again.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
你只能猜^0000FF奇數^000000或^0000FF偶數^000000。
請重新輸入。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
It's time for the
second round. This
time, I'll be the one
declaring my guess,
and you'll shake the coins.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
第二局開始了。
這次由我來猜，
你來搖硬幣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^666666What should I guess?^000000)
Odd
scripts.translation: 奇數

scripts.text: Even
scripts.translation: 偶數

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Let's see...
It's ^0000FFOdd^000000, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
讓我看看...
是^0000FF奇數^000000，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Looks like I won!
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
看來我贏了！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Let's see...
It's Even, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
讓我看看...
是偶數，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I lost?
So it's ^0000FFOdd^000000...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我輸了？
原來是^0000FF奇數^000000...

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Nice job. I didn't
expect for you to
really beat me...
Hahahahahahah~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
幹得不錯。沒想到你
真的贏了我...
哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hahaha! I'm sorry, but
I won. I guess I still got it!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哈哈！抱歉，
我贏了。看來我還是有點本事的！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Let's see...
It's odd, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
讓我看看...
是奇數，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I lost, huh?
So it was ^0000ffEven^000000...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我輸了？
原來是^0000ff偶數^000000...

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Let's see...
It's ^0000FFEven^000000, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
讓我看看...
是^0000FF偶數^000000，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Looks like I won!
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
看來我贏了！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Nice job. I didn't
expect for you to
really beat me...
Hahahahahahah~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
幹得不錯。沒想到你
真的贏了我...
哈哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hahaha! I'm sorry, but
I won. I guess I still got it!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哈哈！抱歉，
我贏了。看來我還是有點本事的！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
You really are amazing!
It's time that the title of
White Meteor be passed
onto someone more worthy...
You are the new White Meteor!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
你真的很厲害！
“白彗星”的稱號
該傳給更配得上它的人了...
你就是新的白彗星！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? Uh, can I get
that in writing please?
It'd mean so much to me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的嗎？呃，能給我
寫個書面證明嗎？
那對我來說意義非凡！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Ah, you want a letter
of recommendation or
my seal of approval, right?
Heh, you must be very proud.
Hold still for a second.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
啊，你是想要推薦信
或者我的認可印章，對吧？
呵，你一定很自豪吧。
站好別動，稍等一下。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000

[{0}]
What does this
scribble on my
wrist mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我手腕上這個
塗鴉是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
That is the sign of
the White Meteor.
Everyone that knows
me will recognize it
and its authenticity.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
那是白彗星的標示。
所有認識我的人
都會認出它，
並確認其真實性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you so much
for the fun game!
I better get going now,
but maybe we can play
again sometime~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你陪我玩這麼有趣的遊戲！
我該走了，
但也許我們改天還能再玩~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hahahaa!
After so long, it
feels good to have
played with a worthy
opponent. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哈哈！
這麼久以來，
能和旗鼓相當的對手
對局，感覺真好。謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I'm sorry, but I've won
the game. I had a really
great time, and I could
tell that it was really close.
It's been a while since I've
had this much fun gambling~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
抱歉，我贏了。
我玩得很開心，
而且能看出局勢很膠著。
我已經很久沒有
這麼享受賭博的樂趣了~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Oh, did you want to
play again? I can tell
that you're a bit eager to
beat me so you're welcome
to play me again anytime.
I'll be right here, hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哦，你想再玩一次？
看得出你很想贏我，
所以隨時歡迎再來挑戰。
我就在這裡，哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Ooh, this is exciting~
We each both won a round:
the next round will decide
who wins and loses!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
噢，這真刺激~
我們各贏了一局：
下一局將決定
勝負！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
It's my turn to shake
the coins. Let's see
how you fare this time...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
輪到我來搖硬幣了。
看看你這次表現如何...

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Shake Shake*
Guess! Is it
Odd or Even?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*搖啊搖*
猜！
是奇數還是偶數？^000000

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
^0000FF{0}^000000?
Okay, you won.

^3355FF*Shake Shake*
Guess! Is it
Odd or Even?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*搖啊搖*
猜！
是奇數還是偶數？^000000

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Well, it's ^0000FF{0}^000000.
Looks like I won.

^3355FF*Shake Shake*
Guess! Is it
Odd or Even?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*搖啊搖*
猜！
是奇數還是偶數？^000000

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Oh... You won...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
噢...你贏了...

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hahaha! I'm sorry, but
I won. I guess I still got it!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哈哈！抱歉，
我贏了。看來我還是有點本事的！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
You can only declare
your guess as ^0000FFOdd^000000 or ^0000FFEven^000000.
Please try entering it again.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
你只能猜^0000FF奇數^000000或^0000FF偶數^000000。
請重新輸入。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
You really are amazing!
It's time that the title of
White Meteor be passed
onto someone more worthy...
You are the new White Meteor!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
你真的很厲害！
“白彗星”的稱號
該傳給更配得上它的人了...
你就是新的白彗星！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? Uh, can I get
that in writing please?
It'd mean so much to me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的嗎？呃，能給我
寫個書面證明嗎？
那對我來說意義非凡！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Ah, you want a letter
of recommendation or
my seal of approval, right?
Heh, you must be very proud.
Hold still for a second.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
啊，你是想要推薦信
或者我的認可印章，對吧？
呵，你一定很自豪吧。
站好別動，稍等一下。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000

[{0}]
What does this
scribble on my
wrist mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我手腕上這個
塗鴉是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
That is the sign of
the White Meteor.
Everyone that knows
me will recognize it
and its authenticity.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
那是白彗星的標示。
所有認識我的人
都會認出它，
並確認其真實性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you so much
for the fun game!
I better get going now,
but maybe we can play
again sometime~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你陪我玩這麼有趣的遊戲！
我該走了，
但也許我們改天還能再玩~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hahahaa!
After so long, it
feels good to have
played with a worthy
opponent. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哈哈！
這麼久以來，
能和旗鼓相當的對手
對局，感覺真好。謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I'm sorry, but I've won
the game. I had a really
great time, and I could
tell that it was really close.
It's been a while since I've
had this much fun gambling~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
抱歉，我贏了。
我玩得很開心，
而且能看出局勢很膠著。
我已經很久沒有
這麼享受賭博的樂趣了~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Oh, did you want to
play again? I can tell
that you're a bit eager to
beat me so you're welcome
to play me again anytime.
I'll be right here, hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哦，你想再玩一次？
看得出你很想贏我，
所以隨時歡迎再來挑戰。
我就在這裡，哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hm? You don't even
have 500 zeny to play
a game? Well, whenever
you feel like playing Coin
Shake, drop on by.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
嗯？你連玩遊戲的
500 Zeny都沒有嗎？
好吧，等你想玩
“搖硬幣”的時候，
隨時歡迎過來。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
This is basically
a guessing game played
in rounds, best 2 out of 3.
One of us will be the coin
shaker, and the other will
be the guesser.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
這基本上是一個猜謎遊戲，
分回合進行，三局兩勝。
其中一人負責搖硬幣，
另一人負責猜。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The coin shaker begins
the round by grabbing
a random amount of coins,
shaking them in his closed
hands, and then stopping,
keeping the coins concealed.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
負責搖硬幣的人開始回合時，
會抓取隨機數量的硬幣，
在緊握的雙手中搖晃，
然後停下，保持硬幣隱藏。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The other person, the
guesser, will then declare
a guess on whether the total
value of the coins is ^0000FFOdd^000000 or
^0000FFEven^000000. Afterwards, the coin
shaker reveals the coins...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
另一人，也就是猜的人，
需要猜測硬幣的總價值是^0000FF奇數^000000還是
^0000FF偶數^000000。之後，搖硬幣的人
會展示硬幣...

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
If the guesser is right,
then he wins the round.
However, if he guessed
wrong, then it's a victory
for the coin shaker.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
如果猜的人猜對了，
他就贏得這一回合。
但是，如果他猜錯了，
那就是搖硬幣的人獲勝。

scripts.text:
[Moohno Ahn]
We each take turns,
switching roles.
If it's your turn to
guess, remember to
call out ^0000FFOdd^000000 or ^0000FFEven^000000.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我們輪流進行，
交換角色。
如果輪到你去猜，
記得喊出^0000FF奇數^000000或^0000FF偶數^000000。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Lastly, I'm the house,
so I'll charge a game
participation fee. It's
not much, just 500 zeny.
We're only playing for fun,
not to break the bank.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
最後，我是莊家，
所以要收取一點參與費。
不多，只要500 Zeny。
我們只是玩玩，
不是要讓你破產。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I still remember that
last legendary match with
Dalho Kwak. Now that man was
a worthy opponent: he could
read others' hands three times
faster than the normal eye!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我仍記得上次
與郭達豪的那場傳奇對決。
那位先生是位值得尊敬的對手：
他看穿別人手牌的速度
比常人快三倍！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
God, I miss those
days competing against
him. I wonder how he's
been doing lately...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
天哪，我真懷念
當年與他競爭的日子。
不知道他最近過得怎麼樣...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Oh, hello
adventurer.
Um, was there
something you wanted?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
哦，你好，冒險者。
呃，有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Rogue Guild's Decoding Request
scripts.translation: 流氓公會的破譯委託

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Ah, Marybell sent you?
I see. I've been struggling
trying to decrypt this letter.
Did you want to take a look?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
啊，是瑪麗貝爾派你來的？
原來如此。我一直都在努力破譯這封信。
你想來看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
This looks like a piece
of blank paper, but if you
add just the right amount
of heat and light, you can
read its contents. This is
some powerful encryption!
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
這看起來像是一張白紙，
但如果加上適量的熱量和光照，
就能讀出裡面的內容。這是一種非常強大的加密技術！

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
So far, I've only decrypted
just a portion of the letter's
content. Unfortunately, I ran
out of the materials I need to
measure how much light and heat
I need to unlock this message.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
目前，我只破譯了信件內容的一小部分。
不幸的是，我用來測量解鎖這條資訊所需光照和熱量強度的材料用完了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
I'm pretty swamped over
here, but if you're working
for Marybell, I don't think
you'd mind doing a favor
for me. Would you gather
the materials I need?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
我這邊事情很多，
但既然你是為瑪麗貝爾工作的，
我想你不會介意幫我個忙吧。
你能幫我收集我需要的材料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
I need
^0000FF20 Live Coals^000000,
^0000FF1 Matchstick^000000,
^0000FF2 Alcohol^000000, and
^0000FF10 Burning Hearts^000000.

[Gooho Ahn]
Once I have the things
I need, I should be able
to decrypt the rest of
this secret Z Gang letter.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
一旦我有了需要的東西，
我就應該能破譯這封Z Gang秘密信件剩下的部分了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
So did you bring the
things I need to measure
how much light and heat
I need to reveal the rest
of this secret Z Gang letter?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
那麼，你帶了我需要的東西嗎？
我需要測量光照和熱量，
以揭示這封Z Gang秘密信件剩下的內容。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Oh, good. Thanks a lot.
Now I should do my part,
and decrypt the rest of
this letter. Mm... Just
give me a second to
make some adjustments...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
哦，太好了。非常感謝。
現在該我做我的部分了，
破譯這封信剩下的部分。
嗯...請給我一點時間
做一些調整...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Oh, what? This language...
It's ancient! Aegye hasn't
been used in... centuries.
I've seen Aegye used in the
Book of Forbidden Mystery
before it was stolen.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
哦，什麼？這種語言...
它是古老的！Aegye已經幾百年
沒有被使用過了。
在《禁忌之謎之書》被偷走之前，
我曾見過Aegye被使用。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
There's a legend about
an ancient civilization that
set the foundation for our
modern society. The Aegye
language was considered
a subcultural phenomenon.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
有一個關於古代文明的傳說，
他們奠定了我們現代社會的基礎。
Aegye語言被認為是一種亞文化現象。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Aegye was popular among
children and rebellious
teens, but was considered
vulgar until it entered the
mainstream. Then, somehow...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
Aegye在兒童和叛逆青少年中很流行，
但在進入主流之前一直被認為是粗俗的。
然後，不知怎的...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Aegye destroyed that
ancient people's lingual
system and civilization
once it was popularized.
That is why there is strong
Aegye censorship today.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
Aegye在普及後摧毀了那個
古代人民的語言體系和文明。
這就是為什麼今天對Aegye有嚴格的審查。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
In fact, the existence
of Aegye is supposed to
be a huge secret. That
language is responsible
for one of the greatest
disasters of all time.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
事實上，Aegye的存在
應該是一個巨大的秘密。
這種語言是歷史上
最大災難之一的罪魁禍首。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Mm... Let me check...
My knowledge in Aegye
is very limited, so...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
嗯...讓我看看...
我對Aegye的瞭解非常有限，所以...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
That's the nature
of Aegye: it is chaotic,
and barely legible!
Regardless, this letter
is invaluable as research
material for my studies.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
這就是Aegye的本質：
它是混亂的，而且幾乎無法辨認！
無論如何，這封信作為我研究的
研究材料是無價的。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
It will be enough
for Marybell if you
deliver the message to
her verbatim. Listen
to me carefully, and
maybe write this down.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
只要原封不動地把信交給瑪麗貝爾就夠了。
請仔細聽我說，
也許最好把它記下來。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Please hurry!
I'm sure Marybell is
waiting to learn the
whereabouts of the Z Gang,
and this letter might have
a clue. Oh, and remember...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
請快點！
瑪麗貝爾肯定在等著
得知Z幫的下落，
這封信裡可能有線索。
哦，對了，別忘了...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
I need
^0000FF20 Live Coals^000000,
^0000FF1 Matchstick^000000,
^0000FF2 Alcohol^000000, and
^0000FF10 Burning Hearts^000000.

[Gooho Ahn]
Once I have the things
I need, I should be able
to decrypt the rest of
this secret Z Gang letter.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
一旦我有了需要的東西，
我就應該能破譯這封Z Gang秘密信件剩下的部分了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Please tell Marybell
the contents of the
Z Gang's letter so that
I can keep the original
document for research purposes.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
請把Z幫信件的內容
轉告瑪麗貝爾，
這樣我就可以保留原件
用於研究了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Encryption is the art of
hiding truth in layers of
secrecy. My specialty is
in unraveling the truth
by breaking encryption.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
加密的藝術在於
用層層秘密隱藏真相。
我的專長是通過
破解加密來還原真相。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
... ...

[{0}]
Something's not quite
right. I should come back
and investigate this area
later when there are fewer
people watching...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有些不對勁。
我應該等這裡人少一點的時候
再回來調查一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nuts! I was supposed
to try to do this secretly!
I better try to investigate
this area again when no
one is around here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
該死！我本來
是想悄悄做的！
最好等這裡沒人的時候
再回來調查一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haha! Got you!
You're an informer for
the Z Gang, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈！抓住你了！
你是Z幫的線人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[????]
I... I... d-don't
know what you're
talking about!
I'm innocent!
scripts.translation:
[????]
我...我...不...不知道
你在說什麼！
我是無辜的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you're telling
me this note didn't
just fall out of your
pocket? What's this
about trying to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你是說這張紙條
不是剛從你口袋裡掉出來的？
這上面說要殺我是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[????]
Th-that's...
I'm not--That...!

[{0}]
You better confess, or
I'll drag you over to the
Prontera Knightage or the
Rogue Guild to take care
of you. In fact, let's just
head over to Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你最好招供，
否則我就把你拖到
普隆德拉騎士團或流氓公會
去處理你。
其實，我們直接去普隆德拉吧...

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
N-no! I'll tell you
everything! Please!
My mother's old! I've
got kids to feed!
I... I can't go to jail!
scripts.translation:
[Z幫線人]
不...不！我會告訴
你一切的！求你了！
我母親年紀大了！
我還要養家餬口！
我...我不能坐牢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
Let's start by you
telling me where
I can find the Z Gang.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
先從告訴我
我在哪裡能找到Z幫開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
I... I really don't
know where to find them.
I'm at the bottom of the
food chain, I just follow
their written instructions.
scripts.translation:
[Z幫線人]
我...我真的不知道
他們在哪裡。
我在食物鏈的最底端，
我只是按照他們的書面指示行事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know what?
Never mind. I'm won't
take you to be jailed by
the Prontera Knights.
I'll drop you off
at the Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道嗎？
算了。我不會把你交給
普隆德拉騎士團坐牢。
我會把你交給流氓公會。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
...............................
Their secret hideout is in
South Morocc, and you can't
enter the place without the
secret password.
scripts.translation:
[Z幫線人]
...............................
他們的秘密據點在
南莫洛奇，
沒有秘密口令
是進不去的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nice. Now, you better
stop running with the
Z Gang. Otherwise, I'm
not going to be so merciful
the next time I see you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好。現在，你最好別再跟Z幫混了。
否則下次再見到你，
我可不會這麼仁慈了。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
Anything you want!
J-just let me liiive!
scripts.translation:
[Z幫線人]
您想讓我做什麼都行！
求...求您讓我活命吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should head back to
Marybell, and see if she's
learned any new information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我該回去找瑪麗貝爾，
看看她有沒有打聽到什麼新訊息。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
什麼？滾開！
聽著，你最好別惹我。
就是...別惹我。

scripts.text:
[Thug]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[惡棍]
什麼？滾開！
聽著，你最好別惹我。
就是...別惹我。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
Whoa, leave me alone!
I'm just standing here
on the road, I didn't
do anything wrong!
scripts.translation:
[Z幫線人]
哇，別纏著我！
我只是站在路邊，
我什麼都沒做錯啊！

scripts.text:
[Former Z Gang Informer]
You don't have to
worry about me anymore.
I've turned over a new
leaf, got a real job,
that sort of deal.
scripts.translation:
[前Z幫線人]
您不用再擔心我了。
我已經改過自新，
找了份正經工作，
就這樣。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
什麼？滾開！
聽著，你最好別惹我。
就是...別惹我。

scripts.text:
[Thug]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[惡棍]
什麼？滾開！
聽著，你最好別惹我。
就是...別惹我。

scripts.text:
[????]
I know you've
been pursuing us!
Grrrr... DIE NOW!
scripts.translation:
[????]
我知道你們一直在追查我們！
嘎嘎嘎...現在就去死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-who are you?

[????]
Y-you're stronger
than I thought!
Run awaaaaay!
scripts.translation:
[????]
你...你比我想像的更強！
快逃啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}] 
Huh? That man must
have dropped this
note in his haste
to get away from here.
Let's see what it says...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？那個男人匆忙逃跑時
一定掉了這張紙條。
讓我看看上面寫了什麼...

scripts.text:
^666666Kill {0}, meow.
That arrogant do-gooder
is looking into us too much.
Fail to kill him, and death
will be too good for you, meow.^000000
scripts.translation:
^666666殺掉{0}，喵。
那個自命不凡的多管閒事者
對我們查得太緊了。
如果殺不成他，
你就死定了，喵。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That must have been
an informer for the Z Gang.
He can't have gotten too far:
I have a chance to catch him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那一定是Z幫的線人。
他應該跑不遠：
我有機會抓住他！

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This slab is speaking
to me! I... I think. Now
where have I heard
talking like this before?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這塊石板在跟我說話！
我...我覺得是這樣。
我剛才在哪裡聽過這種說話方式？

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, right! This is that
trashy language, Aegye,
that Gooho Ahn told me
about. It still sounds
like... A poor excuse
for language to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，對了！這是安具浩告訴我的
那種粗俗的語言，Aegye。
聽起來還是像...一種蹩腳的方言。

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess
I should talk to it. Um...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想我應該跟它說說話。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner n2d sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner n2d sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa! It's saying
something different now!
I must be doing alright.
Now what do I say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇！它現在說的不一樣了！
看來我做得不錯。
那我該說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner r3d sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner r3d sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Heh! I'm on the right
track. Now what do I say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿！我找對方向了。
那接下來該說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
*Creak Creak*
*Creak Creak*
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
*吱呀吱呀*
*吱呀吱呀*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um... Now what...?
Waaaah! Waaah!
scripts.translation: 哇啊啊！哇啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What th--?! What's
happening?! I'm being
sucked away somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什麼？！
發生什麼事了？！
我好像被吸到什麼地方去了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm? Did I do something
wrong? It just stopped
working all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？我是不是做錯了什麼？
它突然就不起作用了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000Rrsoy, rrsoy.
Ai cn'at elt yoo ni ofr nwo. Plzea ecmo ckba tela.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000Rrsoy, rrsoy.
Ai cn'at elt yoo ni ofr nwo. Plzea ecmo ckba tela.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think...
I think I should
try this again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想...
我想我應該再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^666666*Pzzzzz*^000000

[{0}]
Huh? This talking slab
thing isn't working now.
Hello? What happened to you?
Hey! Talk to me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？這個會說話的石板
現在又不行了。
喂？你怎麼了？
嘿！跟我說話啊！

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^666666*Pzzzzz*^000000

[{0}]

thing isn't working now.
Hello? What happened to you?
Hey! Talk to me, will you?

[{0}]

現在又不行了。
喂？你怎麼了？
嘿！跟我說話啊！

[{0}]

Hello? What happened to you?

嘿！跟我說話啊！

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
*Creak Creak*
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
*吱呀吱呀*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This slab looks pretty
strange. Is it making
noises? Hmm... Maybe this
is a clue to the Z Gang!
I'll come back later
to investigate this~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這塊石板看起來很奇怪。
它在發出聲音嗎？嗯...
也許這是Z幫的線索！
我稍後再回來調查一下~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This used to be
where the Z Gang
would hide out.
Good riddance!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡曾經是
Z幫藏身的地方。
終於清除了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a peculiar
looking slab. It sounds
like... What are those
noises? Huh. Weird.
It's like it's just
talking gibberish.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這塊石板看起來
很特別。聽起來像...
那是什麼聲音？
嗯。好奇怪。
它好像只是在胡言亂語。

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Creak Creak*^000000

[{0}]
Did I just...
Hear something
around here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我剛才...
是不是聽到
附近有什麼聲音？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
Something has gone
terribly wrong, hasn't
it? Let me go baaaack~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡...？
一定出了什麼大錯，
對吧？讓我回...回去吧~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
Something has gone
terribly wrong, hasn't
it? Let me go baaaack~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡...？
一定出了什麼大錯，
對吧？讓我回...回去吧~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You cowardly Z Gang!
Come out and surrender!
I've defeated your monster
soldiers already!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們這些膽小的Z幫！
出來投降吧！
我已經打敗你們的
魔物士兵了！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
What should we do?
scripts.translation:
[瑪莎]
我們該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
This is our greatest
crisis ever! I don't
know what to do, meow!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
這是我們面臨的最大危機！
我都不知道該怎麼辦了，喵！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
The Z Gang's not going
to surrender yet! Come
forth, my loyal servants
of the darkness!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
Z幫是不會輕易投降的！
出來吧，我黑暗中的忠實僕從們！

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
No-no-no-meow!
Not that button!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
不不不不喵！
別按那個按鈕！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Huh? Why...?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
咦？為什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Louis]
You mess with the
Z Gang, you--wait.
Let's just do this later.
You know, when you're carrying
fewer items with you. Then,
we can rumble in peace.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你竟然敢招惹Z幫，你——等等。
這事我們改天再算吧。
就是那種，你身上帶的東西少一點的時候。
到時候，我們再好好較量一番。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
What happened?
The big guns were
supposed to come out!
Why aren't we invisible
anymore? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
怎麼回事？
那些大傢伙應該已經出來了才對！
為什麼我們的透明術失效了？
到底發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
You pushed the button
to turn off the invisibility,
meow! Did you really have
to ask?! It's your fault!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
是你按下了關閉透明術的按鈕，喵！
你居然還要問嗎？！都是你的錯！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Argh! I should never
have trusted that fool!
scripts.translation:
[瑪莎]
可惡！我就不該相信那個蠢貨！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... Z Gang...
And cat. It's time
to turn you in.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼... Z幫...
還有貓。
是時候把你們交出去了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
I... I can't accept
our defeat! The Z Gang
won't go down so easily!
Come forth, my demon
spawn minions of doom!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
我...我無法接受失敗！
Z幫不會這麼輕易倒下的！
出來吧，我那些帶來災厄的惡魔後裔僕從們！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think
they're coming.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得它們不會來了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
...............................
We surrender. Argh, but
we were so close to
conquering the world!

[{0}]
Now if you'll just
hand over the Book
of Forbidden Mystery...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在，只要你們把
《禁忌之謎之書》交出來...

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
Louis, meow!
Don't do it!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
路易斯，喵！
別這麼做！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Let's just surrender,
Louis. It looks like
the Z Gang is finished.
scripts.translation:
[瑪莎]
路易斯，投降吧。
看起來Z幫已經完蛋了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, the Rogue Guild
is on its way to come get
you guys. You won't be able
to escape this time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，流氓公會的人
正在趕來抓你們。
這次你們逃不掉了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Awwww, man!
Fine, take the stupid
ol' book. I couldn't
use it that good anyway.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
哎呀，真是的！
好吧，把那本破書拿走。
反正我也用不好它。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Catfoii, would you
lead this adventurer guy
to the exit? I can't bear
to look at the face that's
caused my tragic downfall...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
卡特福伊，
你帶這位冒險者去出口吧。
我實在不忍心看著
導致我悲劇性失敗的那張臉...

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
Fine, meow.
I understand.
But how did we lose?!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
好吧，喵。
我明白了。
但我們是怎麼輸的？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
Something has gone
terribly wrong, hasn't
it? Let me go baaaack~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡...？
一定出了什麼大錯，
對吧？讓我回...回去吧~！

scripts.text:

Hey, you're carrying
too much stuff. You'd
better put some of your
items away first in Kafra
Storage or something.
scripts.translation:

嘿，你帶的東西太多了。
最好先把一些物品存到卡普拉倉庫裡。

scripts.text:

Argh...! What'd 
you do, Louis?

啊...！
路易斯，你幹了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
H-hello? Would you help me?
You'd be saving this poor man's
life if you would just do me
this favor. Please...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
你...你好？能幫幫我嗎？
如果你能幫這個小忙，
就等於救了這個可憐人的命。
拜託了...

scripts.text: How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Ignore Him
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, what can I do to help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我能怎麼幫你？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, thank you so much!
It feels so good to talk to
someone after being ignored
all this time! I might appear to
be a beggar, but I'm actually a
treasure hunter from Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
哦，太感謝了！
被無視了這麼久，
終於能和人說說話了，感覺真好！
我看起來像個乞丐，
但其實我是來自普隆德拉的尋寶獵人。

scripts.text: Umm... So?
scripts.translation: 嗯...然後呢？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I was so sure I could find
the treasure here in Morocc
when I first started... I did
all my research and prep work.
But after hiring teams of other
hunters and researchers...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
剛開始的時候，
我很確信能在莫洛奇找到寶藏...
我做了所有的研究和準備工作。
但在僱傭了其他獵人和研究員的團隊後...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I've spent my entire fortune,
and I'm still not any closer
to finding that treasure.
I... I don't even have enough
money to go back home!
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
我花光了所有的積蓄，
卻離找到寶藏越來越遠。
我...我甚至沒有足夠的錢回家！

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Won't you spare some
money, so that I can finally
go back home to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
你能不能施捨一點錢，
讓我終於能回到普隆德拉的家？

scripts.text: Why don't you just walk?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼不自己走回去？

scripts.text: I can give you some money.
scripts.translation: 我可以給你一些錢。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
What? You don't think that
if I could walk to Prontera,
I'd have done it already?!
Why would I even bother to
beg for money? Fine, I don't
need your brand of sympathy.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
什麼？你不覺得如果我能走回普隆德拉，
早就走了嗎？！
我為什麼要乞討？
算了，我不需要你這副同情的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
You know, I had a hot tip
that I was going to let you
in on, but if you don't want
to share, then neither do I!
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
你知道嗎，我本來有個好線索要告訴你的，
但如果你不想分享，那我也不分享！

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, thank you!
Anything you can spare,
I'll gladly appreciate!
God bless you, bless you!
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
哦，謝謝你！
你能給多少我都感激不盡！
上帝保佑你，保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Umm... Oh, dear...
You're just as bad off
as I am. I appreciate it,
but I can't take your money.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
嗯...哎呀...
你的處境和我一樣糟糕。
我很感激，但我不能收你的錢。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
It's a shame, really.
If you had given me 1,200
zeny, I would have tipped
you off to something big...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
真可惜。
如果你給我1,200 Zeny，
我本來可以告訴你一個大秘密...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Let's see... I just need
1,200 zeny. That's enough
for me to go back home.
Now, I can't let you just
give me money and let you
leave empty handed, can I?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
讓我想想...我只需要1,200 Zeny。
這就夠我回家了。
不過，我不能讓你白白給我錢然後空手離開，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Remember that hidden
treasure I was looking for?
There's a rumor that it's
location has finally been
confirmed. Why don't you
try finding it for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
還記得我一直在找的那個隱藏寶藏嗎？
有傳言說它的位置終於被確認了。
你要不要自己去找找看？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I'd rather that it end up in
the hands of someone like
you than a rival treasure
hunter. This hunter that
stays north in town apparently confirmed the treasure's location.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
我寧願它落入你這樣的人手中，
也不願落入競爭對手尋寶獵人手裡。
聽說住在城鎮北邊的那個獵人，
似乎已經確認了寶藏的位置。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Now, I hear that this guy
hasn't returned home yet,
and he still hasn't found
the treasure. He's probably
run into a pretty bad snag.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
我聽說這傢伙還沒回家，
而且至今還沒找到寶藏。
他大概是遇到了不小的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I doubt that he'll let you
know the treasure's location
easily, but who knows? Maybe
he might slip, and accidentally
give you some kind of clue.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
我懷疑他不會輕易告訴你寶藏的位置，
但誰知道呢？也許他會失言，
不小心給你透露一點線索。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Please! Please, wait!
You're an adventurer, aren't
you? I have some valuable
information to share if you'd
just spare me some... Hey!
Come back! No... I just...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
求求你！請等等！
你是一名冒險者，對吧？
如果你能分我一點...嘿！
回來！不...我只是...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, I remember you.
You must really want that
treasure now, do you? Just
give me 1,200 zeny for me
to go back home, and I'll
tell you everything I know.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
哦，我記得你。
你現在一定很想要那個寶藏吧？
只要給我1,200 Zeny讓我回家，
我就把我知道的一切都告訴你。

scripts.text: Give Money
scripts.translation: 給錢

scripts.text: Don't Give Money
scripts.translation: 不給錢

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Ah, good choice!
And thank you so much.
It'll be great to finally be
back home in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
啊，好選擇！
非常感謝你。
終於能回到普隆德拉的家了，
真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
What th--?! This isn't
enough money for me to go
back home! Well, just come
back later once you scrounge
up the funds. I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
什...什麼？！
這點錢不夠我回家的！
等你籌夠錢後再來吧。
我會在這裡等你的。

scripts.text:

Remember that hidden
treasure I was looking for?
There's a rumor that it's
location has finally been
confirmed. Why don't you
try finding it for yourself?
scripts.translation:

但誰知道呢？也許他會失言，
不小心給你透露一點線索。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Fine, have it your way.
I admit that I'm a little
disappointed in you. Aren't
you adventurers supposed
to be heroes to the people?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
好吧，隨你吧。
我承認我對你有點失望。
你們冒險者不應該是人民的英雄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, you're back?
Ah, you must be having
trouble finding that guy
I was talking about. He's
just in the northern part of this town. It can't be that hard.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
哦，你回來了？
啊，你肯定是在找我說的那個人吧。
他就在這座城鎮的北邊。應該不難找的。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
You found the treasure?!
It... It really exists...
I'm sorry, it's just been
my dream to... I feel like
crying... Oh, God... I don't
know what this feeling is...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
你找到寶藏了？！
它...它真的存在...
對不起，這只是我的夢想...我快哭了...
哦，天哪...我不知道這是什麼感覺...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I mean... I feel so
damned happy, but...
I spent my entire fortune...
Ruined my whole life just
to see that treasure...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
我是說...我感到無比幸福，但是...
我花光了所有的積蓄...
為了看到那個寶藏，毀了我的一生...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
So how's the treasure
hunt coming along? I hope
you have better luck than
I did. Still, I've got a pretty good feeling that you'll find it.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫襤褸的男子]
尋寶進展得怎麼樣了？
希望你比我運氣好。
不過，我有一種預感，你會找到的。

scripts.text:
[Man]
What do you want?
Just leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你想幹什麼？
別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Man]
What do you want?
Just leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你想幹什麼？
別來煩我。

scripts.text: Tell me about the treasure.
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於寶藏的事

scripts.text:
[Man]
What? So you're the one
I was warned about! I've
been wondering when you'd
show up. Prepare to die!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
什麼？原來你就是那個被警告過的人！
我一直在等你出現。準備受死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... Excuse me?
I've just heard that you
confirmed the location of
some amazing treasure,
and I just wanted to ask
you more about it. That's all!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...打擾一下？
我剛聽說你確認了某個驚人寶藏的位置，
只是想多瞭解一些情況。僅此而已！

scripts.text:
[Man]
What? If you're just here
for that, then how'd you
find out about me and
the treasure? Not just
everyone knows about it.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
什麼？如果你只是來打聽這個的，那你又是從哪裡知道我和寶藏的事的？
又不是人人都知道這件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was talking to
this other treasure hunter
who's... Well, he's kind
of a beggar now...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我之前和另一個尋寶者聊過天，他...嗯，他現在算是個乞丐了...

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh. That old man?
Well, I don't know if the
treasure he was looking
for and the one I've found
are the same one. But
yeah, I know that guy.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，那個老人？
我不知道他找的寶藏和我找到的是不是同一個。不過，我確實認識那個人。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Alright. So I found this
treasure, but I have no way
of digging it up. Maybe we
can help each other. I need
money, and you want to know
more, right? Let's cut a deal.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
好吧。我找到了這個寶藏，但我沒辦法把它挖出來。
也許我們可以互相幫助。我需要錢，你也想知道更多，對吧？
我們做個交易吧。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: What'd you have in mind?
scripts.translation: 你有什麼打算？

scripts.text:
[Man]
No? Well...
There's no reason for
you to trust me now,
I suppose. But what can
you gain by walking away?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
不？好吧...
我想你現在也沒有理由信任我。
但如果你現在走開，又能得到什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Let me lay it out for you.
I've been hired to find this
treasure by some people:
they said I can take whatever
I find, but they specifically
want one item for themselves.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
讓我給你解釋一下。
有人僱我來找這個寶藏：
他們說我可以拿走我找到的任何東西，但他們特別想要其中一件物品留給自己。

scripts.text:
[Man]
They pay me on delivery
so I haven't seen a dime yet.
Now, my agreement with them
is conditional. I can't dig
up the treasure so they'll
understand if I say I failed.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
他們是在交貨後才付錢的，所以我到現在還沒見到一分錢。
而且我和他們的協議是有條件的。既然我挖不出寶藏，他們應該能理解我任務失敗這件事。

scripts.text:
[Man]
But if you dig it up, you can
keep everything. Sound good?
All I want is some stuff from
you to make all my efforts up
till now worth my while.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
但如果你把它挖出來，你可以保留所有東西。聽起來不錯吧？
我只想要你的一些東西，來彌補我之前的努力。

scripts.text:
[Man]
In other words,
if you bring me,
^FF000020 Mementos^000000,
^FF00002 Pearls^000000, and
^FF00002 Zargons^000000, we can talk
business further. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
換句話說，
如果你給我
^FF000020個紀念品^000000、
^FF00002顆珍珠^000000，以及
^FF00002個剎勒空結晶^000000，我們就能進一步談生意。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Hey, I might be losing out
by giving up my share of that
treasure, but hey, a bird in
the hand's always worth more.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嘿，雖然我放棄了那份寶藏的份額，但嘿，落袋為安總是更好的。

scripts.text:
[Man]
You again? Lemme guess...
You're reconsidering that
deal I had in mind, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
又是你？讓我猜猜...
你是在重新考慮我提出的那個交易，對吧？

scripts.text: No, not really.
scripts.translation: 不，不是。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 我想是的。

scripts.text:
[Man]
You sure? No one would
be losing in this deal, you
know. Well, except the guys
that hired me to find that
treasure. It's pretty much
a win-win situation.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你確定嗎？在這筆交易中沒有人會吃虧，你知道嗎。
嗯，除了那些僱我來找寶藏的傢伙。這基本上是一個雙贏的局面。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Way I figure it,
someone ought to get
that treasure. I can't
dig it up, but maybe
someone like you can...
scripts.translation:
[男子]
在我看來，
總得有人得到那個寶藏。我挖不出來，但也許像你這樣的人可以...
