scripts.text:
[Man]
Back again, huh?
So did you bring
the stuff I asked?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
又回來了，是嗎？
那你帶來我要求的東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Nice. You did your part.
And now it's time that
I fulfilled my part of
this bargain. Listen up.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
很好。你完成了你的部分。
現在輪到我履行我在這筆交易中的承諾了。聽好了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
The treasure is buried
south of Morocc. Use the
south gate to leave town,
and then head to the next
field to the south. From
there, you're on your own.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
寶藏埋在莫洛克的南邊。使用南門離開城鎮，
然後向南走到下一個野外區域。從那裡開始，就要靠你自己了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
I don't know exactly
where the treasure is
buried, but you should
be able to find it within
that general area. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我不知道寶藏具體埋在哪裡，但你應該能在該區域內找到它。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Huh, you must have
forgotten what I wanted.
I'm not really asking you
for extremely valuable stuff
here. Anyway, listen up.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哈，你肯定忘了我要什麼了。
我並不是在向你索要極其貴重的東西。總之，聽好了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Just bring me,
^FF000020 Mementos^000000,
^FF00002 Pearls^000000, and
^FF00002 Zargons^000000 so we can talk
business further. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
只要給我
^FF000020個紀念品^000000、
^FF00002顆珍珠^000000和
^FF00002個剎勒空結晶^000000，
我們就能進一步談生意。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man]
What are you still doing
here? Shouldn't you be
looking for the treasure?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你還在這裡幹什麼？
不應該去找寶藏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man]
What are you still doing
here? Shouldn't you be
looking for the treasure?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你還在這裡幹什麼？
不應該去找寶藏嗎？

scripts.text: I already found it, but...
scripts.translation: 我已經找到了，但是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I already found it, but...
It won't budge at all!
I think it's protected by
magic. Do you know
anything about that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經找到了，但是...
它完全紋絲不動！
我覺得它被魔法保護著。
你知道關於這方面的事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Wow, you actually found
it? Heh, you're better than
I thought. Sorry about that.
I didn't explain the magic
part since... Well, I didn't
think you'd get that far.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哇，你居然真的找到了？
呵，你比我想像的厲害。
抱歉，我沒解釋魔法的部分，因為...好吧，
我沒想到你能走到這一步。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Anyway, I had problems
with that magic too. Some
guy was supposed to help me
with that, but he didn't come.
I've been so frustrated!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
總之，我也被那個魔法搞得很頭疼。
本來有個傢伙說要幫我處理這個，
但他沒來。我真是受夠了！

scripts.text:
[Man]
I mean, I have no clue
when it comes to magic, and
I don't understand how I'm
supposed to use this thing
my clients gave to me.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我是說，我對魔法一竅不通，
也不明白該怎麼使用
我委託人給我的這個東西。

scripts.text: Who was going to help you?
scripts.translation: 誰本來要幫你？

scripts.text: Your clients gave you something?
scripts.translation: 你的委託人給了你什麼東西？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. The guys that
hired me said that if I waited
at the treasure site, someone
would eventually come to help
me out on the magic end.
I don't know who he is, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，對。僱我的人說，
如果我在寶藏所在地等待，
最終會有人來幫我解決魔法的問題。
不過我不知道他是誰。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. They mentioned
something about him coming
a bit from the west. Maybe
he's over in Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，對。他們提到
那個人會從西邊過來。
也許他在克魔島那邊？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. They gave me
this weird document labeled
''^FF0000[Open^000000.'' I don't know how
to use it at all, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，對。他們給了我
一份奇怪的文件，上面寫著
''^FF0000[開啟^000000''。
但我完全不知道該怎麼用它。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. They gave me
this weird document labeled
''^FF0000[Unlock^000000.'' I don't know how
to use it at all, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，對。他們給了我
一份奇怪的文件，上面寫著
''^FF0000[解鎖^000000''。
但我完全不知道該怎麼用它。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. Let's see here.
Ah, here's the document
that they gave me. It's kind
of a bit torn, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，對。讓我看看。
啊，這就是他們給我的文件。
不過它有點破損了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe torn document
is labeled ''^FF0000[Open^3355FF.''^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那份破損的文件
上面寫著''^FF0000[開啟^3355FF''。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe torn document
is labeled ''^FF0000[Unlock^3355FF.''^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那份破損的文件
上面寫著''^FF0000[解鎖^3355FF''。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, how could you not
know how to use this?
Didn't you get a chance
to talk to your clients?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你怎麼會不知道怎麼用這個？
你沒機會和你的委託人談談嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man]
I haven't even met them.
I just get their instructions
through the mail. Everything
is through a medium with these
guys. I guess they've got their
eyes on me too, but whatever.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我甚至沒見過他們。
我只是通過郵件收到他們的指示。
和這些人打交道，一切都得通過中間人。
我想他們也在監視我，但無所謂了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
I guess they hired me because
they really want the treasure,
but don't want to tip anyone
off that they're looking for 
it, or that they have it.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我想他們僱我是因為他們
真的很想要那個寶藏，
但不想讓人知道他們在找它，
或者他們已經得到了它。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Anyway, all I know is that
this piece of paper is supposed
to do something. But I guess
I'm not smart enough to figure
it out. Maybe you'll have
better luck with them.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
總之，我只知道
這張紙應該能起什麼作用。
但我想我腦子不夠用，搞不懂。
也許你和他們打交道會更順利。

scripts.text:
[Man]
You know, if you can actually
find that guy who was supposed
to help me but never showed up,
maybe he'll understand how to
use that document. Go ahead
and take 'em. Good luck, now.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你知道嗎，如果你能找到那個本該幫我卻一直沒露面的人，
也許他會知道怎麼用那份文件。
拿去用吧。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Man]
I already told you everything
I know. You'd be better off
finding that guy over in
Comodo, or the rest of
that torn document.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我已經把我知道的都告訴你了。
你最好去克魔島找找那個人，
或者找找那份破損文件的其餘部分。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Now that I think about it,
maybe the treasure can be
obtained by two people?
I mean, they planned for
me to go with that guy. Eh,
best not to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
這麼一想，
也許寶藏需要兩個人才能拿到？
我是說，他們原本計劃讓我和那個人一起去。
算了，還是別想這些了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Heh! Looks like I'll be
headed home soon~
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嘿！看來我很快就能回家了~

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Whoa, don't get so close!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
哇，別靠得太近！

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Whoa, don't get so close!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
哇，別靠得太近！

scripts.text: Why are you hiding here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼躲在這裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you hiding here?
Didn't the Z Gang hire you
to dig up some treasure?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為什麼躲在這裡？
Z幫不是僱你來挖寶藏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Huh? Z Gang? Treasure?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
什麼？Z幫？寶藏？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Huh? Wait, tell me the
truth. Did you actually
meet the Z Gang?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
什麼？等等，告訴我實話。
你真的見過Z幫的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I not only met the Z Gang,
I also captured them. I've
come looking for you to
find out more about this
buried treasure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不僅見過Z幫，
還抓住了他們。我來找你，
是想了解更多關於這個埋藏寶藏的事。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
I get it now. You must
have met that other guy
they hired to get the
treasure. Huh. He's got one
half of the spell to open it,
and I've got the other.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
我明白了。你肯定見過
他們僱來取寶藏的另一個人。
哼。他拿著開啟寶藏咒語的一半，
而我拿著另一半。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Well, you can have this,
the rest of the magic spell.
Let me warn you, though,
there's something weird
about the spell, and the
treasure itself.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
好吧，這個給你，
剩下的咒語部分。
不過我要警告你，
這個咒語和寶藏本身都有些古怪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Seseame]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了一份破損的文件，
上面寫著''^FF0000芝麻^000000''。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了一份破損的文件，
上面寫著''^FF0000開門^000000''。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
I don't understand why they
went through the hassle of
splitting this spell in two
parts. There must be some
reason. Whatever it is, it
must be pretty important.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
我不明白他們為什麼要費心
把咒語分成兩部分。
肯定有什麼原因。不管怎樣，
那一定很重要。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
I guess maybe you need
two people to move the
treasure? Well, whatever.
Good luck finding that
treasure. Farewell now!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
也許需要兩個人才能移動寶藏？
算了，無所謂了。
祝你找到寶藏。再見！

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Whoa, don't get so close!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
哇，別靠得太近！

scripts.text: Ask About Treasure
scripts.translation: 詢問關於寶藏的事

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've come looking
for information
about the treasure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來找你是為了
打聽關於寶藏的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
You... You've come
looking for me?!
Ugh, I'm cornered!
I'm not going down
without a fight!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你...你是來找我的？！
可惡，我被包圍了！
我絕不會束手就擒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? No, it's not like
that. I met this treasure
hunter in Morocc that said
I could find you around here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？不，不是那樣的。
我在莫洛克遇到一個尋寶獵人，
他說我可以在這裡找到你。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Treasure hunter...?
Oh, then you already
know about the treasure...
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
尋寶獵人...？
哦，那你已經知道寶藏的事了...

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
If I'm right, then you
need the other half of
the spell to open the
treasure. Here, you can
take it. I have no use
for it, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
如果我沒猜錯，你需要咒語的另一半才能開啟寶藏。
給你，拿去吧。反正我也用不上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Sesame]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了一張撕碎的紙條，上面寫著
''^FF0000芝麻]^000000。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了一份破損的文件，
上面寫著''^FF0000開門^000000''。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Now would you just get
out of here? If you couldn't
already tell, I'm hiding from
some people. I told you all
I know, so do me a favor,
and don't tell anyone I'm here!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你能不能快點走？
如果你還沒發現的話，我正在躲避一些人。
我已經把知道的都告訴你了，
求你個忙，別告訴任何人我在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Aren't you going to
dig up that treasure?
You have both parts of
the spell that you need:
I already gave you the
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000'' part, right?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你難道不打算挖出那個寶藏嗎？
你已經擁有了咒語的兩部分：
我已經把''^FF0000寶藏]^000000'那部分給你了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Anyway, now that the
Z Gang is captured,
it might be safe enough
for me to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
總之，既然Z幫已經被抓住了，
我大概可以安全地回家了。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Would you do me a favor,
and just get out of here
before someone finds
my hiding place?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你能不能幫個忙，
在有人發現我的藏身之處之前離開這裡？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Aren't you going to
dig up that treasure?
You have both parts of
the spell that you need:
I already gave you the
''^FF0000Sesame]^000000'' part, right?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你難道不打算挖出那個寶藏嗎？
你已經擁有了咒語的兩部分：
我已經把''^FF0000芝麻]^000000'那部分給你了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Anyway, now that the
Z Gang is captured,
it might be safe enough
for me to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
總之，既然Z幫已經被抓住了，
我大概可以安全地回家了。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Would you do me a favor,
and just get out of here
before someone finds
my hiding place?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你能不能幫個忙，
在有人發現我的藏身之處之前離開這裡？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Heh! Looks like it's
safe for me to come out
of hiding, and just go home!
But maybe I should stick
around here a little longer,
just to be on the safe side.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
嘿！看來我可以出來
回家去了！
但也許我應該在這裡再待一會兒，
以防萬一。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're carrying too many
items: there's no way you
can carry the Treasure
Chest with you for now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你攜帶的物品太多了：
目前你無法攜帶寶箱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something
here, buried just
beneath the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有什麼東西，
埋在地下。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unngh! I-it won't...!

^3355FFNo matter how hard
you try, you can't dig
out the chest or open it.
There's some magical
aura surrounding the chest
that might be stopping you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF無論你怎麼努力，
都無法挖出或開啟箱子。
箱子周圍似乎有某種魔法氣息，
可能阻止了你。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat Treasure Hunter in
Morocc must know something
about the chest's magical
protection. It might be
a good idea to ask him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF莫洛克的尋寶獵人
一定知道關於箱子魔法防護的事。
也許最好去問問他。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tried casting the
spell on the document
you received, but nothing
happened. You should probably
find the other man over in
Comodo to see what he knows.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你嘗試對你收到的紙條施法，
但什麼也沒發生。
你應該去克魔島找另一個男人，
看看他是否知道些什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'll need to combine
the two halves of the spell
on the document you received
to remove the chest's magical
protection to get the treasure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你需要組合你收到的紙條上的
咒語兩半，以移除箱子的魔法防護
並獲得寶藏。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Z Gang must have split
the spell document in two
parts because one person
isn't enough to open this
chest. It's a good thing
you brought a friend.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFZ幫一定把咒語紙條分成了兩部分，
因為一個人不足以開啟這個箱子。
幸好你帶了朋友。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cast the spell,
the chest opens, and
you grab all the loot inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你施放了咒語，
箱子打開了，
你拿走了裡面的所有戰利品。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no! What's going on?
This Emerald... It must
be cursed by evil magic!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！發生什麼事了？
這顆祖母綠...它一定
被邪惡的魔法詛咒了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You might not be
combining the spell
correctly. Perhaps if
you made it all one word...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼也沒發生。
你可能沒有正確組合咒語。
也許如果你把它變成一個詞...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe treasure chest still
won't open. Then again,
this doesn't seem to be
a one man job...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF寶箱依然沒有開啟。不過話說回來，
這似乎不是一個人能完成的工作...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomone must have
checked the treasure
site after you left:
whoever it was left
telltale signs of
his presence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在你離開後，一定有人
檢查過寶藏地點：
無論那是誰，都留下了
他存在過的明顯跡象。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
I'm an antique appraiser.
You may think of me as similar
to jewel appraisers, but I can
appraise the historical value
of antiques in addition to their quality and monetary value.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
我是一名古董鑑定師。
你可以把我看作類似珠寶鑑定師的人，
但我不僅能鑑定古董的品質和金錢價值，
還能鑑定其歷史價值。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Oooh. You must be the
one sent by Ibrahim, right?
You're the one that found
that rare emerald, one of
the accursed jewels?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
哦。你一定是易卜拉欣派來的人吧？
你就是那個發現了稀有祖母綠的人，
那是被詛咒的寶石之一？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
I'm very interested in the
Cursed Jewels, and have been
researching them. You came
to just the right person if you
wanted to learn more about
the emerald that you found.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
我對被詛咒的寶石非常感興趣，
並且一直在研究它們。如果你想了解更多
關於你發現的那顆祖母綠的資訊，
你來對人了。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Hello, how may
I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
你好，今天有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Ask About Cursed Jewel
scripts.translation: 詢問關於被詛咒的寶石

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came to ask you
about a Cursed Jewel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來是想向你詢問
關於一顆被詛咒的寶石的事。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Let's see... Ah, did
you come to ask about
the Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
讓我看看...啊，你是來詢問
關於“毀滅之鑽”的事嗎？

scripts.text: No, it's the Unlucky Emerald.
scripts.translation: 不，是異樣的綠寶石。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Ah, the Unlucky Emerald?
Yes, that was the most recent
Cursed Jewel to be discovered.
Let's see, where did I put all
of my notes about that?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
啊，異樣的綠寶石？
是的，那是最近被發現的一顆被詛咒的寶石。
讓我看看，我把關於它的所有筆記
放在哪裡了呢？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Would you mind coming
back later? I'm not sure
where I misplaced my notes...
scripts.translation:
[學者]
你介意稍後再來嗎？我不確定
我把筆記放在哪裡了...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Ah, let's see now.
There's a record here
entitled, ''The Story of the
Cursed Jewel.'' According
to this, no one knows where
these jewels were first found.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
啊，讓我看看。
這裡有一份記錄，標題是
《被詛咒的寶石的故事》。根據這份記錄，
沒有人知道這些寶石最初是在哪裡被發現的。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The first incident involving
the jewel involved a Comodo
resident that used the jewel
to pay a gambling debt. He
committed suicide after he
paid his debt, which is a pity.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
涉及該寶石的第一起事件，
是一位克魔島居民用這顆寶石
償還賭債。他在還完債後
自殺了，這真令人惋惜。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
He didn't tell anyone
where he found the jewel
before he died, so we have
no way of determining the
jewel's true origins.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
他在死前沒有告訴任何人
他是在哪裡發現這顆寶石的，
所以我們無法確定寶石的真正來源。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
After it was sold, the
jewel came into a rich man's
possession. However, he lost
his fortune and was completely
ruined after obtaining it. Hence the moniker, ''Unlucky Emerald.''
scripts.translation:
[學者]
寶石被賣出後，
落入了一位富商手中。然而，
他在得到寶石後失去了財富，
徹底破產了。因此得名“異樣的綠寶石”。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Then the emerald came into
the hands of a noble lady
who mysteriously died at
a young age. The emerald's
had thousands of owners
who just... Died.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
隨後，這顆祖母綠落入了一位
貴族女士手中，她神秘地
英年早逝。這顆祖母綠
曾有數千位主人，他們只是...死了。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
What's disturbing is that
the emerald's curse seems
to grow stronger with each
life it takes away. Um, and
your jewel perfectly matches
the descriptions, so, uh...
scripts.translation:
[學者]
令人不安的是，
這顆祖母綠的詛咒似乎
隨著它奪去的生命而變得更強。
嗯，而且你的寶石完全符合
描述，所以，呃...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
You are the new owner
of the Unlucky Emerald.
No one will buy that from
you while it's still cursed.
For the sake of your life,
you must break that curse.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
你就是異樣的綠寶石的新主人。
只要詛咒還在，沒有人會買它。
為了你的性命，
你必須解除那個詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Now, holy spells won't work
on this kind of curse. You'll
need to talk to a shaman.
I think he lives in... Alberta?
He can summon the dead
and act as a medium for you.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
現在，神聖法術對這種詛咒無效。
你需要去找薩滿。
我想他住在...艾爾貝塔？
他可以召喚亡靈，
並作為你的媒介。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The idea is for you to talk
to the spirits killed by this
emerald through that shaman.
And I'm sure he'll be pretty
excited to see that you have
the Unlucky Emerald with you.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
你的任務是通過那位薩滿，
與這顆綠寶石殺害的亡靈對話。
我相信他看到你帶著
“異樣的綠寶石”會非常興奮。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Please find that shaman
in Alberta, and ask if he can
help you break the curse
on that Unlucky Emerald.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
請去艾爾貝塔找到那位薩滿，
問問他能否幫你解除
“異樣的綠寶石”上的詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Wait, you're telling me
that the emerald was cursed
by the vindictive spirit of
some warrior? Interesting...
I should record this in my
research notes. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[學者]
等等，你是說這顆綠寶石
是被某個戰士的怨靈詛咒的？
有意思...
我應該把這個記錄在
研究日誌裡。謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Some jewels are said to
be possessed by ghosts
or evil spirits that will bring
misfortune to their owners,
drive them to death or
insanity, that sort of thing.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
據說有些寶石被幽靈
或邪惡的精靈附身，
會給主人帶來厄運，
甚至導致死亡或瘋狂，
諸如此類的事情。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
The spiritual realm is
the source of my sorcery.
Do not understimate the
power of the spirits!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
靈界是我法術的源泉。
不要低估精靈的力量！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Oh? Heh heh!
You're carrying
something very
valuable, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
哦？嘿嘿！
你身上帶著
非常貴重的東西，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You! Yes... I can sense
them... The angry spirits of
your ancestors! You haven't
made any offerings to them,
have you? You must appease
them before they torment you!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
你！是的...我能感覺到...
你祖先憤怒的亡靈！
你沒有給他們供奉，
對吧？在他們折磨你之前，
你必須安撫他們！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Quickly, now! It is
imperative that you give me
500,000 zeny immediately
so that I can comfort their
souls before they wreck
havoc on your life!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
快一點！你必須立刻
給我500,000 Zeny，
這樣我才能安撫他們的靈魂，
以免他們擾亂你的生活！

scripts.text: Actually, I have a Cursed Jewel.
scripts.translation: 其實，我有一顆被詛咒的寶石。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Jewel...? Oh, a Cursed
Jewel! Hahaha! So that's
what that evil aura was!
My mistake! Say, do you
mind if I take a look at it?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
寶石...？哦，是被詛咒的寶石！
哈哈！原來那股邪惡的靈氣
是那個！我的錯！
請問，你介意我看一眼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
So this bauble's the
Unlucky Emerald? Yes,
it's definitely cursed.
If you don't break the
curse soon, it'll consume
your soul. Not a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
所以這個小玩意就是
“異樣的綠寶石”？是的，
它確實被詛咒了。
如果你不盡快解除詛咒，
它會吞噬你的靈魂。這可不好。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
I need to perform
a ritual to break the
curse. I'll charge you
200,000 zeny for the service.
It's expensive, but I'm saving
your life and risking mine.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
我需要舉行儀式來解除詛咒。
這項服務收費200,000 Zeny。
雖然很貴，但我是在救你的命，
同時也冒著我自己的風險。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hm? Did you forget to
bring the jewel? Hurry,
and bring it back to me.
You need to break that
curse before the jewel
can devour your soul!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
嗯？你忘了帶寶石？
快，把它帶回來給我。
在寶石吞噬你的靈魂之前，
你必須解除那個詛咒！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Did you bring the money?
We must appease the spirits
possessing the soul, and to
do that, I will need to perform
a ritual that will be taxing
on my body and spirit.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
你帶錢了嗎？
我們必須安撫附身於靈魂中的精靈，
為此，我需要舉行一個
對我身心消耗很大的儀式。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Good, good. I see that
you've brought the money.
I can now begin the ritual.
If all goes well, you'll be
free of your curse, and I can
buy some Prontera real estate.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
很好，很好。我看到
你帶了錢。
我現在可以開始儀式了。
如果一切順利，你就能擺脫詛咒，
而我也可以買一些普隆德拉的房產了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Please come back soon
after I've completed the
preparations for the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
請在我完成儀式準備後
儘快回來。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You... You don't have
200,000 zeny? I'm sorry,
but I cannot perform the
ritual for free, even if
your soul is at stake.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
你...你沒有200,000 Zeny？
很抱歉，即使你的靈魂
危在旦夕，我也不能免費
為你舉行儀式。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hmm... You know the
money you gave me?
Apparently, it wasn't
enough. One of the spirits
was about to enter me, but...
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
嗯...你知道你給我的錢嗎？
顯然，那不夠。其中一個精靈
差點進入我的身體，但是...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
It left in disgust after
it learned that I was trying
to break the curse for only
200,000 zeny. I think...
I think I need 100,000 zeny
more for this to be effective.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
它得知我只收了200,000 Zeny
就試圖解除詛咒後，
憤怒地離開了。我想...
我想還需要100,000 Zeny
才能生效。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Good, you've returned!
Did you bring the 100,000
zeny like I asked? It's a small
price considering that I'm
saving your very soul.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
很好，你回來了！
你按我說的帶了100,000 Zeny嗎？
考慮到我是在救你的靈魂，
這算是個小數目了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Ah, perfect!
Hopefully, the
spirits will be more
cooperative this time.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
啊，完美！
希望這次精靈們
會更配合一些。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Yes, the vindictive
spirit in this jewel
will be most impressed
by your sincere efforts.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
是的，這顆寶石中
充滿怨恨的精靈，
一定會被你的
真誠所打動。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You didn't? Do you know
what it's like to have
your soul consumed? Let
me tell you, it's a lot
more painful than parting
with a paltry 100,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
你沒帶？你知道
靈魂被吞噬是什麼
感覺嗎？讓我告訴你，
那比失去區區100,000 Zeny
要痛苦得多！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
At long last, the
spirits and I are one.
The ritual may now begin.
Ohhhhhhhhhhhmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
終於，精靈與我
合二為一了。
儀式可以開始了。
噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hhhkkk... Arrrgh...!

[Shaman]
Th-this emerald!
So many lives! Money
alone won't break this
curse! It's time to get
serious and suppress
this jewel's power!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
這...這顆綠寶石！
這麼多生命！
光靠錢是無法解除
這個詛咒的！是時候
認真起來，壓制
這顆寶石的力量了！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Remember the items
I tell you to bring, and
come back with them
as quickly as you can!
Both of our lives are in
danger until you do!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
記住我讓你帶的物品，
並儘快帶著它們回來！
在你做到之前，
我們兩人的生命
都處於危險之中！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Bring me
^FF00001 Holy Water^000000,
^FF00001 Red Blood^000000,
^FF00001 Witherless Rose^000000,
^FF00001 Crystal Blue^000000, and
^FF00001 Wind of Verdure^000000.

[Shaman]
Hurry! Although the spirits
are eternal, they don't like
to be kept waiting! Don't
question this great irony,
and get those items now!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
快一點！雖然精靈是
永恆的，但它們不喜歡
被人等待！不要質疑
這種偉大的諷刺，
現在就去拿那些物品！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You brought the items?!
Quickly! Place them in
my hands! We can't afford
to waste any more time!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
你帶了物品來？！
快！把它們放在
我手裡！我們不能再
浪費任何時間了！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Thank goodness.
Now... Let me begin...
Uhhkk... Argh! Wait!
I... I see someone...
Covered in blood? Yes...
He's staring at something.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
謝天謝地。
現在...讓我開始...
呃...啊！等等！
我...我看到一個人...
渾身是血？是的...
他正盯著什麼東西看。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
There's a sword behind it.
He's... He's just been in
a fight? I can smell...
His bloodlust. I can't tell
if he cursed the jewel of
if he's another victim...
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
它後面有一把劍。
他...他剛經歷過
一場戰鬥？我能聞到...
他的嗜血氣息。我無法判斷
他是詛咒了這顆寶石，
還是另一個受害者...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Damn it! It's not clear
to me! We need to figure
out if what I'm seeing is
the root of the curse...
What can we do to--Right!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
該死！我不清楚！
我們需要弄清楚
我看到的是否是
詛咒的根源...
我們能做什麼——對了！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
I'm not sure how helpful
he'll be, but there is an
archaeologist in Juno that
might know more about this
specific jewel. Hopefully,
he will have the answer.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
我不確定他會有多
有幫助，但朱諾有一位
考古學家，他可能
對這顆特定的寶石
瞭解更多。希望
他能找到答案。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
For now, the jewel's
curse is beyond my power.
However, if you can determine
the source of the curse, then
I will be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
目前，這顆寶石的
詛咒超出了我的能力。
但是，如果你能確定
詛咒的來源，那麼
我就能幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You... Forgot?!
Your body and soul are in
jeopardy and you forgot?!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
你...忘了？！
你的身體和靈魂都
處於危險之中，
你卻忘了？！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Bring me
^FF00001 Holy Water^000000,
^FF00001 Red Blood^000000,
^FF00001 Witherless Rose^000000,
^FF00001 Crystal Blue^000000, and
^FF00001 Wind of Verdure^000000!

[Shaman]
That antique appraiser...
He wouldn't know anything
more about the jewel, but
that archaeologist in Juno
will hopefully have some
new information we can use.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
那個古董鑑定師...
他可能不會知道
關於這顆寶石的更多
資訊，但朱諾的那位
考古學家應該會有一些
我們可以利用的新資訊。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Ah, you're back.
So did you learn
anything new about
the Unlucky Emerald?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
啊，你回來了。
那麼，你關於
異樣的綠寶石
瞭解到什麼新情況了嗎？

scripts.text: The archaeologist said...
scripts.translation: 考古學家說...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The archaeologist said...
Well, he said that there
is no curse on the jewel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
考古學家說...
他說，這顆寶石上
並沒有詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
What? How dare he refute
what I just told you?!
Is he calling me a liar?
There was a vindictive
warrior's soul inside
that very emerald!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
什麼？他竟敢反駁
我剛才告訴你的話？！
他是在說我在撒謊嗎？
那顆綠寶石裡
明明封印著一個
充滿怨恨的戰士靈魂！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Then again, there's no
point fighting someone
that doesn't believe in
the spirit realm. However,
I wasn't lying. My honor
as a shaman is at stake!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
不過，跟一個不相信
靈界存在的人爭論
也沒有意義。但我沒有撒謊，
我作為薩滿的榮譽
不容有失！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
In fact, I'll prove it to you
by reading the message
inside this emerald. Bring
me the jewel, and I'll summon
the warrior spirit inside it.
Just let me rest a bit first.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
事實上，我會向你證明。
通過解讀這顆綠寶石
內部的資訊。把寶石
帶給我，我會召喚
裡面的戰士靈魂。
不過，請讓我先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Alright. By my pride
as a shaman, I'll provide
this service to you free
of charge! Can't have
anyone thinking I'm
some kind of quack...
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
好吧。以我作為薩滿
的尊嚴起誓，我會
免費為你提供這項服務！
不能讓任何人覺得
我是個江湖騙子...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hmmmm...
Hmmmm...
I... I see.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
嗯...
嗯...
我...我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Huh. Well, what do you
know? There is no curse.
However, it's not true that
only Comodo's prodigal son
was killed over this jewel.
There are many more...
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
哈。真是的，居然
沒有詛咒。不過，
關於這顆寶石，
被殺死的不僅僅是
科摩多龍的浪子。
還有很多人...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Go yonder to the town
of Geffen, head west, and
seek the high ground that
is over the bridge. You know...
Leave Geffen through the west
gate and find a high place.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
去吉芬鎮，往西走，
尋找那座橋上方的
高地。你知道的...
從吉芬西門出去，
找一個高一點的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Trust me. You'll find
something there that will
react to the power of that
emerald you possess.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
相信我。你會在那裡
找到一些東西，
它會對你手中
那顆綠寶石的力量
產生反應。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hmpf! That arrogant
archaeologist! He doesn't
know what he's talking about!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
哼！那個傲慢的
考古學家！他根本
不知道自己在說什麼！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You don't have the
emerald with you?
I hope you didn't
lose it somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
你沒有帶綠寶石嗎？
希望你沒有把它
弄丟在什麼地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Go yonder to the town
of Geffen, head west, and
seek the high ground that
is over the bridge. You know...
Leave Geffen through the west
gate and find a high place.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
去吉芬鎮，往西走，
尋找那座橋上方的
高地。你知道的...
從吉芬西門出去，
找一個高一點的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Trust me. You'll find
something there that will
react to the power of that
emerald you possess.
Don't forget to bring
that emerald with you!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
相信我。你會在那裡
找到一些東西，
它會對你手中
那顆綠寶石的力量
產生反應。
別忘了帶上那顆綠寶石！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
What did I tell you?
That jewel brings very
bad fortune. Though, I'm
not sure why the warrior
spirit inside wouldn't talk
to me. What's with that?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
我跟你說過什麼？
那顆寶石會帶來
極大的厄運。雖然，
我不明白為什麼裡面的
戰士靈魂不肯跟我說話。
這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
It's been a long time
since I've done these
rituals. I feel thoroughly
drained of my spiritual energy.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿]
我已經很久沒有
進行過這種儀式了。
我感覺我的靈力
被徹底耗盡了。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
There's so much to do!
How am I going to handle
all of this research? Don't
panic, don't panic, just
one thing at a time!
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
要做的事情太多了！
我該怎麼處理
所有的研究？別慌，
別慌，一次只做一件事！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Oh, I've heard about you
from that antique appraiser
in Comodo... You're the one
that dig up the Unlucky
Emerald, right? Would
you mind if I take a look?
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
哦，我聽說克魔島
那個古董鑑定師
提起過你...你就是
挖出異樣綠寶石的人，
對吧？介意我
看一眼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Ah, it's no wonder so
many people want it.
This emerald is so huge
and... It's beautiful! So...
I'm guessing you needed
my help with something?
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
啊，難怪那麼多人
想要它。這顆綠寶石
這麼大，而且...真美！
那麼...我猜你是
需要我幫忙解決
什麼問題？

scripts.text: Ask About the Jewel's Curse
scripts.translation: 詢問寶石的詛咒

scripts.text: Show Off Jewel
scripts.translation: 展示寶石

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
The jewel's curse?
Hah! You believe in that
old superstition? Oh, so
you wanted to break the
jewel's curse? Mmpf. Hahah!
You're not dead yet, right?
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
寶石的詛咒？
哈！你相信那種
老迷信嗎？哦，原來
你是想解除寶石的詛咒？
唔。哈哈！
你還沒死，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
It's all a load of bunk!
Only one man died while
keeping this jewel in his
possession, that gambler in
Comodo that used it to pay
off his gambling debts.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
那全是胡扯！
只有一個人因為
持有這顆寶石而死，
就是克魔島那個
用它來償還賭債的賭徒。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
This jewel happened to be
lost for a long time, and it
just reappeared. That's all.
Lots of myths and legends
surround extremely valuable
gems like this one.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
這顆寶石只是
遺失了很久，
現在重新出現了而已。
像這樣極其珍貴的寶石，
周圍總是圍繞著
許多神話和傳說。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Anyway, there's no curse.
Believe what you want to,
but that happens to be my
professional opinion,
based on my research.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
總之，沒有詛咒。
你愛信不信，
但根據我的研究，
這是我的專業意見。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Wow...
That jewel sure
is freakin' huge...
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
哇...
這顆寶石
真是大得離譜...

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
You lost the jewel?
Well, maybe it's not
all bad. History shows
that many people were
ruined by suddenly coming
upon vast fortunes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
你弄丟了寶石？
嗯，也許這並不全是壞事。
歷史表明，許多人
因為突然獲得鉅額財富
而身敗名裂，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
The vindictive soul
of a warrior is just
drifting around in the
world of the living?
I don't think I want to
believe what you're saying.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
一個戰士的復仇之魂
只是在人間遊蕩？
我不太想相信
你說的話。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
I personally feel that
old shaman's a fraud, but...
You should have the freedom
to decide what you believe.
But don't let it bother you.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
我個人覺得
那個老薩滿是個騙子，但是...
你有權利決定
自己相信什麼。
不過別讓它困擾你。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Are you talking about
ghosts again? Fine. For
the sake of the argument,
let's say the jewel actually
possesses the soul of
some fallen warrior.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
你又在說幽靈了？
好吧。為了爭論，
假設這顆寶石真的
擁有某個陣亡戰士的靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
It's not unfathomable for
people with huge debts to
kill themselves, or for
warriors to perish while
fighting Cobolds. Still...
I'll see what I can learn.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
負債累累的人自殺，
或者戰士在與哥布林戰鬥中喪生，
這並不令人費解。不過...
我會看看能瞭解到什麼。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
That reminds me...
I've got some records about
an adventurer group that died
in the field west of Geffen
that you were talking about.
Let me see if I can find them.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
這讓我想起...
我有一些關於一個冒險者團體
在吉芬以西的野外陣亡的記錄，
就是你提到的那個。
讓我看看能不能找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Ah, you're back! I found
those records I told you
about. It's a witness's
account of what happened
when those people died
west of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
啊，你回來了！我找到了
我告訴你的那些記錄。
這是目擊者對吉芬以西
那些人死時發生情況的描述。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
What's interesting is that
the warrior you keep talking
about wasn't killed by Cobolds
at all, according to what this
guy wrote. Let's see...
Ah, it's over here.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
有趣的是，根據這個人寫的，
你一直提到的那個戰士
根本不是被哥布林殺死的。
讓我看看...
啊，在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
''^666666When the chief and his
soldiers arrived, the battle
was over. Dead bodies lay
everywhere, but there was
one warrior covered in blood,
half conscious, but living.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
“^666666當首領和他計程車兵到達時，
戰鬥已經結束。到處都是屍體，
但有一個戰士渾身是血，
半昏迷狀態，但還活著。^000000”

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Strange, isn't it?
This is from a journal
written by a retired soldier
that lives in Prontera now.
It might be a good idea to
see if you can talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
奇怪，不是嗎？
這是來自一名退役士兵的日記，
他現在住在普隆德拉。
也許你可以去和他談談。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
There's a retired soldier
that actually witnessed what
happened in the field west
of Geffen. You should try
to find him in Prontera, and
see what you can learn.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
有一名退役士兵
實際上目睹了吉芬以西
野外發生的事情。你應該
試著在普隆德拉找到他，
看看能瞭解到什麼。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Ah, that's... That's
very profound. That one
warrior went berserk when
he realized he was too weak
to protect his comrades?
He lost total control...
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
啊，這...這
非常深刻。那個戰士
在意識到自己太弱，
無法保護他的同志時
陷入了狂暴狀態？
他完全失去了控制...

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
I better talk to that
old soldier and get the
full story on record.
It'll be a really good history
lesson for Swordmen everywhere.
Thank you for letting me know.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
我最好去和那個老士兵談談，
把完整的故事記錄下來。
這對各地的劍士來說
將是一堂很好的歷史課。
謝謝你告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
I'm so busy! Listen,
would you mind coming
back later when I'm not
so swamped with work?
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
我太忙了！聽著，
你介意稍後再來嗎？
等我沒那麼忙的時候。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Why are you carrying
so much stuff with you?
Isn't there a Kafra Storage
service for keeping your junk?
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
你為什麼帶著
這麼多東西？
卡普拉不是有倉庫服務
可以存放你的雜物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
It's strange that so
many people have been
wanting to talk to me for
some reason, but I'll
admit that it's kind of nice.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
奇怪，最近怎麼有
這麼多人想找我談話？
不過說實話，
這種感覺還挺不錯的。

scripts.text: Ask About Past Battles
scripts.translation: 詢問過去的戰鬥

scripts.text: Ask About Fallen Warrior
scripts.translation: 詢問那位倒下的戰士

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Don't get me started.
Once I start talking about
the old days, I'll go on all
night. Those were real hard
times to live through, but good
memories to remember...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
別讓我開始回憶。
一旦談起往事，
我可能整晚都停不下來。
那是段艱難的日子，
但也是值得銘記的美好回憶...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
The fallen warrior...?
There's only one that brings
a chill down my spine whenever
I think of him. He was about
your age when it happened...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
倒下的戰士...？
每當想起那個人，
我就感到脊背發涼。
事發時，他和你差不多大...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
We received a report about
a Cobold threat, so we were
dispatched to the fields
west of Geffen. But the
battle was over once we
arrived. We were too late.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我們收到了關於哥布林的報告，
於是被派往吉芬以西的野外。
但當我們趕到時，戰鬥已經結束了。
我們太遲了。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
All the Cobolds were slain,
but... There was one warrior
left, covered in blood. When
he saw us, he just started
attacking everyone! He
had completely lost it.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
所有的哥布林都被殺死了，
但...還剩下一個戰士，渾身是血。
他看到我們時，
突然開始攻擊所有人！
他完全失控了。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
We had no choice but to
kill him. It was self defense,
but I can't help but pity him.
All his comrades had been
killed: I can't imagine how
that must have felt.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我們別無選擇，只能殺了他。
那是正當防衛，
但我忍不住同情他。
他的所有同志都死了：
我無法想像那會是種什麼感受。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
We arrived too late to
see that battle, but I'm
pretty sure it was horrific.
You must be pretty interested
in learning about this soldier.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我們趕到時沒能看到那場戰鬥，
但我確信那場面一定很慘烈。
看來你對這位士兵
很感興趣，想了解他的故事。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well, I'm just glad that you
were able to know more
about this story. There's
much you can learn from
other people's experiences.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
嗯，很高興你能
更多地瞭解這個故事。
從別人的經歷中，
你可以學到很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
I don't regret that we
had to kill that warrior.
We did had we had to
back in those days.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我不後悔我們不得不
殺死那位戰士。
在那樣的年代，
我們只能那樣做。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Oh, it's you again.
Did you want to ask me
more about that warrior?
I'm afraid I already told
you everything I know.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
哦，又是你啊。
你還想問我關於
那位戰士的事嗎？
恐怕我已經把知道的
都告訴你了。

scripts.text: Sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text: I met the warrior's spirit.
scripts.translation: 我見到了那位戰士的精靈。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
It's fine.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
What? How is that
even possible?
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
什麼？這怎麼可能？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou explain to the
retired soldier everything
that has happened so far.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF向退役士兵解釋
目前為止發生的一切。^000000

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
That's quite a story.
Still, I'm surprised that
he didn't want to talk to
you about what happened.
I guess he still harbors
bad feelings about that day...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
真是個離奇的故事。
不過，我還是很驚訝，
他居然不想和你談談
那天發生的事。
我想他可能還對那天
懷有不好的情緒...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well, I guess it doesn't
really matter now. Chalk
this all up to a really good
learning experience.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
嗯，我想現在
這已經不重要了。
把這當作一次
很好的學習經歷吧。

scripts.text: I feel so sorry for him.
scripts.translation: 我為他感到難過。

scripts.text: Do you believe the jewel is really cursed?
scripts.translation: 你相信那顆寶石真的被詛咒了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well...
I don't know what to tell
you. I mean, you can't really
put the blame on anybody.
He just lost his mind...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
唉...
我不知道該說什麼。
總之，你不能怪任何人。
他只是...失去了理智...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
I'm not really sure if the
jewel was cursed, if that
warrior started the curse,
or if the jewel isn't cursed
at all. I'm just an old,
simple soldier.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我不確定那顆寶石是否被詛咒，
是那個戰士引發了詛咒，
還是寶石根本沒有詛咒。
我只是一個普通的
老士兵。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
One thing's for sure:
if there was a curse, that
soldier should have been
able to overcome it if his will
was strong enough. It's harsh
to say it like this, but...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
有一點是肯定的：
如果真的有詛咒，
那個戰士只要意志足夠堅定，
就應該能克服它。
這麼說可能很殘酷，但是...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
True warriors have the
strength to endure, to
fight temptation, to keep
their focus. That guy...
He wasn't cut out to fight.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
真正的戰士擁有
忍受痛苦、
抵抗誘惑、
保持專注的力量。
那個人...
他根本不適合戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
You know what?
If you're so worried
about a curse, why don't
you leave that jewel with me?
Don't worry, I'll make sure
to compensate you for it.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
你知道嗎？
如果你這麼擔心詛咒，
為什麼不把那顆寶石
留給我呢？
別擔心，我會補償你的。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
I'd rather keep it to myself,
rather than risk it messing
around with other people.
I know my will's tough enough
to resist its curse, you know,
if it actually exists.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我寧願自己留著，
也不願冒險讓它
去禍害別人。
我知道我的意志足夠堅定，
足以抵抗它的詛咒，
如果它真的存在的話。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
If there's anything
you learn from all this,
it's that you should never
succumb to your desperation.
Rage gives you nothing:
its power is an illusion.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
如果你從這一切中
學到了什麼，
那就是永遠不要
向絕望屈服。
憤怒帶不來任何東西：
它的力量是一種幻覺。

scripts.text:

If you're so worried
about a curse, why don't
you leave that jewel with me?
Don't worry, I'll make sure
to compensate you for it.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]

如果你這麼擔心詛咒，
為什麼不把那顆寶石
留給我呢？
別擔心，我會補償你的。

去禍害別人。
我知道我的意志足夠堅定，
足以抵抗它的詛咒，
如果它真的存在的話。

you learn from all this,
it's that you should never
succumb to your desperation.
Rage gives you nothing:

學到了什麼，
那就是永遠不要
向絕望屈服。
憤怒帶不來任何東西：
它的力量是一種幻覺。

If you're so worried
about a curse, why don't
you leave that jewel with me?
Don't worry, I'll make sure
to compensate you for it.
scripts.translation:

如果你這麼擔心詛咒，
為什麼不把那顆寶石
留給我呢？
別擔心，我會補償你的。

[Retired Soldier]
I'd rather keep it to myself,
rather than risk it messing
around with other people.
I know my will's tough enough
to resist its curse, you know,
if it actually exists.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我寧願自己留著，
也不願冒險讓它
去禍害別人。
我知道我的意志足夠堅定，
足以抵抗它的詛咒，
如果它真的存在的話。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well, you learned all there
is to know about the Unlucky
Emerald. It's time you forget
about the curse or whatever,
and find new adventures.
Ah, to be young again...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
好了，關於不幸的翡翠，
你已經知道了所有該知道的。
是時候忘記詛咒或別的什麼，
去尋找新的冒險了。
啊，要是能再年輕一次就好了...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Ah, how I long for
the old days. Being
retired is just so...
It's so boring! I guess
it's time to find a hobby.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
啊，我多麼懷念
過去的日子。
退休的生活真是...
太無聊了！我想
是時候找個愛好了。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I'm just a wanderer
drifting through this
world. Please just
leave me in peace.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我只是一個
在這個世界
漂泊的流浪者。
請讓我安靜地待著。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
That... That looks
just like the emerald
I used to own. Hmmm...
Did you come looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
那...那看起來
就像我曾經擁有的
那顆翡翠。嗯...
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Get rid of that thing right
now. It's an evil jewel that
causes tragedy wherever
it goes. I remember... I got
that jewel from monsters...
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
立刻把那東西扔掉。
它是一顆邪惡的寶石，
所到之處都會帶來悲劇。
我記得...我是從魔物那裡
得到那顆寶石的...

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I was just a simple man,
dreaming of becoming the
world's greatest warrior.
I had that emerald on me
when we encountered a huge
group of vicious Cobolds.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我只是一個普通人，
夢想著成為
世界上最偉大的戰士。
當我身上帶著那顆翡翠時，
我們遭遇了一大群
兇殘的哥布林。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
No matter how many
we killed, there was
just no end to them...
And then... We... We...
I... It hurts too much
to recall what happened...
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
無論我們殺了多少，
它們似乎永遠殺不完...
然後...我們...我們...
我...回憶起來太痛苦了...

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Why have you summoned me?
I'm just the soul of a fallen
warrior, seeking peace.
Please don't bother me
if you can avoid it.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
你為什麼要召喚我？
我只是一個
隕落戰士的靈魂，
在尋求安寧。
如果可以的話，
請不要打擾我。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
You again? Why do you still
hold the jewel?! Didn't I just
what happened to me and
my comrades! We all died
that day, that day the
Cobolds overpowered us!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
又是你？為什麼你還
拿著那顆寶石？！我不是
剛告訴你我和
我的同伴發生了什麼嗎！
那天我們都死了，
就是哥布林擊敗我們的那天！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Just let me return
to my slumber.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
讓我回到
我的沉睡中吧。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Why have you called
me here again? What
is it you want from me?
Can't you leave me alone?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
你為什麼又
把我叫到這裡？
你想要從我這裡得到什麼？
就不能讓我一個人待著嗎？

scripts.text: Were you really killed by Cobolds?
scripts.translation: 你真的是被哥布林殺死的嗎？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Argh! What is it you're
trying to say?! Leave now!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
啊！你到底想說什麼？！
現在就走！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Still you pester me.
Unfortunately, the power
of the jewel compels me
to return to this plane...
What is it this time?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
你還在糾纏我。
不幸的是，寶石的力量
迫使我回到這個世界...
這次又是什麼事？

scripts.text: You weren't killed by Cobolds, were you?
scripts.translation: 你不是被哥布林殺死的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
How many times must I tell
you? Are you saying that
I'm lying about the deaths
of my comrades? Forget it.
The dead shouldn't talk.
It's a waste of my time.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我要告訴你多少遍？
你是在說我關於同伴
死亡的事在撒謊嗎？算了。
死者不應多言。
這是浪費我的時間。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Take care, young
adventurer, and don't
reopen the wounds of
the past anymore.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
保重，年輕的冒險者，
不要再揭開過去的傷疤了。

scripts.text: You killed your comrades!
scripts.translation: 是你殺了你的同伴！

scripts.text: Do you remember your last moment?
scripts.translation: 你還記得你最後的時刻嗎？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Did I...? Ha. Haha!
adventurer, but that sounds
like something from a trashy
novel. Hah hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我...？哈。哈哈！
冒險者，但這聽起來
像是低俗小說裡的橋段。
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
It's a little hazy...
I... We tried to kill as
many Cobolds as we 
could... Everyone was...
Everyone was dead.
Everyone but me.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
有點模糊...
我...我們試圖殺死
儘可能多的哥布林...
所有人都...
所有人都死了。
除了我。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I was all alone.
We killed all the
Cobolds, but I was...
Then... The next thing...
I was covered in blood.
Then, something appeared?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我孤身一人。
我們殺光了所有
哥布林，但我...
然後...接下來...
我渾身是血。
然後，有什麼東西出現了？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
No, it can't have been.
A human soldier like me?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
不，不可能。
像我這樣的人類士兵？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I was killed... No, wait.
I survived the battle with
the Cobolds. Then, some
coward killed me from
behind, and stole my
emerald. That must be it!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我死了...不，等等。
我在與哥布林的戰鬥中倖存了下來。然後，某個
懦夫從背後殺了我，並偷走了我的
祖母綠。一定是這樣！

scripts.text: How did your comrades die?
scripts.translation: 你的同伴是怎麼死的？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
The Cobolds killed them!
I was too weak to protect
my comrades. Too weak...
When I came back to my
senses, they were all...
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
是哥布林殺了他們！
我太弱了，無法保護
我的同伴。太弱了...
當我恢復意識時，他們都...

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I'm not sure what
happened. There was
blood coming into my eyes...
I remember slashing, and
stabbing, and... And slashing.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我不確定發生了什麼。有
血湧進我的眼睛...
我記得在揮砍，刺擊，還有...還有揮砍。

scripts.text: You slashed everything...
scripts.translation: 你砍殺了一切...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You slashed everything...
Even the comrades you
were supposed to protect.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你砍殺了一切...
甚至包括你本該保護的同伴。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I... I did...?
I... No! Shut up!
Stop it! I couldn't...
Get out of here now!
You're trying to trick me!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我...我做了...？
我...不！閉嘴！
別說了！我不可能...
現在離開這裡！
你是在耍我！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
What is it?
What could you
possibly have to
say to me this time?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
怎麼了？
你這次還能
對我說什麼？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
別纏著我！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Shut up! Stop harassing
me! I can't... I don't...!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
閉嘴！別纏著我！
我...我不可能...！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
.........

[{0}]
This must be the place
that shaman was talking
about. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡應該就是那個薩滿
提到的地方。讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be the place
that shaman was talking
about. Let's see now...
Wait. I need that emerald...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡應該就是那個薩滿
提到的地方。讓我看看...
等等。我需要那塊祖母綠...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Ah, it's very nice and
refreshing to be near this
fountain. It's much cooler
here than back in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克旅行者]
啊，在這個噴泉附近
真的很涼爽舒適。
這裡比夢羅克那邊涼快多了。

scripts.text: Nice day today, huh?
scripts.translation: 今天天氣不錯，是吧？

scripts.text: How's Morocc lately?
scripts.translation: 最近夢羅克怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Oh, yes. It's a wonderful
day! Prontera is so sunny
and cool. No wonder so
many people live over here!
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克旅行者]
哦，是的。今天真是個好天氣！
普隆德拉陽光明媚，氣候宜人。
難怪這麼多人住在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
You're an adventurer, and
you haven't heard the crazy
rumors spreading all over
the Rune-Midgarts kingdom?
I thought you guys traveled
around and heard things.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克旅行者]
你是冒險者，
難道沒聽說在盧恩·米德加茲王國
流傳的那些瘋狂謠言嗎？
我以為你們四處旅行，
應該能聽到各種訊息。

scripts.text: What crazy rumors?
scripts.translation: 什麼瘋狂謠言？

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Uh... Rogue agents!
They're all over the place!
Why don't you talk to some
of the Rogue agents dispatched
in the other towns? Then you'll
know what I'm talking about!
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克旅行者]
呃...流氓特工！
到處都是！
你為什麼不跟其他城鎮
派遣的流氓特工聊聊呢？
那樣你就會明白我在說什麼了！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Shouldn't you be
looking for a Rogue
agent to talk to?
I mean, maybe you
can pitch in and
help them out.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克旅行者]
你不應該去找一個
流氓特工聊聊嗎？
我是說，也許你可以
出點力，幫幫他們。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
So the Z Gang was what
those crazy rumors were
all about. Good to hear
that they're all in jail.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克旅行者]
原來那些瘋狂謠言
都是關於Z幫派的。
很高興聽到他們都進了監獄。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Hey, uh...
I'm just trying to
relax on my vacation.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克旅行者]
嘿，呃...
我只是想在假期裡放鬆一下。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
You're carrying too
much stuff on you.
Take a load off, put
your extra stuff in
Kafra Storage: that's
what's it's for~
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
你身上帶的東西太多了。
減輕點負擔，把多餘的東西
放進卡普拉倉庫吧：
那就是它的用途~

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Man, it feels much safer
hanging out in an alley
than some crowded joint.
Us Rogues... I guess you
can say we got a bit of
agoraphobia, naturally.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
天哪，在小巷裡閒逛
比在擁擠的地方感覺安全多了。
我們流氓...我想可以說
我們天生有點廣場恐懼症。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, I don't think
you're supposed to be
here. You better get
going on your way.
It's not a threat, just
a friendly word of advice.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，我覺得你不應該
在這裡。你最好趕緊離開。
這不是威脅，只是
一句善意的建議。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, I don't think
I can help you out.
You're pretty much
on your own from here.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，我覺得我幫不了你。
從這裡開始，你基本上
得靠自己了。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Huh. I hate clean-up
duty. It's always better
to make messes than to
hang around afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
哈。我討厭清理工作。
製造混亂總比
事後收拾殘局要好。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Yeah, we're investigating
the strange crimes that are
going on around the kingdom.
How'd you know about that?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
是的，我們正在調查
王國各地發生的
奇怪罪行。
你怎麼知道這件事的？

scripts.text: I was just...
scripts.translation: 我只是...

scripts.text: Can I help?
scripts.translation: 我能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Just what...?
Speak up, pal.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
只是什麼？
大聲點說，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
So you wanted to help
us out? Heck, we could
use the help, I guess.
I need you to go on a bit
of a trip for me, so get
some provisions ready, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
所以你想幫我們？
好吧，我們確實需要人手。
我需要你去跑一趟，
所以準備好乾糧，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
You all ready and
everything? Good.
Now, I need you to
deliver some intel to
the other Rogues for me.
Think you can do that?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
都準備好了嗎？很好。
現在，我需要你替我
把一些情報交給其他流氓。
你覺得你能做到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
First, I want you to
go to Al De Baran.
Find our guy, and help
him out any way you can.
Us Rogues are hard to
find, but you'll figure it out.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
首先，我要你去艾爾帕蘭。
找到我們的人，
儘可能幫他一把。
流氓很難找，
但你會搞定的。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I know that's probably
not enough instruction,
but that's just the first
step, anyway. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
我知道這指令可能不夠詳細，
但這只是第一步而已。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, you gotta get
goin' to Al De Baran,
and find one of us Rogues
working on the investigation.
I thought you wanted to help?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，你得趕緊去艾爾帕蘭，
找到正在調查的我們流氓之一。
你不是想幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Here's a bit of a tip~
Us Rogue agents usually
try to hide out in the
south side of towns.
Bit of a tradition.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
給你個小提示~
我們流氓特工通常
喜歡躲在城鎮的南邊。
算是個傳統吧。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
What's this, a report
from Al De Baran? 'Kay,
let me give it a read...
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
這是什麼，來自艾爾帕蘭的報告？
好的，讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Huh, okay. Looks like
your next stop is gonna
be in Geffen. Look for our
Geffen agent somewhere in
the South Geffen area, okay?
Ah, and take this note too.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嗯，好的。看來你的下一站
是吉芬。在吉芬南部區域
找到我們的吉芬特工，好嗎？
啊，還有，把這個便條也帶上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received
another folded note.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了
另一張摺疊的便條。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, why haven't you
left for Geffen? Our
agent oughta be in the
south side of town.
It's not far, so don't
throw a hissy fit.
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，你怎麼還沒去吉芬？
我們的特工應該在城鎮南邊。
不遠，所以別發脾氣。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Finally, the Z Gang
case is closed. Those
guys really gave us some
trouble. Why the hell did
they stir up so much ruckus
in the kingdom, anyhow?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
終於，Z幫的案件結束了。
那幫傢伙真讓我們頭疼。
他們到底為什麼要在王國
搞出這麼大的動靜？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Listen, I wanna thank
you for pitching in and
helping out. It's a small
gift, but maybe you'll
like it. If not, don't
lemme know. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
聽著，我想感謝你
之前的幫忙。這是個小禮物，
也許你會喜歡。如果不喜歡，
別告訴我。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Listen, I wanna thank
you for pitching in and
helping out. It's a small
gift, but maybe you'll
like it. If not, don't
lemme know. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
聽著，我想感謝你
之前的幫忙。這是個小禮物，
也許你會喜歡。如果不喜歡，
別告訴我。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, you were really
a big help earlier.
Can we count on you
again sometime? The
Rogues can always use
another friend, you know?
scripts.translation:
[公會成員]
嘿，你剛才幫了大忙。

scripts.text: Cooperate with this adventurer.
scripts.translation: 與這名冒險者合作。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So... We're partners?
Cool. Nice to meetcha.
I'm the Payon agent.
I guess we gotta work
together from now on.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
那麼...我們是
搭檔了？
酷。很高興認識你。
我是斐揚的特工。
看來從現在起
我們要一起工作了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You...
You can't read either?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你...
你也不會讀？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hahaha! Right on, right on.
Well, I'm pretty sure they
sent you to work with me.
When you're ready to get
to business, come back
and we'll talk, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哈哈！沒錯，沒錯。
我相當確定他們
派你來和我合作。
等你準備好
開始正事時，
回來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, I asked you
to read the note,
not run away! Now...
What's it say?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，我叫你
讀紙條，
不是讓你跑掉！
現在...
上面寫的是什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see,
the note says...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我看看，
紙條上寫著...

scripts.text: Cooperate with this adventurer.
scripts.translation: 與這名冒險者合作。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So... We're partners?
Cool. Nice to meetcha.
I'm the Payon agent.
I guess we gotta work
together from now on.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
那麼...我們是
搭檔了？
酷。很高興認識你。
我是斐揚的特工。
看來從現在起
我們要一起工作了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You...
You can't read either?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你...
你也不會讀？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hahaha! Right on, right on.
Well, I'm pretty sure they
sent you to work with me.
When you're ready to get
to business, come back
and we'll talk, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哈哈！沒錯，沒錯。
我相當確定他們
派你來和我合作。
等你準備好
開始正事時，
回來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Good, you're back.
We got a pretty big
job to take care of.
Lives are at stake,
all that jazz. Ready?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
很好，你回來了。
我們有一件
很大的任務要處理。
事關性命，
諸如此類。準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
The Z Gang poisoned
one of the water wells
here in Payon. All the
water's black now. We gotta
use Red Herbs to counter
that poison, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
Z幫在斐揚這裡
毒化了一口井。
現在水都變黑了。
我們必須用紅色藥草
來中和那種毒素，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So remember to
collect some ^FF0000Red Herbs^000000.
Don't forget: ^FF0000Red herbs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以記得去收集一些^FF0000紅色藥草^000000。
別忘了：^FF0000紅色藥草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Wait, that doesn't
sound right. Did I say
Red Herbs? I'm sorry,
I meant to say ^0000FFGreen
Herbs^000000. Bring me ^0000FF1 Green
Herb^000000, okay? *Phew~*
scripts.translation:
[特工]
等等，這聽起來不對勁。我剛才說的是紅色藥草嗎？抱歉，
我其實想說^0000FF綠色藥草^000000。請給我帶^0000FF1個綠色藥草^000000，好嗎？*呼~*

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Someone's poisoned
Payon's well water...
It's all black and
deadly now. I want you
to bring me a ^FF0000Red Herb^000000
so that we can fix this!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
有人毒化了斐揚的井水...
現在水全變黑了，而且很致命。我需要你帶給我
一株^FF0000紅色藥草^000000，這樣我們才能解決這個問題！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, you're back!
You're much quicker
that I thought you'd be~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你回來了！
你比我預想的要快多了~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, it's gonna take
a while to neutralize all
this poison, but I think
we did it. Hey, gimmie
some time to draw a report,
and then come back later, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好吧，中和所有毒素需要一點時間，
但我認為我們成功了。嘿，給我點時間寫份報告，
然後稍後再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Err?
Where's that
Green Herb?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
呃？
那株綠色藥草呢？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, you're back!
You're much quicker
that I thought you'd be~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你回來了！
你比我預想的要快多了~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Ah, a Green Herb!
Is that what I told
you to bring? 'Cause
I'm sure this is the
right one. Absolutely~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
啊，是綠色藥草！
這就是我叫你帶的那個嗎？
因為我確信這個是對的。絕對是~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, it's gonna take
a while to neutralize all
this poison, but I think
we did it. Hey, gimmie
some time to draw a report,
and then come back later, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好吧，中和所有毒素需要一點時間，
但我認為我們成功了。嘿，給我點時間寫份報告，
然後稍後再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, what are you
doin' with the Red Herb?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你拿著紅色藥草幹什麼？

scripts.text: You said a Red Herb...
scripts.translation: 你說的是紅色藥草...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, what?! Huh...
I guess I did. Eh, no
biggie. Hey, bring me
a Green Herb, will you?
That's the one I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，什麼？呃...
我想我確實說了。沒事，小問題。嘿，給我帶個綠色藥草，好嗎？
那個才是我想要的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, it's gonna take
a while to neutralize all
this poison, but I think
we did it. Hey, gimmie
some time to draw a report,
and then come back later, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好吧，中和所有毒素需要一點時間，
但我認為我們成功了。嘿，給我點時間寫份報告，
然後稍後再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Err?
Where's that
Green Herb?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
呃？
那株綠色藥草呢？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, you know what?
The well water is still
black. That means...
If the herb we used is
good... Then it's just
dyed black to scare people.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你知道嗎？
井水還是黑的。這意味著...
如果我們用的藥草是好的...那麼它只是被染黑來嚇唬人的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So to clean up the
water, we gotta use
a Counteragent, right?
Will you help me out?
I got a Karvodailnirol...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以要清理水源，我們必須使用中和劑，對吧？
你能幫個忙嗎？我有一瓶卡勒波迪藥水...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So if you bring me
^0000FF1 Alcohol^000000, we should
be totally good to
make a Counteragent.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以如果你給我帶^0000FF1個酒精^000000，我們應該
就能完全做好中和劑了。

scripts.text: Wait, Karvodailnirol?!
scripts.translation: 等等，卡勒波迪藥水？！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Yeah. Karvodailnirol.
What about it?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
是的。卡勒波迪藥水。
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You need Detrimindexta
to make a Counteragent,
not Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
製作中和劑需要帝特立米藥水，
而不是卡勒波迪藥水。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, really? Heh!
You're a lifesaver!
Detrimindexta, huh?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，是嗎？嘿！
你真是救星！
帝特立米藥水，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Don't worry, I got
that one too! All you
gotta do is bring Alcohol~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
別擔心，那個我也有！你只需要帶酒精來就好~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, just bring
me an Alcohol, and
I'll take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好了，只要給我帶個酒精，
剩下的交給我處理。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Everything's ready
except for the Alcohol.
Did you bring it?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
除了酒精，其他都準備好了。
你帶了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Great, now all we
have to do is wait.
Nice work, partner.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
太好了，現在只需要等待了。
幹得漂亮，搭檔。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You don't have it?
You didn't drink
the alcohol, did you?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你沒帶嗎？
你該不會把酒精喝了吧？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Everything's ready
except for the Alcohol.
Did you bring it?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
除了酒精，其他都準備好了。
你帶了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Great, now all we
have to do is wait.
Nice work, partner.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
太好了，現在只需要等待了。
幹得漂亮，搭檔。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You don't have it?
You didn't drink
the alcohol, did you?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你沒帶嗎？
你該不會把酒精喝了吧？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Um, I made a mistake
making the Counteragent...
I was supposed to use this
Detrimindexta, not the other
thing, Karvodailnirol, to
make the Counteragent.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
呃，我製作中和劑時搞錯了...
本來應該用帝特立米藥水，
而不是卡勒波迪藥水，
來製作中和劑的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Sorry, they both look
the same to me. And, well,
so do all the letters of
the alphabet. You mind
trying this out again?
Just 1 more Alcohol...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
抱歉，在我眼裡它們長得都一樣。而且，嗯，
字母表裡的所有字母對我來說也都一樣。
你介意再試一次嗎？
只需要再拿1個酒精來...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, I promise!
I won't screw it up
this time. We'll
do this for sure~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，我保證！
這次我絕對不會搞砸的。
我們一定能成功的~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh heh! Looks like
we solved the case!
The water wasn't really
poisoned... Just colored
to look suspicious. See?
Completely safe to drink.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿嘿！看來我們破案了！
水其實並沒有被毒害...
只是被染色了，看起來可疑而已。看吧？
完全安全，可以飲用。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, looks like
we're done here. You
mind taking my report over
to the next Rogue agent?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
總之，這裡的事情結束了。你
介意把我的報告帶給
下一位流氓特工嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Make sure to take
this to the guy in
Comodo, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
記得把這個交給
克魔島的那個人，好嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a note that
communicates solely
through doodles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了一張
僅通過塗鴉來傳達資訊的
便條。^000000

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Make sure to take
this to the guy in
Al De Baran, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
記得把這個交給
艾爾帕蘭的那個人，好嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a note that
communicates solely
through doodles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了一張
僅通過塗鴉來傳達資訊的
便條。^000000

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Be sure that the
Rogue agent over
in Al De Baran gets
my report, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
一定要確保艾爾帕蘭的
流氓特工收到
我的報告，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Huh, the guy in
Al De Baran wouldn't
take it? Oh! That's why!
I meant Comodo! You gotta
go to Comodo! Heh, my bad~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
咦，艾爾帕蘭的那個人
不肯收？哦！我明白了！
我是指克魔島！你得去克魔島！嘿嘿，我的錯~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Be sure that the
Rogue agent over
in Comodo gets
my report, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
一定要確保克魔島的
流氓特工收到
我的報告，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, partner, how's
it going? I'm sorry
if I'm a bit of a hassle
to work with. I might lack
book smarts, but I make
up for it some with my saavy.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，搭檔，最近怎麼樣？
抱歉，我可能有點麻煩。
我可能缺乏書本知識，
但我用我的機智來彌補。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You've got too many
things on you. Why
don't you put some
of it in Kafra Storage
before talking to me, eh?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你身上帶的東西太多了。為什
麼不先把一些放進卡普拉倉庫
再跟我說話呢，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You're the one
that helped take
down the Z Gang?
Heh! Good work~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你就是那個幫助
擊倒Z幫的傢伙？
嘿！幹得好~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Who are you? Hm.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你是誰？嗯。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You know, Rogues are
tricky and hard to catch,
so I'm gonna teach you to
carry yourself through some
self-discipline. Got it?
Discipline! You need it!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你知道嗎，流氓狡猾且難以捕捉，
所以我要教你通過
自我紀律來行事。明白了嗎？
紀律！你需要它！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
From here on out,
I want you to yell
''Yes, sir!'' when you
acknowledge my instructions.
You got that! Loud and clear!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
從現在開始，
我希望你在確認我的指示時
大喊“是，長官！”
你聽明白了嗎！大聲點！

scripts.text: Yes, Sir!
scripts.translation: 是，長官！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Right on, right on.
Hm. Let's try that again...
Let me hear you say it louder!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
很好，很好。
嗯。再試一次...
讓我聽聽，聲音再大一點！

scripts.text: Yes, Sir!
scripts.translation: 是，長官！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Nice!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
不錯！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Okay, now for your
training instructions...
There's a rumor that a monster
has invaded the village, but
I'm sure it's just someone
trying to scare the public.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好了，現在說說你的訓練任務...
有傳言說魔物入侵了村莊，
但我確信這只是有人在
試圖嚇唬公眾。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I'm pretty sure the, uh,
perp is wearing a mask to
fool people into thinkin'
fhe's monster. This means...
Your mission is to bring
me some monsters masks.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我相當確定，呃，
罪犯戴著面具，
想讓人誤以為他是魔物。這意味著...
你的任務是給我
帶一些魔物面具。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh...
What's your mission?!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿...
你的任務是什麼？！

scripts.text: Bring monster masks!
scripts.translation: 帶魔物面具！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Groove.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
酷。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, bring me
^FF00002 scary lookin'
monster masks^000000.
Just 2, and make
sure they're scary.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好的，給我帶
^FF00002個看起來很嚇人的
魔物面具^000000。
只要2個，
一定要嚇人的那種。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
What do you think
you're doin'? I'm
pretty insulted, seeing
as you're all defiant like
this. How do you expect
to become a good Rogue?!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你以為你在幹什麼？
我相當受辱，
畢竟你表現得這麼叛逆。
你指望怎麼成為一名優秀的流氓？！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So... You bring
the masks like
a good little soldier?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以... 你像
一個聽話的小士兵那樣
把面具帶來？

scripts.text: Uh huh.
scripts.translation: 嗯哼。

scripts.text: Yes, Sir!
scripts.translation: 是，長官！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, remember our
little rule? I even
clued you off when
I said ''soldier!'' Heh~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，記得我們
的小規則嗎？我甚至
在我說“士兵！”的時候
就給你提示了。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Okay, let me check.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好的，讓我檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Excellent!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Look, I know I gave you
a hard time. And don't worry,
I'm not gonna take your masks.
I just wanted to train you
to be the best Rogue that
you can be. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
聽著，我知道我
對你很嚴厲。別擔心，
我不會拿走你的面具。
我只是想訓練你
成為最好的流氓。明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Eh? So what's this
note you keep carrying
around in your hand?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
咦？那你一直拿在
手裡的這張紙條是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hmmm... Mmmhmmm...
Hmmm... Mmmhmmm...
Hmmm... Mmmhmmm... Oh!

[Agent]
Aw, nuts! Why didn't
you say something?
I thought you were
here to take the Job
change test for Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哎呀！你為什麼不
早點說？
我還以為你是來
參加流氓轉職考試的！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Aw man, you came all this
way to help me out, and
I thought I--I'm really,
really sorry! It's just
that I got you mixed up
with a trainee I'm expecting...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哎呀，你大老遠
跑來幫我，
結果我卻--我真的
非常非常抱歉！只是
我把你和我預期的
學員搞混了...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Do me a favor, and
not tell anyone, yeah?
Consider this... I dunno,
an insider look into the
Rogue world if you would.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
幫個忙，
別告訴任何人，好嗎？
你可以把這看作...
算是窺探一下
流氓世界內部的秘密吧。

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，長官！

scripts.text: I won't tell anyone.
scripts.translation: 我不會告訴任何人。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Whoa! Whoa!
You can knock
that off now.
Thanks, I really
appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哇！哇！
你不用這麼誇張啦。
謝謝，
我真的非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Thanks. I knew I could
trust you somehow!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
謝謝。我就知道
可以信任你！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, you've got one
last place to go, Morocc.
Check in with the Rogue
agent over there, will you?
Oh, and take this food
with my apologies, 'kay?
[Agent]
Wait, something
isn't quite right. You
mind coming back
a little later?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
總之，你還有
最後一個地方要去，莫洛奇。
去那邊找流氓特工
報到一下，好嗎？
哦，還有，拿著這些食物
算是我的賠罪，好嗎？
[特工]
等等，
好像有點不對勁。
你介意稍後再
回來一趟嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, you've got one
last place to go, Morocc.
Check in with the Rogue
agent over there, will you?
Oh, and take this food
with my apologies, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
總之，你還有
最後一個地方要去，莫洛奇。
去那邊找流氓特工
報到一下，好嗎？
哦，還有，拿著這些食物
算是我的賠罪，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, be safe on your
way to Morocc, alright?
Good luck finding that
Rogue agent over there.
Oh, and mum's the word
on my little mistake~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，去莫洛奇的路上
注意安全，好嗎？
祝你在莫洛奇順利找到
那位流氓特工。
哦，還有，我剛才的小失誤
就爛在肚子裡吧~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, didja even bother
to bring the masks?
Go back and find them!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你連面具
都沒帶嗎？
回去把它們找回來！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, hey, you're back?
Weren't you already on
your way to Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，嘿，你回來了？
你不是已經在去
莫洛奇的路上嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh, looks like we
solved this case~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，看來我們
破案了~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Thanks to you,
we don't have to
worry about that
crummy ol' Z Gang.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
多虧了你，
我們不用再擔心
那個討厭的Z幫了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Until the world is
free of evil and all
that, the Rogues'll
always have work to do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
只要世界上
還有邪惡存在，
流氓們就永遠
有做不完的工作。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Why are you still
sticking around?
Don't you have
something more
important to do?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你為什麼還
賴在這裡？
難道你沒有
更重要的事
要做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
A case? What are you...?
Ask somebody else. I don't
know what you're saying.
Leave me alone, and
just let me relax~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
案件？你在說什麼...
去問別人吧。我不知道
你在說什麼。
別煩我，
讓我歇會兒~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Ahhh, what'd I do
for a nice jug of
frosty beer now~
...What?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
啊，要是現在能來
一大桶冰鎮啤酒
就好了~
...什麼？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, yeah, I'm almost
done with my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，對，我的調查
快結束了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
The Z Gang has been
causing trouble everywhere.
It's just mischief, but...
If I got my hands on them...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
Z幫到處惹事。
雖然只是惡作劇，但是...
如果讓我抓到他們...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, that gang is
drawing a lot of flak
to Morocc. I mean, they
kind of live here, so...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
總之，那個幫派
在莫洛奇惹了很多麻煩。
我是說，他們
好像住在這裡，所以...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
God, I want a drink.
Listen, would you just
go report to the Rogue
Guild for me? I know it's
my responsibility, but...
It's something for you to do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
天哪，我想喝酒。
聽著，你能替我
去流氓公會報告一下嗎？
我知道這是我的責任，但是...
就當是你幫我個忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh! Keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿！繼續
加油~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I don't know who these
pranksters are, but once
I get my hands on them...
I'm gonna--! I'm gonna--!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我不知道這些惡作劇的傢伙是誰，
但要是讓我抓到他們...
我要——！我要——！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
God, I want a drink.
Listen, would you just
go report to the Rogue
Guild for me? I know it's
my responsibility, but...
It's something for you to do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
天哪，我想喝酒。
聽著，你能替我
去流氓公會報告一下嗎？
我知道這是我的責任，但是...
就當是你幫我個忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh! Keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿！繼續
加油~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hurry up, and report
for me to the Rogue
Guild. While you do that,
I think I'll enjoy a drink~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
快一點，替我去流氓公會
報告一下。趁你去的時候，
我想先喝點酒~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
*Hiccup*
Ahahaha,
this feels good!
Good ol' beeeer~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
*打嗝*
啊哈哈，
真舒服！
好喝的老啤酒~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
*Hiccup*
scripts.translation:
[特工]
*打嗝*

scripts.text:
[Agent]
What are you?
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你是誰？
滾開！
